m300235.――うむ、異界の門が開いたぞい。: —Indeed, the gate to the other world has opened.
m300235.――おぉー！ やる気まんまんだ！\nよぉし、王子さま、\nアンナちゃんの日記の中: —Whoa! I'm pumped! All right, Your Highness, let's charge into Anna's diary!
m300235.……そうか、聞いたことがあるぞ。\n膨大な物語世界――リブレットを収めた図書館と: …I see, I've heard of that. A massive library that houses countless story worlds—booklets—and the librarians who guard and restore them.
m300235.……それに、アンナの日記に虫がいるなら、\n急いで討伐しないと物語が――彼女の思: …And if there are bugs in Anna's diary, we have to exterminate them quickly, or the story—her memories—will be devoured by those insects.
m300235.……みんな楽しかった、みたい？: …Everyone seemed to have had fun, I guess?

m300235.……刺激的ではあったな。\nこの世界の花を摘めなかったのは心残りだが。: …It was exhilarating. It's a shame I couldn't pick any of this world's flowers, though.
m300235.……創作意欲が溢れかえっていますわ。\n早く書かないとどうにかなってしまいそうで: …My creative spirit is overflowing. If I don't start writing soon, I fear something terrible will happen.
m300235.あぶないあぶない。\n……うん、ちゃんと受け取ったよ。\n王子兼司書さん、おつか: Dangerous, dangerous. …Yeah, I got it safely. Thank you, Prince-librarian, for your hard work!
m300235.うぅん、日記も物語のひとつだから、\nちゃんと物語世界（リブレット）が存在してる: Well, a diary is a story too, so there's a proper story world—a booklet—inside it.
m300235.うん！ 途中までは虫退治も順調だったんだけど、\n突然グリモワールちゃんに邪魔さ: Yeah! We were doing fine with the bug-clearing until Grimour-chan suddenly interfered, scattering everyone to different places.
m300235.うーん、くわしく……むずかし……。\nあのね、さっきまでわたしたちは、\n『アン: Hmm, details… are tricky… You see, until just now we were inside the “Anna's Diary” booklet.
m300235.えっ、ええええっ！？\nどうして私の日記に異界の門が――きゃぁっ！？: Wh—what?! How is a portal opening in my diary—? Ahhh!
m300235.おかげでアンナちゃんのリブレットは、\nちゃーんと元通りになったよ。: Thanks to you, Anna's reprinted story is back to normal.
m300235.さて、門は長くは保たない。\nそろそろ別れの言葉は済んだかね？: Now, the gate won't stay open for long. Shall we finish our farewell words?
m300235.そうなの！ 手伝ってくれるとうれしいな……。: That's right! I'd be thrilled if you helped…
m300235.そのグリモワールなる人物の力が、\nアンナの日記に何らかの影響を及ぼし、\n異界: That Grimour fellow's power may have affected Anna's diary, causing the portal to another realm to appear…
m300235.それで、エイトといっしょに、\n『アンナの日記』のリブレットに出現した、\n虫を: So Eight and I showed up in the “Anna's Diary” booklet and were trying to exterminate some insects…
m300235.それでは――と、王子？ どうかしましたか？\n……あっ！ そうです！\nお借りし: Well then—um, Prince? Is something the matter? …Ah! That's right! I have to return the Colette I borrowed!
m300235.では、アンナの日記帳に調査の魔術をかける。\nおそらく何も起きないとは思うが――: Very well, I'll cast a detection spell on Anna's diary. I doubt anything will happen, though—
m300235.むむ……魔力が安定せぬぞ……っ？\nこれは……！ サイラス、気をつけよ！\n――:
Hmm… the magical energy isn't stabilizing…? What the—! Cyrus, watch out!
—A portal to another world is opening!!—
m300235.もう、ファウストはそればっかり！\n王子、この世界の怪盗ちゃん達に、\nよろしく: Oh, Faust, always the same! Prince, please give my regards to the phantom thieves of this world!
m300235.わ、私の日記から、女の子が飛び出て……？\nあの……あなたはいったい……？: A girl just sprang out of my diary…? Who… are you?
m300235.わ、私の日記帳のりぶれっと……？\nあの、もう少し詳しく伺ってもよいでしょうか？: The… booklet of my diary? Could you explain a bit more, please?
m300235.わたし？ わたしはテイル！\nエイトと一緒に『アンナの日記』の\nリブレットにい: Me? I'm Tail! I was with Eight in the “Anna's Diary” booklet, or so I thought…
m300235.エイトともはぐれちゃったし、\nルパンちゃんに、ゲーテちゃん、ファウストさんも\: I got separated from Eight, and I've lost track of Lupin-chan, Goethe-chan, and even Faust-san…
m300235.リブレットっていうのは、物語の世界のことで、\n……あぁっ！ これ！ この日記の: A booklet is basically the world of the story itself… —Ah! This! It's inside the diary!
m300235.君はアンナが著した日記の物語世界を守るべく、\nこの日記のリブレットへ入ったのだ: You entered the diary's booklet to protect the story world Anna wrote in, didn't you?
m300235.日記に残されていた魔力は僅かだったが、\n無事に安定させることが出来たな。: The magical energy left in the diary was faint, but we managed to stabilize it safely.
m300235.王子さま、手伝ってくれてありがとう！: Prince, thank you for your help!
m300235.王子よ、このまま異界の門を放置はできまい。\nテイルの仲間の居場所探し、手伝って: Prince, we can't just leave the gate to the other world open. How about helping us find Tail's missing companions?
m300235.私の日記の中に、ですか！？\nこれ、ごく普通の日記帳ですよ……？\n中に入る場所: Inside my diary?! But this is just an ordinary notebook… I don't see any way to get inside it…

――Oh, so this is the legendary honey.
Here goes... licks... Mmm~! It's so sweet!

――Here we go!
Let's do this, Goldo!!

――That's enough!
Everyone, let's take a break for now.

――Yay! A bountiful catch!

"Happy New Year."

Chainson Man & Golden Demon: ――3, 2, 1!
Let's goooooo!!

…………
Achillea, this is your department. I leave it to you.

...No, I'm fine, both of you.
It seems I was just having a dream.

...Huh?
Ah, is that so? Really?
I suppose so, haha, ahahaha!
m300481.……えっ？ 次？\nまだ別の食材も集めるの！？:
...Huh? Next?
We're gathering other ingredients too?!

...Let's keep this place a secret

m300481.……だから雪の積もった訓練場で模擬戦を？: ...So we're doing a mock battle in the snowy training grounds?
m300481.……っ！！\n奴は……この森のヌシ……！！:
...!
That thing... it's the master of this forest...!!
m300481.……なんというのか、大変ですわね？: ...How should I put it... this is quite the predicament, isn't it?
m300481.……まあいいでしょう。あなたに話があります。: That is irrelevant. In the worst case, we will drag her out by force.
m300481.……インテリデーモン。\n開発はそちらに任せていたが、\nいったい何をしたのかね:
...Intelligent Demon.
I left the development to you,
but what exactly have you done?
m300481.……三清が揃い踏みとは、いつ以来でしょうか。: ...It has been quite some time since the Three Pure Ones stood together.
m300481.……妖怪を退けるか。\n見事だ、まろうどたちよ。:
...You have repelled the yokai.
Well done, my attendants.
m300481.……本当に恐ろしいのは、\n王国なのかもしれませんね。: ...Perhaps it is the Kingdom that is truly terrifying.
m300481.……皆気を付けて！\nあれは、森のクマさんだ……！！:
...Everyone, be careful!
That's a bear from the forest...!!
m300481.──それで、きみが王子で間違いないかな？: ──Now then, you are the Prince, correct?
m300481.──というわけだ、私も準備をして王国に向かおう。: ──So it is settled. I will prepare and head to the Kingdom.
m300481.──野蛮だね。そういうところはまるで変わっていない。: Ah, that is precisely why Daode Tianzun is the one we need, isn't it?
m300481.あ、甘味区画はプリンの池の領有権を巡って、\n宗教戦争勃発間近なので近づかないよ:
Oh, the dessert section is on the verge of a religious war
over the ownership of the Pudding Pond, so stay away from there!

Huh? I was just drinking my fill
at a banquet a moment ago...
m300481.ああ、それならこの狙撃手エイルにお任せを。\nちょうど先日、この辺りで見かけたん:
Ah, if that's the case, leave it to this marksman, Eir.
I happened to see it around here the other day.
m300481.ああ、とても、幸せな夢を……。: Ah... it was such a happy dream...
m300481.あくまで我が師の命に従うため。\nそれ以上でも、それ以下でもない。\nあまり勘違:
I am following my master's orders, nothing more.
Nothing less.
Please do not misunderstand.
m300481.あっ！？ 貴方は確か、\n迷い家の従者の……！:
Oh! You are the...
the Lost House Attendant!
m300481.あなたもあんまりもたもたしていますと、\nこのポトフの泉は私が独り占めしますわよ:
If you keep dawdling,
I'm going to hog this pot-au-feu spring all to myself, you know?
m300481.あの、どうして\nそんなことを説明するのですか……？:
Um, why are you explaining
something like that to us...?
m300481.あの、もうその辺でどうか穏便に……。: U-um, could you two please calm down and settle this peacefully...?
m300481.あの、ラタトスク様。\nお酒を飲みすぎでは……？:
Um, Lady Ratatoskr.
Have you perhaps had a bit too much to drink?
m300481.あのぉ、別にレギーナさんの話をしたわけでは――: Um, we weren't really talking about you, Regina――

I thought the point was to scatter the nightmare
so the Prince could have a good dream…
m300481.あれ、忘れたんですかレギーナ。\nなんとグルメジャングルの食べ物は、\n年始に限:
Oh, did you forget, Regina?

during the New Year period, you see?

After all that firing,
it was certainly a fierce battle,
just as Mel said.
m300481.あれはチェインソン男と、\n魔王軍時代にコマでブイブイ言わせてきた\nゴールデン:
That's the Chainson Man and the Golden Demon,
who made quite a name for themselves with their tops
back in the Demon King's army!
m300481.あーあーあー、君はそうやってすぐ暴力に訴える。\n武力とは大事を成すため止むを得: Those who brandish power carelessly lose the persuasive power of their words.

No, look...
The beasts... they're being chased by bees!
m300481.いえ、むしろ頼ってもらえている感がいい感じです。: No, I actually feel honored that they're relying on us.

It was nothing.
Ah… Since we're here,
how about the four of us grab a drink after he wakes up?
m300481.いざ、伝説のはちみつ狩り！: Then, let's go hunt for that legendary honey!
m300481.いざ尋常に雪合戦だァ――ッ！！: Let's settle it with a snowball fight, then――!!
m300481.いや、どう取り繕っても\nこんな正月はおかしいが……？: No, no matter how you spin it, a New Year like this is just wrong...

Oh my, what a stroke of luck to find such a perfect banquet hall!
I was just wandering around when it suddenly appeared, which was quite a surprise.
m300481.いやァ、楽しい訓練だった！\nみんなの腕前も見れて大満足だなァ！:
Well, that was a fun training session!
I got to see everyone's skills up close, so I'm very satisfied!
m300481.うとうとしながら餅を食べるな！\nそんなに死にたいんですか！？:
Don't eat mochi while you're half-asleep!
Are you trying to die or something!?

Mm. Fishermen cannot survive without work.
This can be considered part of the recovery efforts.
m300481.うわぁっ、床からおとし玉が生えてきましたよ……！？: Whoa! The otoshidama are growing out of the floor...!
m300481.えぇ、根こそぎ食べてしまうかもしれませんし……。: Yes, they might eat it all down to the last drop...
m300481.えぇと、つまりこの夢の世界は、\n王子が見ている\n「今年の激戦の再現」というこ:
So, if I understand correctly, this dream world is a
re-enactment of the Prince's
intense battles from this year, right?

Yes... Do you really not remember anything?

Could it be that the shock made you lose your memory?

m300481.ええ、みんなで成長しましょう。\n北方の異変や「黒い光冠」の件にも、\nちゃんと:
Yes, let's all grow stronger together.
So we can properly face the anomalies in the North
and the matter of the "Black Crown of Light."
m300481.ええ、彼女は華の国で最も信仰される神の一柱。\nもしも首尾よくあの子の助力を得ら: However, the investigation into the "Black Crown of Light" is urgent.
m300481.ええと、確か元始天尊様と共に三清と呼ばれる三大仙人、\nその一角にして道徳天尊の: Um, if I recall correctly, you are one of the Three Great Immortals, the "Three Pure Ones," who serve alongside Yuanshi Tianzun…
m300481.えっ……あぁ、そうか。\nたまには戦いじゃない夢だって見たいよな。:
Huh… Ah, right.
I suppose he'd like to see a dream that isn't about fighting, too.

W-Wait, what? No way!
Anyway, countless enemies are approaching!
Everyone in the dream, please fight alongside us!
m300481.えへへ……でも、たまにはこんなお正月も、\n楽しくていいんじゃないですか……？: Hehe... but maybe it's nice to have a New Year like this once in a while...?
m300481.おい！ 理解を諦めんなよ！！: Hey! Don't give up on understanding this!
m300481.おそらくアヅミさんの言う伝説のはちみつは、\nこの森に棲息するハチの魔物が蓄える:
I believe the legendary honey Azumi is talking about is the rich,
magic-infused honey stored by the bee monsters that inhabit this forest.

Oh, did you spot a crab right away?
Hey, Giovanni,
did you catch a big one?

Please snap out of it, both of you.

m300481.お前、変なところで変な自信あるよな……。: You really have some strange confidence in the strangest places…

We're at the royal castle, and you're eating mochi.
I have no idea what kind of dream you were having,
but be careful not to choke on the mochi.
m300481.この森は魔力を帯びた花がよく咲きますからね。\nその蜜を集め、熟成させることで、:

By gathering their nectar and letting it mature,
they likely produce even more delicious honey.

At this rate, we'll be done in no time.
...Hm? What's that sound?

If I don't do at least this much,
my muscle-bound partner can't keep up.

m300481.こんなに雪が積もってんだからよ、\nみんなで雪合戦と洒落込みたくてなァ！:
With this much snow piled up,
I just want to have a snowball fight with everyone!
m300481.さぁ、カニを探しましょう！: Now then, let's look for crabs!

Now then, take your positions at the cannons!
Let's see which gunner is the best at handling snowballs!
m300481.さぁ、妖怪たちを迎え撃ちますよ。\n華麗に勝利して、誅子に武勇伝を聞かせるのです:
Now, let us meet the yokai head-on.
We will achieve a glorious victory and have a tale of valor to tell Shuzi.

Well then, I suppose it's time to wake him up.
Prince, if you have another weird dream,
don't hesitate to call us, okay?
m300481.さぁ行くぜゴールデンデーモンッ！\nどっちが最強のコマ回しか決めようぜッ！:
Let's go, Golden Demon!
Let's settle who the best top-spinner is!
m300481.さあな、何百年振りとかじゃないか？: Who knows? Maybe it's been a few hundred years?

After sleeping that long, he should be close to a full recovery.
Once he passes his final check-up, he'll be ready to fight with full force.

A major crab fishing ground, indeed.
It's certainly dangerous, but the rewards are substantial.

Now then, the Lost House has this to say.
"It is New Year's, so please feel free to relax here for a while."

However…… even if it was our fault,

to end up as scrap…….

m300481.しばきますよ？: I'm going to beat you up, you know?
m300481.しゃあっ！ チェインソン男、爆散！: There! Chainson Man, blown to smithereens!
m300481.すなわち、顔見知りに挑み、\nその力で落とさせるものだと。:
That is, they believe it means challenging someone they know
and having them defeat you.
m300481.そういうことなら、\n号砲の亜神が参戦しないわけにはいきません。:

A drinking session with a divine unicorn.
Sounds good. I have nothing planned for tomorrow.
m300481.私は主君に恵まれましたし……？: I have been blessed with a good master...?
m300481.私は好きで仕えていますから、\n苦労だとは思ってませんよ。:
I serve them because I enjoy it,
so I wouldn't call it a hardship.
m300481.私は振り回されてる感じです……。: I feel more like I'm being dragged along for the ride...
m300481.私も協力しますわ！\nなんでも任せてくださいませ！:
I'll help as well!
Please leave everything to me!
m300481.穏やかな正月を過ごすつもりが、\n何やらおかしなことに巻き込まれたようだ。:
I was planning to spend a peaceful New Year,
but it seems I've been dragged into some strange situation.
m300481.突然カニが欲しいと言い出した時は驚いたが、\nまぁ、今回はタイミングが良かったな:
I was surprised when he suddenly asked for crab,
but well, the timing works out this time.
m300481.老君、これもまた大きな流れの一つだよ。: Laojun, this is simply part of the greater flow of things.
m300481.老君も、相手を怒らせるようなことは言うべきじゃない。\n常に誠意を大切にね。悪意: Always cherish sincerity. Malice only begets malice.
m300481.聞くまでもねェさ！\n雪合戦の第二回戦をはじめようぜ！:
Don't even have to ask!
Let's start the second round of the snowball fight!
m300481.胃薬なら私が持っていますわよ？: I have some stomach medicine if you need it?
m300481.訓練というのは嘘じゃないが、\n名目上の話だからね。:
It's not a lie that it's training,
but that's just the official reason.
m300481.訓練というのは嘘じゃないさ。\nほら、現在北方で「黒い光冠」だのと、\n色々騒ぎ:
It's not a lie that it's training.
Look, there's a lot of commotion in the North about the "Black Light Crown," right?
m300481.訓練と聞いていたのだが……。\nこれはいったいどういうことだ？:
I was told this was training...
What is going on here?
m300481.誅子も。正月だからとはめを外しすぎですよ。\nほら、お水を飲んでください。:
Zhuzi, too. It's New Year's, but you've really let your hair down.
Here, have some water.
m300481.説明されても分かんねぇのは俺だけか？: You're telling me that, and I'm still the only one who doesn't get it?
m300481.誰かー！ この二人の喧嘩止められる人ー！？: Anyone there! Can somebody stop these two from fighting!?
m300481.迷い家様はこう仰っている、\n『間違った認識だけど楽しそうだから訂正はしない』と:
My Master says,
"It's a misconception, but it looks like fun, so I won't correct them."
I'm sure you can handle them, even if the yōkai start playing around.
m300481.迷い家様も褒めていらっしゃる。\n『頑張った皆におとし玉をあげる』と。:
The Lost House itself is pleased.
It says, "I shall give the otoshidama to everyone who worked hard."
m300481.関係ありません。最悪、力ずくでも引きずっていきます。: There are many lands, such as the domains of nomadic horse clans, that lie beyond the reach of the Flower King's authority.
m300481.頭の悪い仙人に大切な家を荒らされたくはないからね。: The problem is whether Daode Tianzun will agree to help…
m300481.飽き飽きだね、どうせ百年も経てばまた戦国時代さ。: I'm so tired of this. In a hundred years, it'll just be another age of warring states.
m300481.駄目です。酔っていたせいで、\n二人とも気持ちよく寝てしまっています。:
It's no use. They were so drunk
that they've both fallen into a deep sleep.
m300481.魔物の復活以降、中止していた北洋のカニ漁を、\nそろそろ復活させたいと\n漁師た:
Since the revival of the monsters, the Northern Sea crab fishing had been suspended,
but the fishermen had just been urging us
to resume it soon.
m300481.魔物の復活前には、一攫千金を夢みて\n漁師たちが集っていた海域ですからね。: It was a sea area where fishermen once gathered, dreaming of striking it rich, before the monsters' revival.
m300481.黒い光冠の魔物についての調査という話なら、\n私は喜んで協力させてもらおうと思っ:
If it's about investigating the monsters with the black light crowns,
I'd be more than happy to lend a hand.
m300481.（ああ、これが夢なら覚めないでくれ──）: (Oh, if this is a dream, please don't let me wake up...)
m300481.（あのお方が太上道君……またの名を霊宝天尊。\n万物の根源を体現するという三大仙: The last of the Three Great Immortals, said to embody the source of all things.)
m300481.（おいしい食べ物がこんなにたくさん、\nしかもいくら食べても太らないなんて……）:
(So much delicious food,
and I can eat as much as I want without gaining weight...)
m300481.（もしかして元始天尊様と太上老君様って、\nものすごーく仲が悪かったりするんじゃ: It's unlikely. She hasn't left her home in a hundred years.
m300481.（幸せだ……こんな幸せなことがあるだろうか……）: (This is happiness... could there be anything happier...?)
m300481.（歴史、これ歴史だ……絶対に遺さないと！）: (History. This is history... I absolutely must record this!)

m400125.ここは地形を熟知している田園で敵を迎え討つ他に\n手立てはありません。: The only option is to meet them head-on here, where we know the terrain best.
m400125.すでに敵は田園を襲撃するための布陣を整えています。\n敵陣に攻め込むのは危険です: They're already setting up their formation to raid the fields. Attacking their camp would be too risky.
m400125.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Also, defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400125.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: First, the sole objective is to eliminate the enemy. Nothing else matters.
m400125.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life gauge hits zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've defeated will be recorded as your achievement.
m400125.今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This battle will be a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” focused solely on defeating the enemy.
m400125.今回は敵が奇襲してきます。\n敵の動きが通常よりも速いのでお気を付けください。: The enemy will launch a surprise attack this time, moving faster than usual, so stay alert.
m400125.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—focus on slaying as many monsters as possible.
m400125.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので\nご注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400125.敵の大部隊が田園近くに展開しているとの報告が\n入りました。: We've received reports that a large enemy force is deploying near the fields.
m400125.王子、田園を守るため『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission to protect the fields!
m400125.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: Rather than protecting our own forces, the priority is how many foes we can take down.
m400125.被害を最小限にするため、すでに放棄された居住区に\nわが軍の陣地を用意しました。: To minimize casualties, we've prepared our own positions in the abandoned residential area.

m400330.――それから王子よ、どうにもきな臭い噂を耳にした。\nこの件で亜神ディアスが動い:
—And, Prince, I've caught wind of some pretty nasty rumors.
The demigod Dias may be getting involved in this!
Never let your guard down against unknown threats!!
m400330.――ほう、魔王城へ向かうのか。\nかつての戦場に再び立つ戦士、心が踊るなッ！！: ――Ho, heading to the Demon King's Castle, are you? A warrior standing again on the old battlefield—my heart leaps!!
m400330.……これは、激戦になりそうですねぇ。: …Looks like this will turn into a fierce battle.
m400330.……ところで、魔王城の財宝は、\nこっそり大胆に盗んじゃってもいいのか？: …By the way, can we just sneakily and boldly steal the castle's treasure?
m400330.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となりますから、\n敵の討伐を優先し、\n魔王城内: Since “clearing even with zero life” is allowed, prioritize enemy kills and cut down the castle's forces as much as you can.
m400330.「援軍要請」のスキルを持つ兵や、\nワルキューレのような兵科を\n出撃メンバーに: I recommend adding troops with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or units like Valkyries to your deployment roster.
m400330.えぇ、今回は敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を得ることはできないでし: Yeah, this time we probably won't get any EXP, gold, or drops even if we defeat enemies…
m400330.それも抜かりなく♪\nデモシェフ商会の方々が先遣隊として、\n魔界の様子を調査し: We've got it covered♪ The Demochef Trading Company sent a vanguard to scout the demon realm!
m400330.ただ城内には、ガリウスを信奉する、\n多数のデーモンが彷徨っているとのことで……: But inside the castle, many demons who worship Garius are said to be wandering...
m400330.つまりこの戦いは、神の楔捜索隊のため、\n出来るだけ多くの『敵を倒すこと』を\n: In other words, this fight is a mission for the Divine Wedge search team—to slay as many enemies as possible!
m400330.ふむ……それで、\n魔王城の現在地は分かっているのか？\n闇雲に魔界に突入するわ: Hmm… so, do we know its current location? We can't just charge blindly into the demon realm!
m400330.まぁ、知っていたとしても、\n決戦後に回収できたとは思えないが。: Well, even if we knew, I doubt we could retrieve it after the final battle.
m400330.また、今回は特殊な作戦ですから、\n時間経過で出撃コストが回復しません。: Also, this is a special operation, so deployment costs won't recover over time.
m400330.むっ……それはすまんなッ！\nしかしまさか、魔王城に神の楔があるとは……！: Hmm… sorry about that! But to think the Demon King's Castle holds the Divine Wedge…!
m400330.ガオレオンさま、声が大きいですよぉっ！\n執務室が壊れちゃいますぅぅ！: Lord Gaoleon, your voice is so loud! It'll break the office!
m400330.同時に、魔王城の調査も兼ねていますから、\n討伐数もすべて記録されていきます。: At the same time, we're also investigating the castle, so every kill will be recorded.
m400330.敵が数で押してくるなら、\n全部倒せば良いって話だろ？\n今までやってきた事じゃ: If the enemy swarms us, we just have to wipe them all out, right? That's what we've always done.
m400330.決戦後まもなくして、\n魔王城は魔界へ沈んでいってしまいましたからね。: Shortly after the final battle, the Demon King's Castle sank into the demon realm.
m400330.自軍の被害を怖れるなってことね。\nふふっ、私たちらしくて良いんじゃない？: Don't fear casualties on our side. Heh, that's just like us, right?
m400330.連中によれば、魔王城には未だ、\nガリウスを討った時の、三女神の力が残っているら: According to them, the castle still retains the power of the three goddesses from when we defeated Garius. Thanks to that, it's not corrupted by the realm's miasma.
m400330.魔王城は魔王ガリウスが作り出した要塞だからな……。\n財宝なんてどこにもないと思: The castle is a fortress created by Demon King Garius… I don't think there's any treasure anywhere.

m400457.――おぉ～、これが王国、\nそして王国軍と帝国軍の皆さん、と。: —Whoa, this is the kingdom, and the kingdom's army and the empire's troops, huh.
m400457.――ふぁ……あふ……。\n海辺の朝というのも良いものだな。: —Ah… sigh… A seaside morning really is something.
m400457.……やれやれ。\nさて王子、私たちもバカンスに向かおうか。: …Good grief. So, Prince, shall we head off on vacation as well?
m400457.……無断の召喚実験は禁止ですよ？\nちゃんと申請はしてくださいね。: …Unauthorized summoning experiments are prohibited, you know? Please submit a proper request.
m400457.……熱くなりすぎて、\n倒れないように注意するですよ？: …Don't get so heated that you collapse, okay?
m400457.あっ……また後方彼女面してるぅ……。: Ah… she's acting all mysterious behind me again…
m400457.えええええっ！？\nあの子ってセレンさんのお子さんだったんですかぁ！？: Wha—!? That kid is Selen's child!?
m400457.おぉ、あのヴァイスさんが\n熱くなってるの、珍しいですねぇ……。: Oh, Weiss getting all fired up—how rare!
m400457.かき氷……ひやひや、冷たい……。\nわーい……あっまーい！: Shaved ice… so cold, so refreshing… Yay… sooo sweet!
m400457.この合同演習も終わりが近い。\nアナトリア、お前とはそろそろ決着をつけたいものだ: This joint exercise is drawing to a close. Anatolia, it's about time we finally settle things between us.
m400457.それから、喚ばれる相手の都合も考えるんだぞ？\nもし取り込み中だったら大変だろう: And you should think about the person you're calling, alright? It'd be a mess if they're in the middle of something.
m400457.それでは、そろそろ演習の準備を始めましょうか。\n王子、皆さん、よろしくお願いし: Well then, shall we begin the preparations? Prince, everyone, thank you in advance!
m400457.はっ……たしかに……。\nじゃあちょっとだけ考慮しますねー。: Yeah… true enough… I'll consider it, just a little.
m400457.ふふ、よかったら一緒に飛んでみますか？\nスズさんの飛び方、ぜひ見てみたいです！: Hehe, would you like to try flying together? I'd love to see how you fly, Suzu!
m400457.やーだー、申請めんどうですー。: Aw man, paperwork is such a hassle—
m400457.わぁっ、おっきいグリフィン！\n翼もおっきいなぁ……。: Wow, a huge griffin! Its wings are massive too…
m400457.わー！ しますしま～す♪\n――って、んきゃぁぁぁ！？ 何ですかその豪速球！？: Yay! Let's do it♪ —Whoa, what the—!? What's with that blazing fastball!?
m400457.ん、なんだご主人のことを聞きたいのか？\n何を隠そう、ご主人は私が育てたんだ。: Hmm, you want to know about the Master? Let me tell you, I raised him.
m400457.んっ、リンと言ったか？\nどうだ、特製かき氷はいらないか。: Hmm, did you say Rin? How about a special shaved ice—do you want some?
m400457.クロミ！ せっかく海に来たんだ、\n一緒にビーチバレーに励まないか？: Kuromi! Since we've come to the beach, why don't we play some beach volleyball together?
m400457.フッ……絆の深さじゃ親子すら超えるかもしれないな……。\n何しろご主人のことで、: Heh… our bond might even surpass parent-child ties… When it comes to the Master, there's nothing I don't know—
m400457.フフ、ここまでは互いに\nなかなか剣を交えることができなかったからねぇ。: Heh, we've hardly had a chance to clash swords until now, have we?
m400457.熱い日差し、涼やかな海風、\nまるでビーチが\n今日の合同演習を祝福してくれてい: The scorching sun, the cool sea breeze—it's as if the beach itself is cheering on today's joint exercise.
m400457.熱き友との戦いと、灼熱の日差し、\n夏は戦士をアツくする季節なんだよ！: A battle with a hot friend, blazing sun—summer really gets warriors fired up!
m400457.皆さんやる気が漲っているようで何よりです。\n特に今日は、特別ゲストもご招待して: Everyone's enthusiasm is wonderful. Especially today, we have a special guest invited.
m400457.（ふっふー、召喚大成功です。\nこれで今後は、自由に召喚実験も認められ――）: (Heh, the summoning was a total success. From now on I can freely conduct summoning experiments—)

m400546.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。: The goal of a Great Annihilation Mission is to take down as many foes as possible.
m400546.いやー、大変な事になりましたねぇ。\nもうドレスお披露目会の本番直前だっていうの: Wow, this has really turned into a mess. The dress showcase is supposed to be right before the main event.
m400546.さっき見てきましたけど、お父さん、\n物凄い剣幕でしたよ。娘たちは絶対に渡さん！: I just saw him—he was furious. He swore he'd never hand his daughters over! And if the Prince steps out, he'll make him his sworn enemy.
m400546.しかし、誤解を解き事態を収拾するためには、\n王子本人による説明が必要不可欠です: Still, the only way to clear up the misunderstanding is for the Prince himself to explain. I suspect it could easily turn into a battle…
m400546.では王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Then, Prince, commence the Great Annihilation Mission!
m400546.なにぶん、お披露目会を見に来ている観客たちも多く、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う: There are a lot of spectators here to watch the showcase, so we can't deploy our troops the way we normally would.
m400546.はい……。まさか、\n金糸雀姉妹のお父様がジューンブライドの祝祭を\n本物の結婚: Yes… Who would have thought the Goldfinch sisters' father would mistake the June Bride festival for an actual wedding and barge in?
m400546.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。: Also, keep in mind that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP or gold.
m400546.レナータさんからの報告によると、金糸雀姉妹や\n父親に加え、多数の妖怪たちが集ま: According to Renata's report, the Goldfinch sisters, their father, and a host of youkai have gathered. We'll need to be fully prepared.
m400546.一触即発な親子喧嘩って雰囲気でしたからねぇ。\nなんか、妖怪たちも集まり始めてて: It feels like a powder-keg family feud. Plus, all those youkai are gathering, so talking it out probably won't work.
m400546.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、: Since deployment costs don't recover over time, I recommend bringing members with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or adding a Valkyrie to your squad.
m400546.出撃前の留意事項ですが、今回のミッションは\n敵の討伐を目指す『大討伐ミッション: A quick note before we deploy: this mission is a “Great Annihilation Mission,” aiming to defeat the enemies.
m400546.情報ありがとうございます。\nでは、戦いはあると考えて、\n騒動の現場である式場: Thanks for the intel. Then, assuming a fight is inevitable, let's head to the ceremony hall.
m400546.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、: Even if our base's life hits zero, the number of enemies you've defeated will still be recorded, so don't fear falling—keep pressing the attack.
m400546.王子とランウェイを歩き、\nライスシャワーを受ける目玉イベントを、\n婚姻の儀式: He might be misinterpreting the highlight event—walking the runway with the Prince and getting showered with rice—as a marriage ceremony.

m400571.――た、大変です！\n海の家の前でお客さんたちが暴走しています！:
――Oh no!
The customers are causing a ruckus in front of the beach shack!
m400571.――海の家のお手伝い、ですか？: ――Helping out at the beach shack, huh?
m400571.……いや、そう上手くはいかないようじゃ。\nとんちきなのがやって来たぞ。:
...No, it does not appear to be that simple.
A certain troublesome presence has arrived.
m400571.……うるさい仙人たちよりも、\n昔馴染みのほうが厄介かもしれんのう。: ……Old friends might be even more of a pain than the noisy immortals.
m400571.……こういったときは予測できないことが起こるものです。\nどのような事態にも対応:
……In situations like this, the unexpected can happen.
I recommend preparing thoroughly so you can handle any situation that arises.
m400571.……各国の超有名人たちが手伝う海の家がある。\nそんな噂を聞きつけた人々が殺到し:
……Apparently, word got out that a beach shack staffed by superstars from all over the world was opening.
People have been flooding in ever since.
m400571.……王子殿下も乗り気のようですね。: ……It seems His Highness is up for it.
m400571.あぁ……そういえばスイカの魔物も、\n魔神ビフロンスを信仰してたわね……。: Ah... I suppose the Watermelon Monsters did worship the Demon God Bifrons...
m400571.あとまぁ、普通に店の迷惑になるからのう。: Besides, we're just causing a nuisance to the shop.
m400571.あ～有名人に接客されてぇなぁ～。\nそのことをいずれ生まれてくる子どもや孫に、\:
Ah~ I wish I could be served by a celebrity~.
I'll brag about it to my children and grandchildren
for the rest of my life~.
m400571.いやはや、揉めまくっておるな。\nなにやら変な客も混ざっているようじゃが……。:
My, my, what a commotion.
It seems some rather peculiar guests have mixed in with the crowd...
m400571.いやまぁ、海の家に来るんだから、\n手持ちがないこともないんだろうけどさ。\n君:
I mean, since they came to the beach shack,
they probably have something on them, but…
You're not planning to rob ordinary citizens, are you?
m400571.うるさい仙人たちからは逃げられても、\n昔馴染みからは逃げられんかったのう……。:
I could escape the noisy immortals,
but I couldn't shake off my old friends……
m400571.お前それ王国の王子の前でも言えんの？\nオタクは真夏の砂浜みてぇな過酷な環境に来:
You say that in front of the Kingdom's Prince?
Otaku, don't come to harsh environments like a midsummer beach!
Go read your history books in the shade!!
m400571.お客さんたちの勢いが弱まってきたわね。: The customers' energy seems to be dying down.
m400571.ぐぬぬ……どうやらサボれないようじゃのう。: Hmph... It seems I cannot afford to slack off after all.
m400571.こうして多くの人に慕われるのは嬉しいことですが、\nさすがにこれは看過できません:
While it is heartening to be looked up to by so many,
this has gone far beyond what we can simply overlook.
m400571.この魔物に襲われたせいで、\n海の家は営業できなくなったのですね。: So that is why the beach shack was forced to close its doors.
m400571.これからまた働かねばならんのか……。\n儂はもう愛想よく接客する体力とかないぞ？:
I have to work again...
I have no energy left for pleasant customer service.
m400571.さて、これで作戦は終了か。\nなんだかどっと疲れた気がするよ。:
Well, that wraps up the operation.
I feel completely drained.
m400571.さて、開店じゃ。: Now then. We are open for business.
m400571.す、スイカの魔物！？ どうしてここに……！？: A, a Watermelon Monster?! Why is it here...?
m400571.ずっと正気ではない者もいるようです。: It seems some of them are not entirely in their right minds.
m400571.せっかくですから、王子たちも遊びに来ませんか？\n私たちが店員として接客してあげ:
Since we're here, why don't you join us, Prince and all?
We'll be happy to serve you as your staff♪
m400571.そう、スイカを販売していた海の家の人間たちのように！\nみんなの両手首を捻り上げ:
Just like the humans who ran the beach shack and sold watermelons, Sui!
We will twist both of your wrists
so you can never cut a watermelon again, Sui!
m400571.そうだスイ！ スイカたちは人間を許さないスイ！\nだからこの場の人間たちを倒して:
That's right, Sui! The watermelons will not forgive the humans, Sui!
So we will defeat everyone in this place, Sui!
m400571.そう簡単にはいかないスイ！\nスイカの底力を見せてやるスイ――！！:
It won't be that easy, Sui!
We will show you the true strength of a watermelon, Sui――!!
m400571.そのせいで営業できない状態になっていてね。\n紆余曲折あって、私たちが手伝うこと:
They were in no shape to open for business.
After a bit of a roundabout discussion, we ended up agreeing to help out.
m400571.そのとおりだスイ！\nただ、手伝いが入ったのは予想外だったスイ！:
Exactly, Sui!
However, we did not expect reinforcements to show up, Sui!
m400571.そのとき気づいたスイ。\n人間とスイカは相容れないスイ。\nスイカは人間を打倒し:
That is when we realized, Sui.
Humans and watermelons are incompatible, Sui.
Watermelons must defeat humans... Sui!
m400571.その他、風神雷神の娘たちに、号砲の亜神などなど。\n……人々が押し寄せるのも納得:
Not to mention the daughters of the Wind and Thunder Gods, the Demi-god of the Signal Cannon, and so on.
...I suppose it's no wonder the crowds are surging in.
m400571.そもそもこの程度で疲れるほど、\n君はやわじゃないだろう。: You are hardly the type to tire out from something like that.
m400571.それから、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドは入手できないよ。\n戦利品が期待できるよ:
Also, defeating enemies won't yield any EXP or Gold.
It's not a situation where we can expect spoils of war,
and we'll be fighting ordinary customers, after all.
m400571.それともなんでスイ？\nビフロンス様が消滅してしまったせいで、\nもう頑張る理由:
Or is that a question, Sui?
Are you mocking the watermelons who have lost their reason to strive
because Lord Bifrons has been annihilated, Sui?
m400571.だから今度は海の家と王子たちを、\nかち割られたスイカみたいに粉々にして、\n確:
So this time, we will smash the beach shack and the Prince and his friends
to pieces, just like a smashed watermelon,
and put them out of business for good, Sui!
m400571.だとしてもですよ。\n臨時とはいえ店員なんですから、真剣に働かないと。:
Even so.
We are employees, even if only temporarily, so we must work seriously.
m400571.ちょっと営業の手伝いをするはずが、\n大騒動に巻き込まれてしまったみたいじゃな…:
I was only supposed to help out with the sales,
but it seems I've been dragged into a major commotion…
m400571.ついでに儂がその辺でぐーたらしておったのがバレて、\n海の家の手伝いに駆り出され:
And since I was caught lazing about in the area,
I got conscripted into the beach shack crew too.
m400571.でしたら早速、お店にご案内して――: Then, allow me to guide you to the shop right away――
m400571.ですが休むわけにはいきませんよ。: But we cannot afford to rest.
m400571.では改めて、お店を開ける準備をしましょうか。\nほら王子様もお客さんの列に並んで:
Then, let us prepare to open the shop.
Come along, Prince. Please join the line of customers.
m400571.となると、一度騒ぎを鎮める必要がありますね。: In that case, we need to calm the situation down first.
m400571.とはいえ嘆いていても始まらんか。\n皆を落ち着かせる作戦をさっさと考えねばな。:
Still, there's no use in lamenting it.
We need to come up with a plan to calm everyone down, quickly.
m400571.どうやら、スイカの魔物はやる気みたいですね。\nそれに見てください、スイカの甘い:
It seems the Watermelon Monster is quite serious.
And look, the scent of the sweet watermelons has attracted a swarm of insect monsters.
m400571.どけッ、ミーハー共がよ！！\n俺は歴史オタクだぞッ！！\nお前らとは偉人を推して:
Move, you fickle masses!!
I'm a history otaku!!
I've been supporting great figures for far longer than you have!!
m400571.どんどんヒートアップしていっていますね。\nこのままですと暴動に発展する可能性が:
The situation is heating up rapidly.
At this rate, it looks like it could easily escalate into a riot.
m400571.どんな事故を起こしたのかは知らないけど、\n本当にみんな両手首を捻挫していたよ。:
I don't know what kind of accident it was, but
they really did all have sprained wrists.
m400571.なんでもスイカの仕入れの際に事故が起きて、\n店員さん全員が両手首を捻挫すること:
Apparently, an accident happened while they were stocking up on watermelons,
and every single one of them sprained both wrists.
m400571.はぁ……善意で店の手伝いをした結果、\nこんな事態に陥るなんてね。:
Sigh... I can't believe helping out a shop out of the goodness of my heart
would lead to this kind of mess.
m400571.ふふっ、そうだったね。\n私たちは、海の家のお手伝いをするんだもん。:
Fufu, that's right.
We are here to help out at the beach shack.
m400571.ふふっ、なんて言う割には、\n真面目にお手伝いを頑張ってたように見えたけどね？:
Heh, for all that complaining,
you seemed to be working quite hard, though?
m400571.ぼ、暴走っていったいなにがあったのよ！？: A ruckus? What on earth is going on!?
m400571.まぁ、それが一番手っ取り早いだろうね。\n分かっているだろうけど、『大討伐ミッシ:
Well, that is the quickest way to handle it.
As you know, a [Massive Subjugation Mission] aims to deal with
as many opponents as possible at once.
m400571.まぁ、それはさておきじゃ。\nそろそろ海の家の開店時刻が来るわけでな。:
Well, setting that aside.
It's about time for the beach shack to open.
m400571.まさか、従業員たちの両手首捻挫の原因は……！\nスイカの仕入れの際の事故って、そ:
No way... the reason the staff all had sprained wrists was...!
An accident during the watermelon delivery... that's what it was...!
m400571.まだまだ暴れている人たちはいますが、\nこの調子なら問題なく鎮圧できそうです。:
There are still some troublemakers causing a ruckus,
but at this rate, we should be able to quell the situation without issue.
m400571.スイカの生き方とはなにか、生きる意味とはなにか。\n答えのないスイカ哲学を考え続:
What is the way of a watermelon? What is the meaning of existence?
We had been musing on these unanswerable questions of watermelon philosophy,
until one day, we witnessed a watermelon being smashed in a watermelon-cutting game, Sui.
m400571.スイカの魔物の沈黙を確認。\nそれから人々も落ち着きを取り戻したようです。:
The Watermelon Monster has gone silent.
It appears the civilians are regaining their composure as well.
m400571.ビフロンス様がいなくなった今、\n我々は自分のスイカ生を歩くことになったスイ。:
Now that Lord Bifrons is gone,
we have been left to walk the path of our watermelon lives, Sui.
m400571.儂は浜辺で果物でも食べて、寝て、\nちょっと肌でも焼いちゃったりして、\n悠々自:
I was planning to just eat some fruit, take a nap, and
get a little tan while lounging on the beach in peace, but……
m400571.儂らがこんなことをするのは、この夏だけじゃからな。\nしっかり目に焼き付けて、思:
We are only doing this for the duration of this summer.
Take it all in and make a memory of it, Prince♪
m400571.全員変ではあったでしょう。: Well, they were all peculiar to begin with.
m400571.夏といえば海、海といえばスイカ。\nならば浜辺に我々がいることはなにも不思議では:
Summer means the sea, and the sea means watermelon.
So there is nothing strange about us being on the beach, Sui.
m400571.実戦は終わりましたし、次は模擬戦ですか？: The real battle is over, so is this a sparring match next?
m400571.客の数が多いなら、ここは『大討伐ミッション』で、\n一気に鎮圧するべきだろうな。:
If there are so many customers, we should use a [Massive Subjugation Mission]
to quell the disturbance in one go.
m400571.少しでも売り上げに貢献するために、\n吟遊詩人のコネを全力で使って、\n拡散しま:
In our attempt to boost sales, we used our bard connections
to spread the word as widely as possible,
and it seems that backfired.
m400571.新しい模擬戦会場はここですか？: Is this the new simulation arena?
m400571.暴徒たちの勢いを削ることが目的だから、\nライフが０となっても作戦は完遂できる。:
The goal is to break the rioters' momentum,
so even if your Life reaches 0, the mission is considered complete.
The bard over there will handle recording the results.
m400571.模擬戦ひとつもらえますか？: May I have a simulation battle?
m400571.歴史に名を残した偉人や亜神が手伝う海の家。\n貴方としては惹かれるものがあるので:
A beach shack run by historical figures and sub-gods.
Surely that sounds intriguing to you, doesn't it?
m400571.浜辺で遊んでいたらたまたま海の家を見つけたんだけど、\nそこの店員さんたちが困っ:
We were just playing on the beach when we happened to spot it, and
the staff there looked pretty desperate.
m400571.海の家に虫……最悪ですね。: Insects at a beach shack... that is the worst.
m400571.王国文化が生んだ悲しきモンスターね。: A tragic monster born of the kingdom's culture.
m400571.白の帝国の初代皇帝と初代騎士団長。\n華の国の設計者の亜神に、偉大なる仙人。\n:
The First Emperor of the White Empire and the First Grandmaster of the Knights.
The Demi-god who designed the Land of Flowers, and the Great Sage.
And then, the Kingdom's First Vice-Commander...
m400571.私たちは店員として、\nまだまだお客さんたちの相手をしなければいけませんから。:
As employees,
we still have plenty of customers to attend to.
m400571.緊急事態なのもあって、今回は補給は間に合いそうにない。\n部隊を展開するためには:
Given the emergency, it's unlikely we'll be able to resupply in time.
To deploy our forces, we'll need to form a unit with someone who has [Request Reinforcements],
or include the Valkyries.
m400571.自分たちの知名度と人気の高さを、\n低く見積もりすぎておったようじゃな。: It appears we underestimated just how famous and popular we truly are.
m400571.見つかってしまったのが運の尽きじゃ。\n仕方がないから、ほどほど真面目に働くとす:
Well, well. It seems my luck has run out.
Very well then. I shall work with a reasonable degree of seriousness.
m400571.言われてみると確かに、スイカ視点のスイカ割りは、\nとても残酷な遊びに見えそうで: Now that you mention it, a watermelon-cutting game from the watermelons' point of view does sound rather cruel.
m400571.責任を取って……というのも変な話じゃが、\n海の家の臨時手伝いとして、一働きして:
Taking responsibility for this... well, that's a strange way to put it, but
let's pitch in for a bit as temporary help at the seaside house!
m400571.迷惑なスイカと衛生的によくない虫には、\nお引き取り願うとするかのう。: We shall ask these troublesome watermelons and unsanitary insects to kindly leave.
m400571.随分と暇そうにしていたからな。\nありがたく戦力にさせてもらったぞ。:
You looked awfully bored, so
I figured I might as well lend you a hand.
m400571.集まった人たちは興奮状態で話を聞いてくれませんし……。\nこのままだと海の家で暴:
The crowd is too worked up to listen to reason…
If this goes on, we might have a riot on our hands at the beach shack.
m400571.順番が来たら接客してあげるよ。\nそれまでに買いたい物とか決めておいてね。:
We'll serve you when it's your turn.
Try to decide what you want to buy in the meantime, okay?
m400571.食べ物や飲み物を色々と取り揃えていますから。\nたくさん買って売り上げに貢献して:
We have a wide variety of food and drinks available.
Please buy plenty and help boost our sales.

m500238.――あっ、ありがとうございますっ！\nさすが王子の旦那ですよぉー！！\nこの御恩: —Ah, thank you! As expected of the Prince!! I'll definitely repay this favor...!!
m500238.――あのデウスエクスマキナとやら、\n巨体の割にエネルギーの発生機構が見当たらね: —That so-called Deus Ex Machina, for its massive size, has no visible energy generator.
m500238.――おっと、それもそうか。\nとなると、是が非でもここで破壊しちまうしかないな。: —Right, that makes sense. Then we have no choice but to smash it here, no matter what.
m500238.――やった！\nデウスエクスマキナが崩壊していきます！\nさっすが王子の旦那――: —We did it! The Deus Ex Machina is collapsing! That's the Prince for you—wait, what? Hey!?
m500238.――わわわ、そ、そうですね、落ち着かないと……。\nすーはー……すーはー……。\: —W-well, yes, I need to calm down... Sigh... sigh... Alright, let me explain... I'll explain!!
m500238.――何じゃ、この異質な魔力反応は！\n警備機械に魔法が効かぬぞ……！？:
—What is this alien magical reaction!?
Magic doesn't work on the guard machines...!?
m500238.…………やはりな。\n王子、こいつのコアがなくなってるぞ。:
………I knew it.
Prince, its core's gone.
m500238.……あるいは、コアを退避させるために、\nあえて自爆したって可能性もあるが、\n: …Or maybe it self-destructed to protect the core—hard to tell until we search a bit more.
m500238.あいつの注意を引いて、砲弾をも受け止めちゃう、\n重装備の方々の協力が不可欠かと: We'll need the heavy-armed folks to draw its attention and even catch the shells!
m500238.あの青い機械自体にも、\nデウスエクスマキナと同じ魔力障壁があるみたい。\nこう: It seems that blue machine itself has the same magical barrier as the Deus Ex Machina. At this point, we might have to smash it with physical attacks!
m500238.あれだけ膨大なエネルギーを放出してるんだ、\n本体を破壊して循環が止まると、\n: It's unleashing an enormous amount of energy; if we destroy the main body and stop the circulation, it could blow up like a security bot.
m500238.あれはきっと、古代文明の逸話に出てくる\n「デウスエクスマキナ」に違いありません: That must be the “Deus Ex Machina” mentioned in the ancient civilization's legends...!
m500238.えっ、つまりあいつ、\nあの巨体全部を、コアから供給される\nエネルギーだけで動: Wait, so it's moving that entire bulk solely on energy supplied from its core?
m500238.えっと、赤い機械が物理障壁、\n青い機械が魔法障壁でしたよね……。: Um, the red machine was the physical barrier, the blue one the magical barrier, right…?
m500238.おそらくな！\n王子、魔術師や魔法剣士の力を借りるんだ！\nわざわざ向こうの得意:
Probably!
Prince, call in the mages and magic swordsmen!
No need to fight it on its own turf!
m500238.お願いです、王子の旦那っ！\nあたしの故郷を、鋼の都を助けてください……！！: Please, Prince! Help my hometown, the Steel City...!!
m500238.これが本当なら、鋼の街を取り戻す前に、\n鋼の街が粉々になっちゃいますよぅ……。: If that's true, before we can save the Steel City, it'll be shattered to pieces... I never imagined the legendary weapon actually existed...
m500238.しかもあの赤い機械自身は、\nより強力な刃も矢も通らねぇ障壁を展開してやがる。\:
And that red machine itself has deployed a barrier that even the strongest blades and arrows can't pierce.
What kind of tech is that—unbelievable…!!
m500238.そのとおりですっ！\n王子の旦那、鋼の都の未来のため、\nデウスエクスマキナをぶ: Exactly! Prince, for the future of the Steel City, please crush the Deus Ex Machina!!
m500238.その理不尽なまでの戦力から、\n機械仕掛けの神を意味する名を付けられた、\n鋼の: Because of its absurd firepower, it's been given a name meaning a mechanical god—a legendary ancient weapon passed down in the Steel City...!!
m500238.それが、目撃者の話によれば、不意に装置が発光し、\n周囲のありとあらゆる物を引き: Witnesses say it suddenly lit up, pulling in everything around it and transforming into a massive weapon.
m500238.それじゃあ早速、この図面をみてください。\nこの辺り……そう、この大砲には注意が: Now, take a look at these schematics. Around here... right, you need to watch out for this cannon. That weapon is equipped with two powerful guns!
m500238.ただ、奴の構造体は、自身のエネルギー量に\n耐えきれていないらしい。\n放ってお: But its structure can't withstand its own energy levels. If we leave it alone, it might self-destruct, you know?
m500238.だ、だめですよ！\n街の中で自爆したら大変なことになっちゃいます！！: N-no! If it self-detonates in the city, that'll be disastrous!!
m500238.だ、大爆発でしたね……。\nでもこれで勝ったんですよね？\nあたし達の勝ちってこ:
That… was a massive explosion, huh….
But we won, right? That means we won, right?!
m500238.ってボリスさん！\nまだ近付いたら危ないですよぅ！？:
Hey, Boris!
It's still dangerous if we get any closer!?!
m500238.な、何あの赤いやつ！\nデウスエクスマキナにも\n周囲の警備機械にも攻撃が通じな:
W-what's that red thing!
Neither the Deus Ex Machina nor the surrounding guard machines are taking any damage!
m500238.まぁいいさ、どちらにせよこいつの調査が必要だ。\nコアの捜索含め、後始末は俺様達:
Whatever, we need to investigate this thing either way.
Leave the cleanup, including the core search, to us.
m500238.まさか、あの赤いコアを持つ機械、\n物理的な防御機構を強化しているのか？: Could that red-core machine be reinforcing its physical defenses?
m500238.まさか、機械技術で\n魔法障壁を再現したとでもいうのか！？\n古代の技術ってのも:
Could it be they've recreated a magical barrier with machine tech!?
Ancient technology is really pulling a fast one…
m500238.まともに正面から止められる相手ではありません！\n至急、進路上の兵には一旦退避頂: It's not an opponent we can stop head-on! All troops on the path, withdraw for now! Prince, is that alright?
m500238.むむむ……。\n勝ったのはいいけど、ちょっと気になるね。:
Hm…
Winning's great, but it's a little unsettling.
m500238.やれやれ、古代の遺産なんて関わるもんじゃないぜ。\nさぁて、どれどれ中身を拝むと:
Good grief, ancient relics are nothing to mess with.
Alright, let's see what's inside.
m500238.デウスエクスマキナ、沈黙しました……！！: The Deus Ex Machina has gone silent…!!
m500238.デウスエクスマキナを破壊次第、\nとにかく急いで退避した方が良さそうですねぇ……: Once we destroy the Deus Ex Machina, we should evacuate immediately...
m500238.事件の発端は、鋼の都郊外の研究施設でした。\nその施設では古代文明の遺物と思われ: The incident started at a research facility on the outskirts of the Steel City. They'd been studying a device thought to be an artifact of the ancient civilization for years...
m500238.二重の防御機械に守られた\n古代兵器デウスエクスマキナ、ですか……。\n王子、慎:
An ancient weapon, the Deus Ex Machina, protected by double-layered defense machines…
Prince, please command carefully…!!
m500238.今やその装置は、周囲の建造物までをも取り込み、\n巨大な兵器となってしまっている: Now that device is absorbing even the surrounding buildings, turning into a gigantic weapon.
m500238.伝説によれば、デウスエクスマキナのコアは、\n周囲の物質を取り込み、時に山よりも: Legend says the core of the Deus Ex Machina absorbs surrounding matter, growing into a colossal mass bigger than a mountain, and it wouldn't stop until everything was destroyed...
m500238.分かりました。お願いしますね。\nそれでは王子、我々は先に撤収しましょう。\nデ:
Understood. We'll take care of it.
Then Prince, we'll withdraw first.
Thanks for the Deus Ex Machina defeat—well done!
m500238.大丈夫だ、もうあの膨大なエネルギーは……。\nいや待て、あまりに残留エネルギーが:
It's fine, that massive energy is….
Wait, actually the residual energy is way too low.
m500238.実は、古代文明の巨大兵器が復活して、\n鋼の都で暴走しているんです……っ！！: Actually, an ancient civilization's massive weapon has reawakened and is rampaging through the Steel City...!!
m500238.崩壊じゃない……あれは、変形だ……ッ！！\nあんなデカブツと激突したら潰されちま: It's not collapsing... it's transforming...!! If we clash with something that huge, we'll get crushed!
m500238.更に、デウスエクスマキナは、\n鋼の都の警備機械群の制御を奪い、\nその配下につ: Furthermore, the Deus Ex Machina will seize control of the Steel City's guard machines and put them under its command.
m500238.爆風で吹き飛んじゃったのかな？: Did the blast blow it away?
m500238.物理的な、防御機構……？\nえぇっとつまり……魔法なら効くってことですね！？:
Physical defenses…?
So… magic might work, right!?
m500238.王子、あの砲への対処は、\n私達みたいな重装備の前衛に適宜指示を出してくれ。: Prince, give orders to heavy-armored frontliners like us on how to deal with that cannon.
m500238.王子、あの青いコアの機械がいる限り、\nデウスエクスマキナには\n魔法が効かない: Prince, as long as that blue-core machine is around, we can assume magic won't affect the Deus Ex Machina.
m500238.王子の旦那っ、王国のみんなっ、\nほんっとーにありがとうございましたぁ！:
To Prince's man, to everyone in the kingdom—
thank you so, so much!!
m500238.王子の旦那っ！\nあれがデウスエクスマキナです……！: Prince! That's the Deus Ex Machina...!
m500238.王子の旦那ー！ 大変！ 大変なんですよー！\nあたしの故郷がっ、鋼の都が大変なこ: Prince! It's terrible! It's really terrible! My hometown, the Steel City, is in a dire situation! If this keeps up, the city will be smashed to pieces!
m500238.王子の旦那！\n今度は青いコアの機械が出てきましたよ！！:
Prince's man!
Now a blue-core machine has appeared!!
m500238.研究所の元所員の話によると、\nその装置は、莫大なエネルギーを持つコト以外、\n: According to a former researcher, the device is an unknown object with only one thing known: it holds an enormous amount of energy.
m500238.砲の対処と、警備機械の対処、\nどちらもこの戦いには不可欠です。\n王子の旦那、: Dealing with the cannon and the guard machines are both essential to this battle. Prince, please command carefully...!
m500238.突き出しているのが、例の２門の砲か……。\n確かにあの口径の砲は、\n生半可な装: That's the two-barrel cannon sticking out... Indeed, a gun of that caliber can't be handled with mediocre gear.
m500238.難しいこたぁ考えるな。\n逆の特性で殴ってやれば弱点になるってことだ。\n両方破: Don't overthink it. Hitting it with the opposite property will hit its weak point. Destroy both and the damage should reach the core!

m500360.――ファイブ、お前らしくもないな。\nこんな派手なシノギに手を出すとは。:
――Five, this is uncharacteristic of you.
Taking on such a flashy job.
m500360.――ファイブ様、魔神が目を覚ましたようです。: ――Master Five, it seems the Demon God has awakened.
m500360.――モラクスの鎧が砕けたぞ！\nどれ、噂の宝石の盾を拝んでやろうじゃないか。:
――Morax's armor is shattered!
Well then, let's take a look at that famous Gem Shield.
m500360.――王子、至急お耳に入れたいことが。\n闇の組織の動向に関する情報です。: —Prince, there's something I need to tell you right away. It's information about the Dark Organization's movements.
m500360.――魔神モラクスの魔力反応、急速に低下していきます！\nやった！ ボクらの勝利で:
――Morax's magical energy signature is dropping rapidly!
We did it! This is our victory!!
m500360.……そう簡単に逃がすと思うか？: ……Do you think we'll let you escape that easily?
m500360.……強大な魔力反応といい、\n宝石鉱山という場所といい、\nただのおとぎ話だとは: ...Between the powerful magical reaction and the location being the gemstone mine, I can't believe this is just a fairy tale.
m500360.……捨て駒とは、殊勝な心がけだな。\nファイブめ、上手く部下を飼いならしたか。:
……Sacrificial pawns, huh. A noble sentiment.
So you've managed to tame your subordinates, Five.
m500360.あぁ……これはゴーレム技師の間では\n結構有名なおとぎ話なんです。: Ah... it's actually quite a well-known story among Golem Engineers.
m500360.あの宝石鉱山周辺で、\nそれほどの強大な存在が\n封印されたという話は聞いたこと: I've never heard of a being that powerful being sealed around the gemstone mine...
m500360.いいえ、むしろ魔術師たちによれば、\nこの反応は何らかの\n「封印」が解除されつ: No, quite the opposite. According to the mages, this reaction is a sign that some kind of "seal" is beginning to break.
m500360.うっ……たまにはいいだろ、姐さん！: Ugh…… let me off the hook this once, sis!
m500360.えっと、早とちりかもしれないので！\nでも、少しでも力になれたなら嬉しいです♪: Umm, I might be jumping to conclusions! But I'm glad I could be of some help♪
m500360.お前ら……ちっ、命までかけようとするんじゃねぇぞ。\n金儲けは死んだらできねぇん:
You guys…… Tch, don't go throwing your lives away.
You can't make money when you're dead.
m500360.かつての人類の味方、魔神モラクス様の置き土産、か。\nあーあ、そんなありがたい宝:
A parting gift from the Demon God Morax, humanity's former ally, is it.
Ah, well. I suppose we can't just pocket such a valuable gemstone.
m500360.これは……アンリさん、お手柄かもしれませんよ。: This is... perhaps a great find, Anri.
m500360.さて、私たちはまだ仕事があるぞ。\n捕虜には聞きたいことが山ほどあるからな。:
Now then, we still have work to do.
We have a mountain of questions for the prisoners.
m500360.そして、その終焉の地のひとつである、\nとされているのが、宝石鉱山の近くなんです: And one of the places believed to be where they met their end is right near the gemstone mine.
m500360.その魔神は鉱石の鎧をまとっていて、\nあらゆる物理的な力を反射する、\nとても強: This demon god wore armor made of ore, which reflected all physical force. They were incredibly strong and a great ally to humanity.
m500360.それで、その魔神の最期は……？: And how did that demon god's story end?
m500360.ちっ……もう少し削れるかと思ったんだが。\nまぁいい、もう随分と稼がせてもらった:
Tch…… I thought I could squeeze out a bit more.
Well, fine. We've already made a pretty good profit.
m500360.ですが、宝石の魔神はある日、\n強敵との戦いにおいて、鉱石の鎧を砕かれてしまった: But one day, in a battle against a formidable enemy, the demon god's ore armor was shattered.
m500360.では我々も、一度拠点に戻りましょうか。\n王子、此度の魔神討伐、お疲れ様でした！:
Then let's head back to base as well.
Prince, well done on defeating the Demon God!
m500360.ところで……どうして\nそんなおとぎ話をご存知だったのですか？: By the way... how did you know about such a fairy tale?
m500360.どこへともなく、姿を消したそうです。\n暴走し続ける己を止められなかったのでしょ: They are said to have vanished into the unknown. They probably couldn't stop themselves from going berserk. Surely, they did it to protect their comrades from harm...
m500360.は、はいっ！\nさすがファイブ様だ……これと、この原石と……。:
Y-yes, sir!
As expected of Master Five…… This one, and this rough, and……
m500360.ふぃー……。\nったく、ファイブめ面倒な魔神を復活させやがって。:
Phew…….
Damn it. Reviving such a troublesome Demon God.
m500360.へぇ、純粋な力比べをご所望か。\n王子、あの魔神にどう応えるかは任せるよ！:
Hm, so you want a pure test of strength.
Prince, it's up to you how you deal with that Demon God!
m500360.ま、待ってください！ 後を追うのは危険です！\nこの轟音、聞こえませんか！？:
W-wait! It's dangerous to pursue them!
Can't you hear that rumbling?!
m500360.まさか眠り続ける魔神が周囲を侵食し、\n宝石だらけの洞窟を作ってくれてるとはなァ:
Who would have thought a sleeping Demon God would erode its surroundings
and create a cave full of gems for us.
m500360.まったくです。\n――ですが、この鉱山は使えますね。:
Truly.
――But, we can make use of this mine.
m500360.もうほとんど結界みたいなものですね……。\nおとぎ話が本当なら、\nあの盾は物理:
It's practically a barrier now……
If the fairy tales are to be believed,
that shield should reflect anything other than physical attacks!
m500360.アイリーン姐さん、今ならまだ追えるけど、どうする？: Sis Irene, we can still catch up now. What do we do?
m500360.ゴーレムの駆動音です！\nそれも一体や二体じゃありません！\nゴーレムの軍団がこ:
It's the sound of Golems powering up!
And not just one or two!
A Golem army is heading this way!
m500360.ゴーレムを従え、千年戦争を戦った宝石の魔神。\nゴーレム技師にとっての、偉大なる: A gemstone demon god who commanded golems and fought in the Millennium War. A great predecessor to us Golem Engineers. Their name was—
m500360.ゴーレムを従え、千年戦争を戦った宝石の魔神でしたか。\nどうやら、ここに眠ってい:
So, the Gem Demon God who commanded the Golems and fought the Millennium War……
It seems the one slumbering here was none other than Morax, the Demon God of the fairy tales.
m500360.ファイブ様、ここは俺たちが引き受けます。\n面倒みてもらった恩義がありますから。:
Master Five, we'll handle this.
We owe you for taking care of us.
m500360.ボ、ボクもついていきます！\nもし本当に魔神モラクスがいるなら、\nゴーレムの専:
W-wait! I'm coming with you!
If Morax is really there, we'll need a Golem expert!
--- scene: Lv.1 (battle, start) ---
m500360.他の幹部には黙っておけよ。\n見逃してやるから、\n撤退開始までありったけ懐に突:
Keep this from the other executives.
I'll let you off the hook, so
stuff as much as you can carry before we retreat.
m500360.兵の配置変更を急ぎましょう。\n王子、迅速な指示をお願いします！:
We need to adjust our troop placement quickly.
Prince, please give your orders swiftly!
--- scene: Lv.2 (battle, route) ---
m500360.千年戦争の折、人間に味方しながらも\n最後には心を失ってしまった魔神がいるという: It's a sad tale about a demon god who fought alongside humanity during the Millennium War, but ultimately lost their heart.
m500360.千年戦争を戦った兵からすれば、\nきっと心強い味方だったのでしょうね。: To the soldiers who fought in the Millennium War, they must have been a reassuring presence.
m500360.小銭稼ぎばかりじゃ儲からなくてな。\n魔神駆除業者も来たことだし、\nこっちは退:
Just picking up small change won't make us rich.
Since the Demon God exterminators are here,
I'll be taking my leave.
m500360.彼らが魔術実験をしている、ということですか？: You mean they're conducting magical experiments?
m500360.心当たりがあるとすれば……。\nあっ、宝石の魔神のおとぎ話がありましたね！: If I had to guess, though... Ah! There was a fairy tale about a gemstone demon god!
m500360.我々の懐も――いえ、\n組織の資金も、これでかなり潤沢になりますね。:
Our pockets―― no, the Organization's funds,
will be quite substantial with this.
m500360.王子、急ぎ迎撃の準備をお願いします。\n敵はゴーレムと――魔神モラクスです！！:
Prince, please prepare for the counterattack immediately.
The enemy is the Golems…… and the Demon God Morax!!
--- scene: Lv.1 (battle, route) ---
m500360.盾……？\nいや待て、なんだあれ、盾が浮いてるぞ！:
The shield……?
Wait, what's that? The shield is floating!
m500360.闇の組織の新たな資金源と目されていた宝石鉱山から、\n未知の、そして極めて強大な: A powerful, unknown magical energy has been detected from the gemstone mine, which was believed to be the Dark Organization's new source of funding.
m500360.魔神は真の姿――物理攻撃以外を反射する、\n宝石の盾を携え、己の心が消え去るまで: The demon god revealed their true form—wielding a gemstone shield that reflected everything except physical attacks—and kept fighting for their comrades until their heart faded away.
m500360.魔神モラクス、ですか……。\nともあれ、闇の組織を放置することはできません。\n:
Morax, the Demon God……
Regardless, we cannot leave the Dark Organization to their own devices.
Prince, let us quickly assemble a unit and head to the gemstone mine!
m500360.魔神モラクスの置き土産、ですね。\nこれだけの巨大な鉱脈であれば、\n各地の復興:
A parting gift from the Demon God Morax, huh.
With a vein this massive,
we could fund the reconstruction efforts everywhere and still have change to spare.
m500360.（……ほらな。噂をすればってやつだ。\nこんな濃厚な殺気を隠しもしねぇとは、\n:
(……There I go. Talk about bad timing.
Irene really has been softening up, hiding a killing intent this thick.)
m500360.（問題は、これだけ派手な目覚め方をした魔神に、\n王国が気付かないはずがないって:
(The problem is, with an awakening this conspicuous,
there's no way the Kingdom hasn't noticed.)

m920009.……ただ気になるのは、呪われた戦士たちは\n理性を失った、戦うだけの存在のはず…: …What concerns me is that cursed warriors should have lost their reason, existing only to fight…
m920009.あなたたちも私たちの仲間に\nなりたいの？: Do you want to become our allies as well?
m920009.この先に鎧の戦士たちが集結しつつあるようです。\n集まりきる前に敵を倒さないと、: Armored warriors are gathering ahead. If we don't defeat them before they fully assemble, things could become irreversible.
m920009.この地に鎧の戦士たちが\n集結しているらしいのですが……。\nどうか気を付けてく: It seems armored warriors have gathered in this land… Please be careful.
m920009.これまでの戦いで魔物の軍勢にいた\n鎧の魔物……。\n彼らは元は人間だったと聞い: In previous battles, there were armored monsters among the demon hordes… I've heard they were once human.
m920009.さあ、我々と死ぬまで、そして\n死んだ後も永遠に戦い続けようぞ……！: Now, let's fight until death, and even after we die, continue battling forever…!
m920009.それが騎士団を名乗り、我々に\n挑戦してくるなんて……。\nなんだか嫌な予感がし: Yet they claim to be a knight order and challenge us… I have a bad feeling about this….
m920009.なかなか手強いな……。\n相手にとって不足はないということか。\n精々、我々を楽: You're quite a handful… So we're evenly matched, I see. At most, just give us a good show.
m920009.まさか我々が追いつめられるとは……。\n愉しい！愉しいぞ！: I never imagined we'd be cornered… Delightful! How delightful!
m920009.ユリナは敵の力を奪う暗黒の波動の\n持ち主……。我々の盟主にふさわしい。: Yurina wields the dark wave that steals the enemy's power… She's fit to be our leader.
m920009.先ほど暗黒騎士団と名乗った戦士も、\nおそらくそのように呪われた戦士の一人なので: The warrior who just called themselves the Dark Knight Order is probably one of those cursed warriors.
m920009.女神の力にすがる弱き者たちに\n戦いを挑むために参った。: We have come to challenge the weak who cling to the goddess's power.
m920009.彼女がいると我々の攻撃力が下がります。\n優先して倒してください。: She weakens our attacks. Take her down first.
m920009.我々を追いかけてきたつもりのようだが\n罠にかかったのは貴様らの方だ: You think you were chasing us, but it's you who fell into a trap.
m920009.我らは永遠の戦いに身を委ねし\n暗黒騎士団である。: We are the Dark Knight Order, devoted to an eternal battle.
m920009.永遠に戦い続けると言われています。: And are said to fight forever.
m920009.王子、あのユリナという者がいると\n私たちの攻撃力が下がるようです。\nお気を付: Prince, that Yurina seems to be lowering our attack power. Please be careful.
m920009.王子、敵が向かってきています！\nあのユリナが出てくるかもしれません。: Prince, the enemy's approaching! Yurina might appear.
m920009.痛い、痛いよお母さん……！\n……私を……捨て、ないで……。: It hurts, it hurts, Mother…! …Don't… abandon me… .
m920009.貴方は人間なのですか？\nそれに、なんだか力が抜けていくような……。: Are you human? And… I feel my strength slipping away…
m920009.長い年月を戦いのみに生き、\n戦いだけが全てとなってしまった人間は\nその命が尽: Humans who have lived only for war for countless years, whose lives revolve around battle, even after their bodies die, their souls inhabit their weapons,

m920040.……はッ！ 私は、今まで何を……。\nくっ、操られてしまっていたのか。\n不覚だ: ……Hah! What have I been doing all this time…? Damn, I was being controlled…! I'm a fool… you damned youkai…!
m920040.……イナリさん。あなたも封印されたいんですか？: ...Inari-san. Do you want to be sealed too?
m920040.……札を渡すつもりがないなら\n力ずくで奪うまでだ……！: ……If you won't hand over the talismans, I'll just take them by force…!
m920040.あぁ、そうだ。すべて私たちが行った。\nぬらりひょんの復活に合わせ、村を襲い、\: Yeah, that's right. We did it all. While Nurarihyon rises, we attacked the village—your coming here was part of the plan.
m920040.あなたたちか。先ほどはすまなかった。\nどうやら不覚にも妖怪に操られていたようだ: You… it's you. Sorry about earlier. Looks like I was unintentionally being controlled by a youkai, but I'm fine now.
m920040.あの妖怪は……、牛鬼だね。\n単体でも強い上に毒の霧をまき散らす、\n妖怪から見: That youkai… It's an Ushioni. Even alone it's strong, and it spreads poisonous mist—troublesome even for other youkai.
m920040.あの巨大な塔は……！\nそれに、辺りに漂うこれは毒の霧でしょうか……。: That massive tower…! And that fog drifting around… is that poison mist?
m920040.あれ、王子？ 何かおっしゃいましたか？\n声が聞こえた気が……。: Huh, Prince? Did you say something? I thought I heard a voice...
m920040.あれー？ ……あっ、思い出した！\n彼女って確か……、封妖の忍者とかって\n妖怪: Huh? …Oh, I remember! She's that… sealing-ninja, right? A ninja who specializes in exterminating youkai.
m920040.あんたたちなら妖怪の総大将の復活を\n阻止できるかもね。: You might actually be able to stop the great youkai commander's resurrection.
m920040.あんたも忍者……。\n封印の札を剥がしたのはあんたたち？: You're a ninja too… Did you strip the sealing talismans?
m920040.うっそだよーん。驚いた？ \nやっぱり人間を驚かすのは楽しいなぁ♪: Gotcha! Surprised? I still love startling humans ♪
m920040.うん。さっきの戦いで何か妙な気を感じたんだ。: Yeah. I sensed something odd during the fight.
m920040.うんうん。\n一度、戦った間柄こそ分かりあえるって事だね。\nよろしくね。ナギち: Yeah, yeah. Once we've fought side by side, we can understand each other. Nice to meet you, Nagi-chan!
m920040.おぉ。人間どもか。\n復活の肩慣らしには丁度良い。:
Ah, humans, huh.
A perfect warm-up for my revival.
m920040.おそらく魔物たちはあの要石を破壊して\nぬらりひょんを復活させる気です。: They're probably trying to destroy that stone to revive Nurarihyon.
m920040.お前たちをここで倒せば\n私たちの目的は達成される。覚悟しろ！: If we take you down here, our goal's achieved. Brace yourself!
m920040.お前たちを倒し、その封印の札も\nまとめて処分してやるかのぅ……！\nさぁ、妖怪: I'll crush you and destroy those sealing talismans at the same time...! Come, monsters. Let's begin the assault...!
m920040.お前はあの時の……！\nここで何をしている！: You're… that person from back then! What are you doing here?!
m920040.ここが妖怪たちとその総大将、「ぬらりひょん」が\n封印されている洞窟だよん。: This is the cave where the youkai and their commander, Nurarihyon, are sealed.
m920040.ここだねー。\n要石があるということは、封印はまだ\n解かれていないみたい。:
Here it is.
Since the sealing stone is still here, the seal hasn't been broken yet.
m920040.このまま封印を解かせるわけには\nいきません。王子、急ぎ戦闘の準備を！:
We can't let the seal be broken.
Prince, let's hurry and prepare for battle!
m920040.この村を襲う妖怪たちを追い払うことは\nできましたが、手強い敵でしたね。: We drove the youkai off this village, but they were a tough opponent.
m920040.これは逃げられたかな。\nどうやら妖怪たちを連れて、\n洞窟から出ていったみたい:
Looks like he got away.
He seems to have taken the youkai and left the cave.
m920040.こんな時に……。\nぬらりひょんは偵察兵に追わせて、\n私たちは村の人たちを守り:
At a time like this...
Let the scouts chase Nurarihyon while we protect the villagers!
m920040.さあさあ、そんなことよりさ\n彼女は都の中心部に行ったようだよ。: Anyway, more importantly, she's headed for the city's center.
m920040.しかし、私一人ではぬらりひょんを\n倒す事は難しい……。\nどうか、一緒に戦って: But I can't defeat Nurarihyon alone… Would you fight alongside me?
m920040.そういえば、さっき村を襲っていた忍者が\n封印の札を持っているのを見つけたよ。: Come to think of it, I saw a ninja who was raiding the village holding the talisman.
m920040.そうそう。このまま復活したら\n多くの人間が襲われるんじゃないかな。: Yeah, that's right. If he comes back, a lot of humans will get attacked.
m920040.それにこの毒の霧、牛鬼も攻めてくる……。\n気をつけて……。: And this poisonous fog— even the Ushioni are charging in... Stay on guard...
m920040.それに封妖の忍者は妖怪たちの中では有名だよ。\n妖怪にとっては天敵みたいな物だか: Besides, the sealing-ninja is famous among us youkai. To us, she's like a natural enemy.
m920040.ただ、急がなきゃね。お札が剥がされている以上、\n復活まで時間はないんじゃないか: But we have to hurry. Since the talisman's already been peeled off, there isn't much time before they revive.
m920040.だが、各地に散らばった封印の札を集めて、\n封妖の力を高める必要がある。: But we still need to gather the scattered sealing talismans and strengthen the sealing power.
m920040.だけど、妖怪の総大将が復活しちゃったら\n多くの人間たちが犠牲になる。: But if the great youkai commander revives, many humans will become casualties.
m920040.って、なぜナギさんの事を知っているんですか？: Wait, how do you know about Nagi-san?
m920040.つまりはやつを倒せば、妖怪たちの戦闘力を\n抑えることができるってこと。\n最優: In other words, if we take him down, we can suppress the monsters' strength. Target him first, that might be best.
m920040.な…なるほど……。理由はともかく、\nこのまま放っておいていい問題でもありません:
I see... Regardless of the reason, we can't just leave this problem unchecked.
Prince, let's discuss the details back at the castle.
m920040.なぜそこまでの事情を知っているのですか？\nあなたはいったい……？: How do you know all that? Who exactly are you…?
m920040.なるほど。封印の札を管理している一族を操れば、\n封印の札を剥がすことも容易です: I see. If we control the clan that manages the sealing talismans, removing them becomes easy…
m920040.なんとか勝つことはできましたが……、\nぬらりひょんと妖怪たちの行方が気になりま: We managed to win, but I'm still worried about Nurarihyon and the youkai's whereabouts.
m920040.なんとか妖怪たちを倒すことができました……。: We managed to defeat the monsters...
m920040.なんとか魔物を退けられましたね……。\nこれでひとまず安し……:
We managed to push the monsters back...
For now, that's a relief.
m920040.ぬらりひょんの復活で、強い妖怪も\n現れ始めちゃってるみたいだね。: With Nurarihyon's revival, even stronger youkai are starting to appear.
m920040.ぬらりひょんもそこに\nいるんじゃないかな？\n王子、追いかけよっ！: Nurarihyon's probably there too, right? Prince, let's chase after her!
m920040.ぬらりひょんを倒すという目的のもと\n協力して頂いたんですよ。: We were cooperating under the goal of taking down Nurarihyon, after all.
m920040.ひぃっ！ あの女は地獄耳か！？\n今の状態で見つかれば封印されてしまう……！\n: Hii! Does that woman have hell-ish hearing?! If she finds me now, I'll be sealed... We should make a run for it!
m920040.ふっふっふー。ぬらりひょんがいなくなった今や\nあたしの天下。戦いの後、気を緩め: Heh heh heh— now that Nurarihyon's gone, this is my domain. Letting your guard down after a battle? How naive, humans...
m920040.ま、まずは考える前に行動しなきゃだね。\n忍者たちが封印の札をもっているのなら\: Well, no point thinking about it—let's act. If the ninjas have the talisman, we'll just take it back!
m920040.まぁ、この程度の封印ならば、\n中から破ることなど造作もないがのぉ……。: Well, a seal this weak is no trouble to break from the inside...
m920040.まぁまぁ落ち着きなよ。今は人間たちの味方だよ。\nぬらりひょんは野放しにしたら、: Calm down, calm down. I'm on the humans' side now. If Nurarihyon runs wild, I'll be in trouble too.
m920040.まさか妖狐が人間に協力するなんてな。\n化かされているんではなかろうか。: I never imagined a fox spirit would side with humans. Could we be deceived?
m920040.わかりました。私たちも目的は同じです。\n共に戦いましょう！: Understood. Our goals are the same. Let's fight together!
m920040.んー、あたしって人間を驚かすのが楽しいんだよね。\nむしろそれが生きがいっていう: Hmm, I just love startling humans. It's kind of my purpose, I guess.
m920040.イタズラ妖狐の事は置いておこう……。\n今回の戦いで、倒した妖怪たちは\n再びあ: Let's set aside the mischievous fox… The monsters we defeated today will be sealed back in that cave.
m920040.ヒェッヒェッ。人間どもめ、わしはまだ倒れておらぬ。\nこのぬらりひょん、簡単にく: Heh heh. You humans think I'm down? This Nurarihyon won't go down that easily...!
m920040.ヒョッヒョッ。あやつらが封印の札を\n剥いでくれたおかげで楽に出られたわい。: Heh heh. Thanks to them removing the sealing talisman, I could get out easily.
m920040.人間に危害を加える妖怪を封印したり、\n妖怪が封印されている場所を守ったりしてる: She's supposed to seal away youkai that threaten humans, and guard the places where they're sealed. Those sealing talismans were made by her clan, too.
m920040.今は妖怪総大将のぬらりひょんを\n倒すためにここに立っている。: I'm here now to take down the youkai Grand Marshal, Nurarihyon.
m920040.何かしらの妖怪がとりついているのか……。\n自分の意思で動いているわけではなさそ: Some kind of youkai must have possessed her… She doesn't seem to be acting of her own will.
m920040.偵察兵の報告によると、\nぬらりひょんはこの東の国に行き着いたようです。: Scouts say Nurarihyon's made it to the eastern lands.
m920040.前にいったけど、ぬらりひょんは戦場にいる\n妖怪たちの戦闘力を底上げする力がある: I went ahead, but Nurarihyon can boost the combat power of any monster on the battlefield.
m920040.前に人間を驚かせて遊んでた時、\nあのナギちゃんに退治されそうになったんだ。\n: Back when we were messing around and scaring humans, that Nagi-chan almost got us killed. I managed to trick her and escape♪
m920040.危ない！ 要石からはなれて！: Watch out! Get away from the stone!
m920040.同じ妖怪だからね！\nあたし、妖狐のイナリって名前なの。\n妖怪って聞いたことく: Because I'm a youkai too! I'm Inari, the fox youkai. You've at least heard of youkai, right?
m920040.報告します！ 先ほどぬらりひょんと妖怪たちの\n侵攻先が判明しました！: Report! We've just pinpointed Nurarihyon's and the youkai's invasion target!
m920040.報告！ この先の村が妖怪に\n襲われているとのことです！: Report! The village ahead is under youkai attack!
m920040.報告！ 今しがた近くの村が\n忍者の一団に襲われているとの\n情報が入りました！: Report! We've just received word that a nearby village is being attacked by a group of ninjas!
m920040.妖怪が封印されている洞窟……。\n何が起こるかわかりません。\n王子、お気を付け:
A cave sealed with youkai... Who knows what might happen.
Prince, stay careful.
m920040.妖怪たちが封印されている洞窟に案内するよ。\nあたしについて来て！: I'll lead you to the cave where the youkai are sealed. Follow me!
m920040.妖怪たちよ……。人間どもを恐怖の\nどん底に突き落としてしまえ。\n暴れるのじゃ:
Youkai... Cast the humans into the depths of terror.
Rampage!
m920040.妖怪に襲われている人々を放ってはおけません。\n王子、応戦いたしましょう！: We can't just leave those people to the youkai. Prince, let's engage!
m920040.妖怪の総大将……ですか？: The great youkai commander… you say?
m920040.妖怪の総大将ぬらりひょんと妖怪たちは\nある洞窟の中に封印されているんだけど、\: The great commander of the youkai, Nurarihyon, and his minions are sealed inside a cave, but the sealing talisman is about to be ripped off and the seal will break.
m920040.妖怪は確かに聞いたことはありますが……。\nなぜその同じ妖怪が私たちに警告を？: I've heard of youkai, sure… but why is a youkai warning us?
m920040.安心するのは早いよ？\n魔物がこっちに向かってきてる。:
Don't get complacent yet.
Monsters are heading this way.
m920040.封印の札をどうするおつもりですか？: What do you intend to do with the sealing talismans?
m920040.封印の札を妖怪たちが所有している……。\nおのれ妖怪たちめ、同士が持っていた札を: The monsters are holding the sealing talismans... Damn you yokai, stealing the very seals we need...!
m920040.封印の札を集めて妖怪たちを封印することができれば、\n人間を守れる上にあたしの楽: If we can gather the talismans and reseal the youkai, we'll protect the humans and still have my fun. A real win-win!
m920040.封印を強固なものにするためには\nその札を取り返して封印の力を\n強める必要があ: To reinforce the seal we need to retrieve that talisman and boost its power…
m920040.待っていたぞ。\nお前たちが集めている封印の札、\nそれを渡してもらおう。: I've been waiting. Hand over those sealing talismans you've gathered.
m920040.待っていたぞ王子。\n私はナギ、お前たちはここで討つ……！:
I've been waiting for you, Prince.
I'm Nagi, and you'll meet your end here...!
m920040.待っていますナギさん。\nでは妖怪たちの脅威もなくなったことですし\n王子、戻り: I'll be waiting, Nagi-san. With the monster threat gone, Prince, shall we return?
m920040.復活しちゃったかー……。\nぬらりひょんは戦場にいる妖怪たちの戦闘力を\n底上げ: So he's revived... Nurarihyon can boost the combat power of the youkai on the battlefield, so be careful.
m920040.忍者たちが妖怪の封印を解こうとしているみたいだね。\nでも、なんで人間が妖怪の手: Looks like those ninjas are trying to break the youkai's seal. But why would humans help the youkai?
m920040.忍者たちも姿を消してしまいましたし……。\n人間が妖怪に協力するなんて……。: The ninjas vanished too… Humans cooperating with youkai…
m920040.忍者たちを追い払うとは、なかなかの腕前だねー。: Not bad at all—driving those ninjas away like that.
m920040.我が居城へようこそ人間どもよ。\nわしらを封じる為、わざわざ東の国までご足労\n: Welcome to my castle, humans. You've gone all the way to the Eastern lands to seal us away. Too bad, but you'll meet your end here.
m920040.操られてしまっている今、\nあの子には何を言っても無駄だと思うよ。: Now that she's being controlled, I doubt anything we say will reach that girl.
m920040.村を襲うのをやめてください！\n今、大量の妖怪たちが復活して大変なんです。\n人: Please stop attacking the village! We've got a massive wave of youkai reviving right now—this isn't the time for humans to fight each other!
m920040.来る……。ヤツラが来るよ。: They're coming... They're on their way.
m920040.洞窟の要石の修繕が終わったらその時は王子、\nいつかはあなたの元に……。: Once the cave's keystone is repaired, then, Prince, someday… to you...
m920040.王子、ぬらりひょんは東の国の都に\n根城を構えているという報告を受けました。\n: Prince, we've received word that Nurarihyon's set up a stronghold in the capital of the eastern lands. We must hurry!
m920040.王子、住民たちが忍者に襲われたとの\n報告があった場所です。: Prince, this is the place where we received reports that the villagers were attacked by ninjas.
m920040.王子、敵がこちらに向かってきています。\n住民たちを守るため、反撃いたしましょう: Prince, the enemy's coming toward us. Let's strike back to protect the villagers!
m920040.王子、敵がこちらに向かってきます！: Prince, the enemy's coming this way!
m920040.王子、至急向かいましょう。\nこれ以上、妖怪たちの好きにさせるわけには\n行きま: Prince, we need to head there immediately. We can't let those youkai run wild any longer!
m920040.知れたこと。ぬらりひょん様に献上する。: It's obvious. I'll present them to Lord Nurarihyon.
m920040.驚かせる人間がいなくなっちゃったら\n私は何を生きがいにしたらいいの？\nって訳: If there's no one left to surprise, what would I live for? So I'll help you out.

m920077.――お、シノのやつ、あんなところにいたか。\nおいッ雷神！ ここじゃここじゃ！\: ——Ah, there you are, Shino, over there. Hey, Raijin! Over here, over here! Look, that's Nura-nosh's daughter.
m920077.――おや？\nちょうど妖怪たちが姿を現しましたね。\n王子、彼らの毒には充分お気: —Hmm? The youkai are appearing right now. Prince, please be careful of their poison.
m920077.――がはァッ！？ ば……ばか、な……ッ！！\nこの私が、人間なんぞに不覚を取るな: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: —What…!? You… fool…! How could I, of all beings, be caught off guard by a human…! Guh…!
m920077.――ん？\n何じゃおぬしは？\nどこかで見たことのあるような……？: Hmm? Who might you be? You look familiar...
m920077.――ヒャッハァッ！ こんな所にニンゲンがいるぜ！\nケッケッケェ、どうやって痛め: ――Hyahha! There's a human right here! Hehehe, how shall I hurt them... This is gonna be fun!!
m920077.――勝手な言い草ね。\n戦うことの意味は、あてたちが決すべき事柄よ。: ――How presumptuous. The meaning of battle is something the target must decide.
m920077.――気づかれては仕方がない。\nいや、簡単に気づかれてしまう程に\n我らの力が強: ――We can't help being noticed. Or perhaps our power has grown so strong that we're easily detected… Heh heh.
m920077.……で、ぬらりひょんが私を妖怪と間違えて\nスカウトしに来て大変な事になったって: ……so Nura-nosh's daughter mistook me for a youkai and came to scout me, causing a huge mess. Don't you think that's terribly rude?
m920077.……やはり風神様でしたか。\nお久しぶりですね。覚えていませんか？\n私です。ぬ: ...So it is indeed you, Fujin. Long time no see. Don't you remember? It's me, Shino, the daughter of Nurarihyon.
m920077.……ゲハァッ！！\nシノよ、認めてやろう。\n「血判状」を受け取れ。: ...Gehah! Shino, I acknowledge you. Take the Blood Charter.
m920077.……先行してしまい申し訳ありません、王子。\nですが、この通り酒呑童子の首級は取:
…I'm sorry I went ahead, Prince.
But as you can see, I've taken Shuten-douji's head.
m920077.……機は、熟した。\n決戦の時は近いわよ……。:
…The moment's ripe.
The decisive battle is drawing near.
m920077.……行ってしまいましたね。\nですが、お二人に認めてもらえたようで、\n本当によ: ……They've left. But it seems we've earned their recognition, which is really great!
m920077.……話が早くて助かります。\n父を討った貴方の力が本物かどうか、\n試させて頂き: …You're quick to get to the point, which I appreciate. I'll test whether the power that slew my father is truly yours… Prepare yourself!
m920077.「血判状」とは、その妖怪が\n私の配下になるという事を記した\n誓約書みたいなも: The "Blood Charter" is basically a pledge stating that the monster will become my subordinate.
m920077.あ、あの、シノさん……。\nファーさんはかつてぬらりひょんが封印を解いた\n「仙: Um, Shino… Far was once the “Sengor” that Nura-hyon released from his seal, so he's not a youkai.
m920077.あ、ちょっと待ちなさい！\n……って、行ってしまいました。どうしてでしょう。\n: Ah, wait! …He already left. Why? I made him sign the Blood Charter, yet he disobeys…
m920077.あ、貴方はいったい……？\nもしかして、王子のお知り合いでしょうか？: Ah, who might you be...? Could you be an acquaintance of the Prince?
m920077.ありがとうございます風神様、雷神様！\n本当に、なんとお礼を言っていいのか……。: Thank you, Fujin-sama, Raijin-sama! Truly, I don't know how to thank you…
m920077.あーッ！？\nなんてことしやがるんだっ！！\n妖怪達がみーんなやられちまってるじ: Ahh!? What the heck is this!! All the youkai are getting taken down!?
m920077.いえ、焦って追撃する必要はありません！\n敵が逃走した経路は把握出来ていますから: No, there's no need to rush after them. We've tracked their escape route. Right now, we need to regroup our forces.
m920077.いざとなれば私も王子の盾となりましょう。\nサイゾウ殿に後れをとったりはしません: If push comes to shove, I'll become the Prince's shield. I won't fall behind Saizou!
m920077.ええっ！？ \nぬらりひょんに、娘さんがいたのですか！？\n……ぜ、ぜんぜん似て: What!? Nurarihyon had a daughter?! …She doesn't look anything like him at all.
m920077.おいっ！！ 馬鹿野郎ッ！！\n俺の首も持って行かんかァッ！\nこちとら今は身体が:
Head of Shuten-douji: Hey!! You idiots!!
Don't take my head too!
I've got no body right now, so at least understand that!
m920077.おぉ、本当か……！\nここまでこれたのも、すべて王子のおかげです。\n本当に、感: Oh, really…! We've come this far thanks entirely to you, Prince. I can't thank you enough…
m920077.お前らァ……絶対に許さんぞぉぉぉぉッ……！！: Head of Shuten-douji: You… you'll never——let………………
m920077.くっくっく……見つけましたよ、ぬらりひょんの娘シノ。\n我が配下の妖怪たちが次々: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Heh heh… there you are, Nura-hyon's daughter Shino. I thought my minions had all vanished… Seems the nuisance runs in the family, just like his father.
m920077.くっくっくっ……。: Head of Shuten-douji: Heh heh heh…
m920077.この辺りに、毒を操る妖怪「牛鬼」がいるはずです。\n彼らは、とても凶暴で父上も手: There should be a poison-wielding youkai called “Ushi-oni” around here. They're extremely ferocious; even my father had trouble with them. I hope it goes well…
m920077.これでは、妖怪は魔物と同類に\n成り下がってしまう。: At this rate, yokai will be reduced to the same level as mere monsters.
m920077.これは、ぬらりひょんの刀……。\nシノさんの覚悟、受け取りました。\n王子、まず: This is Nurarihyon's blade… I've received Shino's resolve. Prince, let's hear what she has to say first.
m920077.さて、「血判状」も手に入れることができましたし、\nこれで河童も大人しくなるでし: Well then, we've obtained the Blood Charter, and with that the Kappa should be quiet. So, Prince, let's move on to the next area.
m920077.しかし、凶悪な妖怪の河童が、\nあれ程大人しくなるとは……、\n一体どの様な話を: But for a vicious yokai like the Kappa to become so docile... I wonder what kind of story they're telling.
m920077.すみません。つい力が入りすぎてしまいました。\nしかし、きっちり落とし前だけは\: I'm sorry. I got a bit carried away. But we have to make sure we finish this properly.
m920077.そ、そうだったのですか……！\nすみません。てっきり妖怪かと……。\n……申し訳: I—I see…! I'm sorry. I assumed he was a youkai… My apologies.
m920077.そう……ですね……。\n私は父の想いを継ぎたいだけ……。\n復讐など、意味はない: …I see. I just want to carry on my father's will… Revenge is meaningless…
m920077.そうですね。\nって……あれ……？\nシノさん？ シノさんがいないようですが……: That's right. …Wait, what's that? Shino? She doesn't seem to be here…
m920077.そこで王子に頼みがあります。\n今は空席となっている妖怪の総大将の座に、\n私が: Therefore, Prince, I have a request. Would you aid me in assuming the vacant seat of Great General of the yokai?
m920077.そのような事がバシラさんと父上の間にあったとは……。\nふふっ……妖怪総大将であ: To think something like that happened between you and my father… Heh… Even the Great General of youkai, my father, wasn't immune to mistakes.
m920077.それではファー。\nこれよりは私と行動を共にしなさい。: Then, Far, from now on you'll act alongside me.
m920077.それでは王子、次の妖怪の元へ向かいましょう。: Then, Prince, let's head to the next yokai.
m920077.それでは皆さん。\n我ら妖怪は在るべき場所へと帰ります。\n今度は、妖怪の総大将: Then, everyone, we youkai will return to where we belong. Next time, I'll meet you as the Grand General of the youkai!
m920077.それに、王子も妖怪には手を焼いているのでしょう。\n私が妖怪の総大将になれば、妖: Besides, you must be struggling with the yokai yourself. If I become Great General, I can ensure that a portion of them won't trouble humanity.
m920077.そんなに強い妖怪という事は、\n彼らを配下にできれば、\n妖怪の総大将にまた一歩: If those monsters are that strong, then making them our allies would bring us one step closer to the Supreme Commander of the youkai!
m920077.そんなに難しく考える必要はありません。\n相手を動けない程度に痛めつけて、\nこ: There's no need to overthink it. Just hurt them enough that they can't move, and have them sign this "Blood Charter."
m920077.だからこそ、統制を失った妖怪達に\n今一度秩序をもたらす役目は、\n自分が担うし: That is why I believe it falls to me to restore order to the wayward yokai.
m920077.だといいのですが……。\n: I wish that were the case…
m920077.ったく、妖怪ってのは何奴も此奴も馬鹿ばっかりだぜ。\n俺に敵うわきゃねえのに正面:
Damn it, you yokai are all idiots.
You come at me head-on even though you can't match me…
I'll kill you just like that old fool…
m920077.ついに見つけたぞ……酒呑童子。\n今こそ、父の無念、晴らさせてもらう……。:
At last I've found you… Shuten-douji.
Now I'll fulfill my father's unresolved grudge…
m920077.つまり、相手に恐怖心を抱かせなくては\nいけないという事ですね……。: In other words, we have to make the opponent feel fear… got it.
m920077.ですが、まだ気を抜くことはできません。\n王子、しばしの休息の後、\n次の地へと: But we can't let our guard down yet. Prince, after a short rest, let's head to the next area.
m920077.ですが、父上が死んだと分かった途端、\n多くの妖怪が縄張り争いを始め、\n好き勝: But the moment word spread of my father's death, many yokai began fighting over territories, threatening humans at will and committing ever greater atrocities.

m920077.はい。\n風神様も、どうかお達者で。: Yes. Please stay well, Lord Fujin.

m920077.ほう……。\nどうやら我らが体内に魔神アガレスの残片を\n取り込んだことを察して: ――I see… It seems they've realized we've absorbed a fragment of the demon god Agares.

m920077.まあ、名乗ったところで意味はありませんがね……。: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Well, introducing myself won't change anything…

m920077.また河童でござるか。\n放っておいては港町の人々が危険でござる。: Another Kappa, huh? If we ignore it, the townsfolk will be in danger.

m920077.やっぱりシノさんって、ぬらりひょんの娘ですね……。\nとりあえず、天狗の血判状は: So Shino really is Nura-hyon's daughter… We've got the Tengu's blood charter, so let's shake it off and head to the next area!
m920077.よかった……。\nどうやら刀を収めてくれたようですね。: That's a relief… It seems you've sheathed your sword.

Huh…!?

G…Aa…Aa…

m920077.ゲハハハハハ！\nこのわしと雷神を退けるとはさすがじゃのう！: Gehahahaha! To drive back me and Raijin, that's impressive!
m920077.ゲハハハハハ！\nそうだ！ もっと人間を恐怖させろ！\n殺してしまっても構わんぞ: Gehahaha! That's right! Spread more fear among humans! I don't mind killing them!

Shino!!
…Thank goodness, you seem to be okay.

m920077.シノ殿、これ以上はさすがに可哀想かと……。: Lady Shino, I think it's cruel to push them any further...

Head of Shuten-douji: Damn…

Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: H-hii…!?

H-Huh…!

m920077.人間と妖怪の隔たりはあるにせよ、恩義に報いぬは\n一族の恥……。王子、今後なにか: Even though there's a gap between humans and youkai, failing to repay a debt would disgrace our clan… Prince, if you ever need help, please rely on me.

m920077.今回、手合わせを願ったのは、\n父上を討った貴方に、頼みごとがあり、\nその力量: This time, I asked for a duel because I have a request for you, the one who defeated my father, and I wanted to gauge your strength.

We'll retreat… for now.

m920077.妖怪は他者からの恐怖心を糧として生きています。\nもし、自身に恐怖を抱かせる相手: Yokai survive on the fear others feel toward them. If someone inspires fear in them, they'll instinctively gather around that person.

m920077.後は、鬼の残党を退治すれば終わりです。\n王子、どうか最後まで貴方の力をお貸し下:
Now we just need to wipe out the remaining demons.
Prince, please lend me your strength until the end!

m920077.我が父上が亡くなった今、\n東の国に存在する妖怪たちは、\n妖怪の総大将を失い、: Now that my father has passed, the yokai that inhabit the East have lost their Great General and are without direction.
m920077.改めまして、私の名はシノ。\n妖怪の総大将ぬらりひょんの娘です。: Allow me to introduce myself—my name is Shino, daughter of the Great General of Yokai, Nurarihyon.
m920077.早速、河童が村で暴れているようですね。\n王子、「血判状」を書かせに行きましょう: Looks like the Kappa's already causing trouble in the village. Prince, let's go get that Blood Charter signed.
