m920077.早速現れたようですね。\nしかし、夜闇とは忍には丁度良い……。\n拙者の姿を捉え: Looks like it showed up right away. But the night darkness is perfect for a ninja… they'll never be able to catch sight of me.
m920077.最初からそうしていれば、\n怪我をせずに済んだものを。\n貴様ら河童は、父上が定: If you'd done that from the start, you could've avoided injury. Kappa, return to the territory my father set for you!
m920077.本当に「血判状」を書かせたら、\n大人しくなりましたね。\n……力ずくで言う事を: Once you made them sign the Blood Charter, they really did settle down... Though it does look like we forced them into it.
m920077.東の国の現状を貴方はどこまでご存じでしょうか？: How much do you know about the current state of the Eastern Kingdom?
m920077.次はいったいどのような妖怪に\n血判状をもらいにいくのでしょうか？: I wonder what kind of youkai we'll be getting a Blood Charter from next?
m920077.無様……だと？\nそうか、貴様たちが父上を……ッ！！\n許さない……貴様ら鬼だけ: Disgraceful…? So you were the ones who…!! I won't forgive you… I'll never forgive you demons!
m920077.父の無念、だとぉ？\n……その妖気は……そうか！？ \nお前、ぬらりひょんの娘だ:
My father's grudge, you say?
…That aura… I see!?
You're the daughter of Nurarihyon, aren't you?
m920077.王子……さすがの強さだな。\n魔神アガレスの力をもってしても\n倒せないとは……: Prince… your strength is truly unmatched. Even with Agares' power, we couldn't fell you…
m920077.王子、これは風神様と雷神様から\n共に認めてもらう絶好の機会となりましょう。\n: Prince, this is a perfect chance to earn the approval of both Fujin and Raijin. Please hurry and prepare for battle.

m920077.王子、ぬらりひょんの娘が向かってきます！\n兵の報告では、少数ですが妖怪も従えて: Prince, Shino's daughter is approaching! The troops report she's accompanied by a few yokai. Don't let your guard down!

Prince, hurry, let's chase Shino!

Prince, give the kappas a decent beating.
I'll go persuade the kappa chief nearby.
m920077.王子、貴方に頼むのはただ一つのことだけです。: Prince, I have only one request of you.
m920077.王子！ 港町が河童に襲われています！: Prince! The port town is under attack by Kappa!
m920077.理解したところで、時既に遅しッ！\n我ら鬼刃衆と魔神の力、しかとその身に刻むがい: Even if you understand, it's already too late! Let the power of us Oni Blade Squad and the demon be etched into your very being!
m920077.私の為に、風神様が……？\nああ、なんたる幸甚でしょうか。: For my sake, Fujin-sama…? Ah, how fortunate!
m920077.私はかつての妖怪の総大将である\nぬらりひょんの娘です。: I am the daughter of Nurarihyon, the former Great General of the yokai.
m920077.私はぬらりひょんの血を引く娘、シノ。\nこの度は、父であるぬらりひょんの遺志を継: I am Shino, daughter of Nurarihyon's blood. I have come before the Prince to fulfill my father's dying wish.
m920077.私はまだ妖怪総大将の器ではありませんが、\n人間と話をする事は出来ます。\n目的: I'm not yet worthy of the title, but I can converse with humans. I won't question the means for my goal.
m920077.私は重水の四天王にして、\n酒呑童子様の忠実な僕にございます……くっくっく。: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: I am one of the Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water, a loyal servant of Lord Shuten-Dōji… heh heh.
m920077.私達妖怪は人間がいないと\n生きていけませぬ故、総大将となった者が、\n無暗に人: We yokai cannot survive without humans, so the one who becomes Great General keeps us from slaughtering people indiscriminately.
m920077.空を飛ぶ物の怪ですか。\nならば、拙者の手裏剣で、平伏させてみせましょう。\n王: Is it a monster that flies in the sky? Then I'll make it bow down with my shuriken. I won't let the Prince lay a finger on it.
m920077.致命傷を与えたのは間違いないと思います。\n身体のみの酒呑童子は明らかに弱ってい: I'm sure we dealt a fatal blow. The body-only Shuten-douji was clearly weakening… And now, with just a head, he can't do anything.
m920077.行きましょう、バシラさん！\n私たち妖怪の未来の為にッ！: Let's go, Bashira! For the future of our youkai!
m920077.話合いができるよう、\n血気盛んな妖怪たちを\n痛めつけて大人しくさせてほしいの: To make the talks possible, I need you to subdue the hot-blooded yokai, keeping them quiet.
m920077.話術……ということは話合いですかぁ。\nぬらりひょんは、何だかんだで、\n地道な: Persuasion, huh? So it's a negotiation. Nurarihyon, after all, rose to power through steady effort.
m920077.貴様……いったい何者だッ！？: You… who the hell are you!?
m920077.貴様の覚悟がどれほどのものか、\n今ここで見せてもらおうぞ！: Let's see just how resolute you are, right here!
m920077.道のりは険しいかとは思うが、お主なら\n妖怪総大将の地位、十分に務まるとわしは思: The road ahead will be tough, but I think you can fully live up to the position of Great General of youkai. Stay safe, Shino. Gehahaha!
m920077.道中の案内と妖怪たちへの交渉は私がやります。: I'll handle the travel and the negotiations with the yokai.

We took the Head of Shuten-douji…
We did stop them for now, but… sorry about that.
m920077.重水の四天王が逃げていきます！\n追撃しますか……？: The Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water is fleeing! Shall we give chase…?
m920077.頼もう！\nこの国の主である王子を尋ねに参りました。\n誰か、話の出来る者はおり: I beg of you! I have come to seek the Prince, ruler of this land. Is there anyone here who can speak with me?
m920077.風神様……。\nかまいたちまで……！？\nありがとうございます。: Lord Fujin... even the Kamaitachi...? Thank you.
m920077.風神様に……それに、雷神様までッ！？\nどうしてこのような場所に？: Fujin-sama… and even Raijin-sama!? Why are we in a place like this?
m920077.首を落とした程度で、\n俺を殺したつもりかぁぁぁッ！？:
Head of Shuten-douji: Just because you've cut off my head…
You think you've killed me!?
m920077.鬼たちが退いていきます……。\n何とか、勝てたようですね。:
The demons are pulling back…
Looks like we managed to win after all.
m920077.鬼に謀られたとはいえ、\n結果的にぬらりひょんに最期手を下したのは拙者たち。\n: Even though we were deceived by demons, it was us who ultimately put an end to Nurarihyon. Are you seeking revenge?
m920077.鬼刃姫様ッ！\n今の戦い、ご覧になっていたのですか？: Oni Blade Princess! Were you watching the fight just now?
m920077.魔神アガレスの残片！？\nということは、まさか……！: A fragment of Agares!? That means…!
m920077.（ここが父上を討った者の住む地ですね。\n我が願い……必ずや聞き入れてもらう……: (So this is the land of the one who slew my father… My wish… will surely be granted…!)

m920082.――うぅむ……。\n天狗の神通力による幻惑であろう。\n天狗は魔法の様な不思議な: —Hmm… It must be the Tengu's shintō power creating an illusion. Tengu wield a strange, almost magical force.
m920082.――おお！？ 灯篭がこんなにも綺麗に……ッ！\nアオバ、腕をあげたな。これならば: —Whoa!? The lanterns look this clean…! Aoba, you've really improved. No complaints here. Very well, let's begin today's training!
m920082.――くっ、万事休すか……。\n志半ばで命を散らすことになるとは……。\nむ、無念: ――Damn, everything's falling apart… To die before I've finished my mission… How frustrating…
m920082.――くッ、急に熱波が……これも、コノハ様の力、なの？: —Whoa, a sudden heat wave… Is this also Lady Konoha's power?
m920082.――こ、これはッ……印可状！！\nコノハ様に真に認められたからこそ受け取れる証…: —Th-this is… a Certification!! A proof that I've truly been recognized by Lady Konoha… I'm more moved than ever!
m920082.――だが勘違いするでないぞ？\n今の其方の武技では鬼共の精強な身体を\n滅する事: —But don't get the wrong idea. With your current technique you still can't defeat the mighty bodies of demons.
m920082.――ほ、報告ッ！\n霧が発生していて前線が混乱しています！\nそれに、天狗も現れ: —Report! Fog has rolled in and the front lines are in chaos! And the tengu have appeared!
m920082.――むっ！！ 待て、アオバ……！\nこの妖気は……なるほど、餓鬼か。: —Hold it!! Aoba… This evil aura… I see, it's a hungry spirit.
m920082.――むっ！？ なぜこの様な場所に人間たちが！？\nそれに茨木童子様まで……！: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: —Wha! Why are humans in a place like this? And even Ibaraki-doji himself…!
m920082.――むむっ。\n神通力で心を操られているのか……。\n姿を変えた上に心まで操ると: ――Hmm. Manipulated by divine power, are they… To change form and even control minds… You must be a high-rank youkai!
m920082.――むッ！？\nあの少女は……？ 背に……羽がある！？\nまさか、あの方こそが探: —Huh! That girl…? She has wings on her back!? Could she be the very Tengu I've been seeking!
m920082.――ん？ 彼奴らはいったい？\n……ほう、どうやら人間のようだな。\n斯様な場所: ???: Huh? Who are those…? …Hmm, they seem human. It's rare to see people in a place like this.
m920082.――グッ、ぅ……\nなんという事だ。\n我ら四天王と渡り合うとは……。: …Guh… what a surprise. To clash with the Four Heavenly Kings themselves…
m920082.――ハァ……ハァ……キバヒメ……サ、マ……。\n我ラハ……オニ……トナッテシマ…: —Haa… haa… Kibahime… we… we've become… demons… Please… don't abandon us…
m920082.――報告ッ！\n山道より魔物が出現！: —Report! Monsters have appeared on the mountain path!
m920082.――止せ！\n無闇な追伐にて命を散らす気か！？: —Stop! Do you intend to waste your lives on a reckless hunt!?
m920082.――鬼刃衆！？\nよかった……みんな生きてたのね！\nもう、あてがどれだけ心配し: —Oni Blade Squad!? Thank goodness… everyone's alive! I was so worried about Atei—how much I worried—.
m920082.…………もう、掃除なんてしたくありません！！\n一体いつになったら、\n私に稽古: …I don't want to clean anymore!! When will you finally give me some training?
m920082.…………キバヒメ……酒呑童子様ヲ阻ム者……。\n其ノ悉ク……我ラガ……\n酒呑童: ……Kibahime… those who oppose Shuten-dōji… All of them… we… With Shuten-dōji's power… we shall be destroyed… Prepare yourselves…
m920082.……あ、れ？ ヘンです。銃が、軽い……？\nいや、身体も同じ……まるで羽が生えた: …Huh? Something's weird. My gun feels light…? My body too… It's like I've grown wings! Even though I've only been doing chores…
m920082.……え？\n王子の仲間の中に天狗山の場所を\n知っている方が見つかったのですか！: …What? One of the Prince's companions actually knows the location of Tengu Mountain!?
m920082.……くっくっく。\n天狗と人が手を取り合うとは、実に面白い。\nいいでしょう、こ: Heh heh heh. Humans and Tengu joining forces—how amusing. Very well, I'll finish them all here.
m920082.……そうかもしれぬ。\nそれに、天狗は、自らの気配を断ち切る事もできる。\n拙僧: …Perhaps. Moreover, Tengu can cut off their own presence. They might be watching us from nearby….
m920082.……ふむ。\nアオバのやつ、掃除はきちんとやっておるかの？\nどれ、そろそろ確認: …Hmm. Is Aoba actually keeping up with the cleaning? Let's see… I suppose it's time to check on her—
m920082.……むぅ。あれは人間か。\n天狗山には古より天狗一派の物の怪しか\nおらんかった: …Hmm. Those are humans. I don't recall any Tengu-folk haunting this mountain for ages. What shall we do?
m920082.……コノハ様。はいッ、有り難う御座います！\n貴方様から教えて頂いた全ては私の生: ……Lady Konoha. Yes, thank you! Everything you taught me will be a treasure for my whole life. I won't become complacent—I'll defeat the Shuten-doji!
m920082.……全てを一人で抱え込まないで下さい。\n今は私たちも、鬼刃姫さんの味方なのです: …Don't try to shoulder everything alone. We're on your side, too.
m920082.……実は私は妖怪退治を専門とする狙撃手でして。\n故郷の村を滅ぼした仇敵を討つべ: …Actually, I'm a sniper who specializes in exterminating youkai. I came here to train on the mountain where the tengu dwell, seeking revenge against the foe that destroyed my home village…
m920082.……逃げられてしまいましたか。\nですが、十分な戦果を得ることができました。\n: …They got away, huh? Still, we secured a solid victory. Overwhelming the Four Heavenly Kings will boost our confidence.
m920082.あ、コノハ様！ すみません、時間がかかってしまって。\nですが、きちんと汚れを落: Ah, Lady Konoha! I'm sorry it took so long, but I've made sure everything's spotless!
m920082.ああ。酒呑童子率いる鬼の一族は天狗にとっても、\nやっかいな存在だ。其方らが善戦: Yeah. The demon clan led by Shuten-doji is a thorn even for us Tengu. I don't expect you lot to hold your own, but lending a hand won't hurt.
m920082.あたしとバシラが巡回して見つけたんだよ！\nえっへん！: Bashira and I found them on patrol! Take that!
m920082.あたしは猫が大好きだから、\n猫耳の装飾を頭につけてるだけです……。: I just love cats, so I wear cat-ear accessories on my head…
m920082.あの……何かおかしくないですか？\nこの場所、天狗さんに会った場所と同じだと思い: Um… doesn't something feel off? This place looks exactly like where we met the Tengu. Even the lanterns are in the same spots….
m920082.あの拭き掃除がお前の身体を変えたってことだな。\n既にあんたは修行をつけて貰って: So that cleaning changed your body, huh? Looks like you've already gotten some training.
m920082.あの牛頭の魔物、他の妖怪とともに\n再戦するような事を言っていましたね。\nただ: That Ox-Head Demon said it would fight again with other youkai. I hope that's just sour grapes.
m920082.あまり浮かれ騒ぐのは良くない。水と雷よ。\n天狗の神通力を甘く見れば、死に繋がる: Don't get too carried away. Water and Thunder, listen. Underestimating a Tengu's divine power will get you killed. …Huh? Who are those?
m920082.ありがとう……。\n王子の力を借りてばかりだね……。\nでも、今は素直に嬉しい…: Thank you… I keep leaning on the Prince's power… But right now I'm genuinely happy.
m920082.ありがとうございます、コノハ様！\nこのアオバ、どんな修行であっても耐えてみせま: Thank you, Konoha-sama! I, Aoba, will endure any training you give me!
m920082.ありがとうございます、フドウ様。\n何とお礼を申したらいいのか……。: Thank you, Lord Fudou. I don't know how I can ever repay you…
m920082.ありがとうございます。\nですが、まだまだ酒呑童子を倒すには至ってません。\n仇: Thank you. But we're still far from defeating Shuten-doji. To avenge us, I must become stronger!
m920082.いいか、アオバ？ \n絶大な力を有したとて、流れ着く先を決するは「心」だ。\n力: Listen, Aoba. No matter how great your power, it's your heart that decides where you end up. If you become too obsessed with strength, you'll become no different from a demon.
m920082.いくら人間の姿を真似たところで、\nその猫耳こそが妖怪である何よりの証拠！: No matter how well you mimic a human, those cat ears are the clearest proof you're a youkai!
m920082.いくら酒呑童子様といえど、\n奴らを確実に塵に出来ると言えるであろうか……？: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: Even if it's the Shuten-doji himself, can we really say we'll turn them to dust…?
m920082.いずれ、絶対に鬼刃衆を助け出す……。\nそして――。: Someday, I'll definitely rescue the Oni Blade Squad… And then—
m920082.いつでも頼ってください！\nそれでは、王子帰還しましょう。: You can rely on us anytime! Then, let's return to the Prince.
m920082.いつものように戦っては危険というわけですね。\n王子、慎重な采配をお願いします。: So fighting as usual would be dangerous. Prince, please command cautiously.
m920082.うむ、息災でな……アオバ。\n然るべき時が来れば、また会う事もあるであろう。\n: Indeed, stay healthy, Aoba. When the time is right, we may meet again. Farewell.
m920082.お、王子、あそこをご覧下さい！\n酒呑童子の配下の四天王です……！\nまさか、天: Oh, Prince, look over there! Those are the Four Heavenly Kings serving Shuten-doji…! They're attacking Tengu Mountain?
m920082.お、落ち着いて下さい！\n私たちは貴方の命を奪おうなどという気は\nこれっぽっち: Please, calm down! We have absolutely no intention of taking your life.
m920082.おい、アオバ！ \nこの灯篭は、天狗山に数百年に渡って残る逸品なのだ。\nちゃん: Hey, Aoba! This lantern is a masterpiece that's been preserved on Tengu Mountain for centuries. Polish it until it shines!
m920082.おいおい！\n豪風の四天王が逃げていくぞ！\n臆病風に吹かれたって訳か？: Hey, hey! The Four Heavenly Kings are running away! Cowardly, blown by the wind?
m920082.かなり上まで登ってきたというのに、\n天狗の姿は見当たりませんね……。: We've climbed pretty high, yet we still can't spot any tengu…
m920082.くっ……。\n王子、霧が更に濃くなっています。\n遠距離兵はさらに戦い辛くなるの: Damn… Prince, the fog is thickening. Long-range units will have an even harder time fighting, so be careful!
m920082.くっ、多勢に無勢か……。\nぬぅううう……。今、王子と戦えば敗北は必至……。\n: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: Damn, outnumbered… Ugh… If we fight the Prince now, defeat is certain… We have no choice but to retreat!
m920082.くっくっく……天狗山に出向くのも随分と久しいですね。\nさて、今日こそは目障りな: Heh heh heh… It's been ages since we last set foot on Tengu Mountain. Today, we'll finally crush those pesky Tengu.
m920082.こ、これはとんだ失礼を！\n私の国では人間に化ける猫の物の怪がいたゆえ、\nてっ: What a grave insult! In my country there are cat youkai that disguise themselves as humans, so I completely mistook you for a monster…
m920082.こちらこそ宜しくお願いしますね、アオバさん。\nそれでは王子、帰還するとしましょ: The pleasure's mine, Aoba-san. Well then, Prince, let's return!
m920082.この山は天狗の棲む神聖な山ぞ。\n戯れに汚すのであれば、\n其方らを山の肥やしと: This mountain is a sacred realm where Tengu dwell. Should you defile it for sport, making you fertilizer for the mountain would be all too easy.
m920082.この旅の目的はただ一つ……。\nそれは、私の故郷を滅ぼした\n酒呑童子という名の: My only purpose on this journey is one thing... to slay the demon called Shuten-dōji, who destroyed my hometown.
m920082.この程度で音をあげるとはどういうことだ！\n日の出前から始めて、まだ二つしか終わ: How can you give up so easily! We started before sunrise and you've only finished two already? I won't let you rest until it's all done!
m920082.この辺りはもう人が住んでいない廃屋しかないですし、\nまさかゴブリンが現れるとは: There are only abandoned houses around here, no one lives here, so I never expected goblins. You two are impressive!
m920082.これほど不利な状況にあっても、\nカラス天狗やかまいたちらを負かすとはな……。: Even in such a dire situation, you managed to defeat the crow Tengu and the kamaitachi….
m920082.これ程までに成長していたとはな。\nよし、いいだろう。此を以て最後の修行とする。: I never expected you to have grown this much. All right, this will be your final trial. Come on, Aoba! Endure my onslaught!
m920082.しかし、やっかいだな。\nまさか、天狗と人間、それもあの王子が手を組むとは。: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: This is troublesome. Who would have thought a tengu and a human, and even that Prince, would join forces?
m920082.しかし、今の私の力では\n強大すぎる酒呑童子に勝つことなどできません。: But with my current strength, I have no chance against the overwhelming Shuten-dōji.
m920082.じ、獣人……！？\nそれは一体どういう事だ……？\n物の怪が化けた姿ではないのか: Beastperson…!? What does that even mean? Isn't she just a monster in disguise!?
m920082.じ、神通力……！？\nそれでは、私たちはこの森から出られないのですか？: Shintō power…!? Does that mean we can't get out of this forest?
m920082.すごい……アオバさんの援護射撃のおかげで、\n難なく魔物を一掃することができまし: Amazing… Thanks to your support fire, Aoba, we cleared the monsters without trouble.
m920082.ぜ、是非ご案内いただきたい！\n勿論、ただでとは言いません。修行を終えた後は、\: I-I'd be honored if you'd guide me! Of course, I won't ask for a free ride. After my training, I promise I'll lend my strength to the Prince and his allies!
m920082.そ、そんな……！\n申し訳ありません、王子。視界が悪くて、\n遠くに矢を射る事が: N-no…! I'm sorry, Prince. The visibility's terrible, I don't think I can shoot arrows that far…
m920082.そ、そんなぁ……。\nまだ掃除は続けるのですね……ハァ。: Wh-what… So the cleaning's still going on… *sigh*.
m920082.そうだ、それで良い。\nぬらす、ふきとる、ぬらす、ふきとる。\nこの動きを忘れる: That's it, just like that. Wet it, wipe it, wet it, wipe it. Don't ever forget this motion.
m920082.そうだね……。\n今は生きていると分かっただけで良いよ……。: Right… Just knowing they're alive is enough for now…
m920082.そうですね。\n一度、私達の仲間のいる所に行ってみましょう。: That's right. Let's head to where our companions are first.
m920082.そうですね。\n王子、では私達も山へ登りましょう！: That's right. Prince, then let's climb the mountain too!
m920082.そこで私は、天狗山に住むと言い伝えられる\n高名な天狗の許で修行をすべきと考えた: So I decided I should train under the famed tengu said to live on Tengu Mountain.
m920082.それが本当なら、\n天狗がアオバさんに力を貸してくれる可能性も\nゼロとは言い切: If that's true, we can't say there's zero chance the tengu might lend you power, Aoba.
m920082.それと、王子、我が修験にお付き合い頂き感謝します。\n約束通り今よりアオバは貴方: And Prince, thank you for joining me in my training. As promised, from now on I'll be your strength. I look forward to working together!
m920082.それに、バシラさんは妖怪ではありませんよ。\nれっきとした「獣人」です。: Besides, Bashira isn't a youkai. She's a bona-fide beastperson.
m920082.それに、酒呑童子の血肉を得た……と、言っていました。\n同族となったのであれば、: Besides, you said you'd taken Shuten-dōji's flesh… If you've become one of them, his followers won't kill you so easily.
m920082.それにしても、王子は本当に人間なのですか？\n物の怪をも上回る力をお持ちの様に見: Still, Prince… are you really human? You seem to wield power beyond any youkai… You even communicate with the troops without a word.
m920082.それよりもアオバ殿。本当に天狗に会いに行くのか？\n拙僧ら修験者であっても、\n: More importantly, Aoba, are you truly set on meeting the tengu? Even for us ascetics, the climb up this mountain is treacherously steep.
m920082.そんな……！\n鬼刃衆があてに刃を向けるなんて……！？: No…! The Oni Blade Squad turning their blades on Atei…!?
m920082.だって……みんなが……\n鬼刃衆が生きてたんだ……！: But… everyone… the Oni Blade Squad is alive…!
m920082.ちっ……。\nここで倒すつもりだったが、逃がしちまったか。: Tch… I intended to finish it here, but it's escaped.
m920082.ちょ、ちょっとアオバさん！\n王子は、もちろん人間ですよ！: Hey, hey, Aoba! The Prince is, of course, human!
m920082.ちょ、ちょっと待ってください！\n彼女達は化け猫ではありません！: W-wait a moment! They're not masquerading cats!
m920082.ちょ、調子に乗るでないわ！\nまだ少し早いかも、と前置きしただろうに……！\nま: Hey, don't get cocky! I told you it might be a little early…! Honestly, that's just like you…
m920082.ですが、天狗も鬼と同じように\n悪い妖怪なのではないのでしょうか……？: But… aren't the tengu just as bad as demons?
m920082.というのも、私は天狗山の詳しい場所を\n知らないのです……。: You see, I don't actually know where Tengu Mountain is…
m920082.どうか私めを弟子にして頂きたい！\n鬼に殺された故郷の者たちの仇を討つため、\n: I beg you to take me as your disciple! To avenge my hometown, slaughtered by demons, I wish to master unrivaled strength!
m920082.なぜなら、天狗は妖怪の身でありながら、\nかつて人間に武芸を伝授したという伝説が: Because legend says that, although tengu are youkai, they once taught martial arts to humans—a story that's been passed down in my hometown for ages...
m920082.ぬぅ……。彼奴ら、まだ自我が残っておったか……。\nもう少し時間がかかる様だな。: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: Huh… they still retain some will… It'll take a little more time. There's nothing we can do. I'll leave for today.
m920082.は、はいぃ………………うぅぅ。\nでもコノハ様ぁ……私、もう何時間も拭き続けてい: Y-yes… uuu… But, Lady Konoha… I've been wiping for hours now, and my hands and shoulders just won't stop hurting…
m920082.は、はいっ！\nもっと修行に励みます……！: Y-yes! I'll work harder on my training…!
m920082.はぁ、はぁ……ダメです。\n完全に天狗様を見失ってしまいました。\nもう、完全に: —Pant, pant… It's no use. I've completely lost sight of the Tengu. The darkness has swallowed everything….
m920082.はい、分かりました！\n餓鬼など、今の私の敵ではありません。\nコノハ様が満足す: Yes, understood! Those hungry spirits aren't my opponents right now. I'll give you a battle worthy of your satisfaction!
m920082.はい。私の決意に曇りはありません。\n天狗の教えを受け、天下無双の力を体得せねば: Yes. My resolve is unwavering. I must learn the tengu's teachings and master unrivaled power, or my great ambition will never be fulfilled…
m920082.ふむ、アオバのやつめ、\n四肢の筋力は十分に備わったと見える。\nだが、体力の方: Hmm, Aoba seems to have built up good limb strength. But I wonder about his stamina… Haa—!!
m920082.ふむ、アオバ殿の得物はかなり風変わりな逸品ゆえ、\nそれを使いこなすとはまったく: Hmm, Lady Aoba's weapon is quite an unconventional masterpiece, and to wield it so well—truly humbling.
m920082.ふむ、天狗の気配が消えたか。\n……全く以て不思議な存在だのう天狗とは。: Hm, the tengu's presence has vanished… What a mysterious being, that tengu.
m920082.ふん……調子の良い奴め。\nだがそうした単純さは其方の強みでもあるな。: Hmph… You're getting cocky. Still, that simplicity is also your strength.
m920082.ほ、報告！ 牛頭の魔物が多数出現！\nさらに、どの個体にも攻撃が全く通じない模様: R-report! Numerous Ox-Head Demons have appeared! Moreover, none of our attacks seem to affect them at all…!
m920082.ほう、人間のくせになかなかやりおる。: Hmm, humans sure know how to put on a show.
m920082.ほう、鬼とな？ しかし、其方は人間であろう？\n自らの力を計らぬその無謀な志は、: Ah, you seek to become a demon? Yet you are but human. Such reckless ambition, untested, will only lead to your ruin.
m920082.まずいですね……。\n霧が出ている時は、普段通り遠くの敵に\n攻撃を当てる事は困: This is bad… When the fog's out, hitting distant enemies as we normally do will be difficult.
m920082.まだ少し早いかもしれぬが、\n特別に其方にはコレを渡しておこう。\n有り難く受け: It might still be a bit early, but I'll make an exception and give you this. Accept it gratefully.
m920082.まだ粗削りではあるが、素養はあるとみえる。\n其方、確か名をアオバと言ったな？\: It's still rough around the edges, but you've got the talent. And you said your name was Aoba, right? Fine, I'll train you personally.
m920082.まったくもう！ アオバさんってば何でも疑って……！\n天狗様に、妖怪と人間の区別: Good grief! Aoba-san doubts everything…! Please have the Tengu teach you how to tell youkai from humans in training!
m920082.もちろん天狗も妖怪のひとりですから、\n危険な存在であることには変わりありません: Of course, tengu are also youkai, so they're still dangerous. But now I have no choice but to believe in the tengu legends.
m920082.よく耐え抜いたな、アオバ。\n今日の修行はここまでとしよう。: You held out well, Aoba. That's enough training for today.
m920082.より強くなりたいと望むのならば、\n明朝からは灯篭だけでなく\n寺の壁の掃除もし: If you want to become stronger, starting tomorrow you'll clean not just the lanterns but also the temple walls.
m920082.アオバよ、この窮地を好機へと転じてみせよ！\n今こそ稽古の成果を示す時なり……。: Aoba, turn this dire situation into an opportunity! Now's the time to show the results of your training… Use the techniques you've honed here to drive them back!
m920082.アオバ殿、天狗を追いましょう。\n今ならば、追いつけるかもしれぬ。: Lord Aoba, let us pursue the Tengu. We might still catch up.
m920082.アンナさん、ゴブリン達が現れたのは、ここです！: Anna, the goblins showed up right here!
m920082.カカカッ。\nあの三大妖怪の一柱、\n酒呑童子に本気で挑むつもりでおるのか。: Kaka… Are you really planning to take on one of the three great youkai, Shuten-doji?
m920082.グ、グフッ――！？\nあそこにいるのは人間達……ッ！？\n少数ならいざしらず、人: G—Guff…!? Those over there are humans…!? If it were just a few, maybe, but there are far too many…
m920082.グハハハ！\n生ぬるいと言っておるだろう。水よ。\nこの山ごと、わしの雷の餌食に: Guhahaha! I told you it was too soft, Water. I'll make this whole mountain a feast for my thunder!
m920082.グフフフフ……！\nこの砂漠を越えれば、東の国は目と鼻の先……。: Guffaw…! Once we cross this desert, the eastern lands are just around the corner….
m920082.コノハ様……！ \n本当に、本当に有難うございました……。: Lady Konoha…! Truly, thank you so much…
m920082.シ、酒呑童子様……ノ……血肉ヲ得……\n我ラ……修羅……畜生……ラセツ、ガ道ヲ、: S-Shuten-dōji… we seek your flesh… We, the Shura beasts, will blaze the path… A sudden gust of wind… arrives… and we come.
m920082.バシラさんがそう仰るのも無理はありません。\nですが、酒呑童子率いる鬼の一族と天: It's understandable you'd think that, Bashira. However, the demon clan led by Shuten-doji has long been at odds with the tengu.
m920082.人気のない廃屋に誘い込み\n人間を喰らうつもりだったのだろう！\n化け猫め、私が: You lured us into this deserted house to devour humans, didn't you? Masquerading cat, I'll be the one to bring you down…!
m920082.人間どもめ……覚えていろッ……！\n次こそは必ず強大な力を持つ妖怪とともに、\n: You humans… remember this…! Next time, with a truly powerful youkai, we'll wipe you out…!
m920082.仕方ない。\nそこまで言うのならば稽古をつけてやろう。\n構えろ！ アオバ！: Fine. If that's what you want, I'll give you a lesson. Get ready, Aoba!
m920082.他の妖怪の仲間になろうと考えていたとなると、\n動きが気になるな……。: If it's looking to join other youkai, its movements are worth watching…
m920082.伝承によれば天狗の教えを受けた人間は、\n天下無双の武人に至ったとされており、\: According to the tales, anyone who receives a tengu's teachings becomes a peerless warrior. I'm determined to master that power, no matter what.
m920082.全妖怪の長にならんと企む鬼達は、\n修験によって卓越した力と知識を備える天狗を支: The demons, who plot to become the rulers of all youkai, have repeatedly assaulted Tengu Mountain, trying to seize the tengu's superior strength and knowledge gained through ascetic practice.
m920082.卑劣な……！\n何が何でもここであの化け猫を撃ち倒し、あの方たちを\nお救いしな: Despicable…! I must shoot that masquerading cat down here and save those people… Aoba, onward!
m920082.右手で濡れ拭き。\n左手で乾き拭き。\n分かるか？ アオバよ。: Wipe it with your right hand while it's wet, dry it with your left. Got it, Aoba?
m920082.大方、我が力を欲する邪悪な妖の手先であろう。: They're likely minions of a wicked demon craving my power.
m920082.天狗が人間に肩入れしてるとなれば、\n少々厄介になってきたな。\n酒呑童子様に報: If the Tengu are siding with humans, things just got messy. I'll report back to Shuten-doji.
m920082.天狗の山？\nうーん、あたしは知らないけど、\nもしかしたら仲間の誰か知ってる人: The Tengu Mountain? Hmm, I don't know, but maybe someone among our allies does.
m920082.天狗様！ 私の話を聞いて下さい！\n実は、私は酒呑童子を倒す力を得る為に、\n貴: Tengu! Please hear me! Actually, I've been searching for you to gain the power to defeat the Shuten-dōji.
m920082.実は、詳しい場所が分からず、\n困っていたところでした。: The problem is, I have no idea exactly where that place is, and I was at a loss.
m920082.小賢しい妖術使いって訳か。\n面倒くさいのは嫌いだ。\nつまり、本体を見つけてと: So it's some clever illusionist, huh. I hate dealing with hassles. In other words, just find the real one and take it down, right?
m920082.屈服など生ぬるいぞ。水よ。\nわしなら羽をむしり取り、殺し尽くしてやるわい。: Subduing them? That's too soft. Water, heed my call. I'll tear out their wings and slay them all.
m920082.左様。\nだが、分身といえど本体と同等の力を持っている。\n王子、十分にご注意な: Exactly. But even the duplicates possess strength equal to the original. Prince, please be very careful.
m920082.引き続き、妖怪全体の動きにも注意が必要ですね。\n王子、それでは帰還するとしまし: We still need to keep an eye on the overall youkai activity. Prince, let's head back then.
m920082.待って！ みんな、待ってよ！\nあてを置いていかないで……！: Wait! Everyone, wait! Don't leave Atei behind…!
m920082.復活した大妖怪、酒呑童子の傘下に入り、\n必ずや憎き人間どもを根絶やしにしてやる: Having joined the resurrected great youkai, Shuten-dōji's forces, we will surely eradicate those hateful humans.
m920082.我が団扇が生ぬるい風を操るだけの\nものだと思っておったら大間違いだぞ。\nじわ: You thought my fan only summoned a gentle breeze? Big mistake. Feel this heat wave that saps your stamina bit by bit!
m920082.掃討完了……。\n皆さん、お怪我はありませんか？: The sweep's complete… Is anyone hurt?
m920082.操られているのかもしれませんね……。\n今は、無力化することに専念しましょう。: They might be being controlled… For now, let's focus on neutralizing them.
m920082.攻撃が通じぬとな……？\nむぅ……。異国の妖怪には、不思議な妖術で分身を\n作る: Attacks don't work, you say…? Hmm… I've heard that some foreign youkai can create duplicates with mysterious sorcery…
m920082.来る日も来る日も雑用ばかりで……耐えられません！\nもう……山をおります！: Every day it's just chores… I can't take it! I'm leaving the mountain!
m920082.此処がアオバ殿が探し求めていた天狗山の登口だ。: This is the trailhead of the Tengu Mountain you've been searching for, Aoba.
m920082.無駄とも思えた、あの拭き掃除が、\nこんなにも私を強くしてくれてただなんて……。: That cleaning I thought was useless actually made me this strong… I'm truly impressed by your teachings, Lady Konoha!
m920082.然り。我が名は天狗山の主、コノハ。\nして、何用だ人間よ？: Indeed. I am Konoha, lord of the Tengu Mountain. What brings you, humans, here?
m920082.王子、すぐに戦いの準備をお願い致します！: Prince, please prepare for battle at once!
m920082.王子、駆けつけて来て下さり、ありがとうございます。\n私が牛頭の魔物を目撃したの: Prince, thank you for coming to our aid. I saw the Ox-Head Demon around here.
m920082.王子、鬼刃姫、こっちだ。\n見てくれ。以前、鬼刃衆が捕らえられていた場所を\n未: Prince, Kibahime, over here. Look—the place where the Demon-blade troops were captured is still being watched by the Shuten-doji's minions.
m920082.王子よ、拙僧らも山へ赴かぬか？\n大敵にも臆せず、自ら厳しい修験を積む者を前にし: Prince, shall we also ascend the mountain? Facing someone who fearlessly endures harsh ascetic training against a great enemy, we cannot simply stand idle.
m920082.確かに、酒呑童子とはいずれまた戦う事に\nなるでしょうし、アオバさんの修行を援護: Indeed, we'll eventually have to face Shuten-doji again, and supporting Aoba's training will be beneficial for us as well.
m920082.確かにそうみたいね……。豪風の四天王も\n定期的に出入りしているという事だけど、: It certainly seems that way… The Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale also come and go regularly, so something must still be hidden there…?
m920082.私の名前はアオバ。\n妖怪退治専門の狙撃手として\n各地を旅している者です。: My name is Aoba. I'm a sniper who travels the lands, specializing in exterminating youkai.
m920082.私は、生まれた時からこの姿なんです！: I've looked like this since birth!
m920082.私もそんな気がしていました。\n……まっすぐ走っていたはずなのに、\nそんなこと: I felt the same. We were supposed to be running straight, yet… how could this be?
m920082.精神、武技、そして肉体……全ての理を悟り、\nお前自身が己という器の限界を越える: Mind, technique, and body… grasp all the principles, and by surpassing the limits of your own vessel, you'll finally understand the meaning of that certification.
m920082.見たところ、自らの意思で山に踏み入ったようだな。\n……いいだろう。我ら天狗の山: ???: It looks like they entered the mountain of their own volition. …Very well. Let's test with our divine power whether they're worthy to step onto the tengu's mountain.
m920082.賢明な判断ですね……。\nそれでは人間どもよ。\n次に見える時を楽しみにしてます: Wise decision… So, humans, enjoy the next time we meet… heh heh heh.
m920082.逃がすものか、豪風の四天王――\nって……あ、あれは……！？: We won't let them escape, Four Heavenly Kings—wait… what's that…!?
m920082.過ぎたことですし、気にしないで下さい。\nそれよりも妖怪を退治することに\n並々: That's all in the past, so don't worry about it. More importantly, you seem unusually eager to hunt down youkai, don't you?
m920082.酒呑童子……！？ \n一体何を言っているの……？: Shuten-dōji…!? What on earth are you saying…?
m920082.酒呑童子に早急に合流したいのだが、\n我ながら運が悪すぎる……！ \nこうなれば: I want to rejoin Shuten-dōji quickly, but my luck is terrible…! At this point, I'll counter with my illusionary duplicate technique.
m920082.餓鬼……ッ！？\n一体どうしてヤツらが此処に？: Hungry spirit…!? Why are they here?
m920082.驚いた……まさか立っていられるとは思わなんだ。\n合格だ、アオバ。其方の執念には: I'm impressed… I never thought you'd still be standing. You pass, Aoba. I'm humbled by your determination.
m920082.鬼刃姫、近づくんじゃない！ \n何か様子がおかしい。\n彼らは明らかに敵意を持っ: Kibahime, don't get close! Something's off. They're clearly hostile.
m920082.鬼刃姫さん、冷静になってください！\nあの状態では、今は放っておくしかありません: Kibahime, please calm down! In that state, we have no choice but to leave them be.
m920082.（――おい！ 豪風の四天王が帰っていくぞ……！\nどうする？ とっ捕まえた方が良: (—Hey! The Four Heavenly Kings are leaving… What should we do? Should we try to capture them!?)
m920082.（――！ 皆静かに。\n豪風の四天王が出てきたぞ……）: (—Everyone, stay quiet. The Four Heavenly Kings have appeared…)
m920082.（いざとなれば彼奴らを使う事も考えねばな……。\n酒呑童子様の血肉を与えたとはい: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: (If it comes to it, we may have to use them… Though we gave them the Shuten-doji's flesh and blood, their bodies haven't fully regenerated yet…)

m920118.――いいえ、滅びの時は訪れません。\n王子と、そして私たちが貴方を倒してみせます:
—No, the age of ruin will never come.
Prince, and we, will defeat you!
m920118.――かつて、ある雪降り止まぬ地で、\n神々による戦いがあったとされる……。\n魔: ――Long ago, in a land where the snow never ceased, a war among the gods is said to have taken place… The Demon King should be there now.
m920118.――ぐっ、な、何ッ……！？\nち、力が抜け落ちるようなこの感覚は……！？\nぐぁ:
—Guh, wh-what…!?
This feeling… like my power's draining away…!?
Guaaaahhh—!!
m920118.――ここからは私が相手をしてやろう。\n腕に覚えがあるならば、かかってくるが良い: —From here on out, I'll handle you. If you think you're strong enough, come at me!
m920118.――この世界はお前の物ではない、か。\n無謀なところといい、あの言葉といい、\n:
—This world isn't yours, is it?
Your reckless streak and those words…
They reminded me a little of my brother, Prince.
m920118.――さぁ、余興は終わりだ。\n我が真の力を前にして、絶望に咽び泣くが良い。:
—Now, the entertainment ends.
Face my true power and weep in despair.
m920118.――しかし、残念だったな。\n時間切れというやつだ、人類種共よ。:
—But, that's a shame.
Time's up, humanity.
m920118.――そうはさせない。\nお前たちを野放しにしては、\nこちらの作戦に支障が出るか: —I won't let that happen. If I let you run wild, it'll jeopardize our operation.
m920118.――だが王子、最後にひとつ問いたい。\n無駄とは思うが、お前もこちらへ来ないか。: —But Prince, I have one final question. It may be futile, but will you come this way? I could bargain with the Demon Lord for you.
m920118.――ところでシャディアよ、お前には恩がある。\n何かの間違いで敵対はしたくない。: —By the way, Shadia, I owe you a favor. I don't want any misunderstandings that lead to hostility… Don't start thinking strange thoughts.
m920118.――どうやら全て、\n作戦どおりに進んでいるようだな、シャディアよ。: —It seems everything's proceeding exactly as planned, Shadia.
m920118.――なるほど。予に刃を向けるか。\nまさかかつての『器』の血縁が生き残っていたと: I see. You dare point a blade at me. So the bloodline of that former “vessel” survived, huh? But you humans think you can kill me?
m920118.――ようやく来たか、王子。\nそれにシャディアも、どうやら無事だったようだな。: ――So you finally arrived, Prince. And it seems Shadia made it out in one piece, too.
m920118.――よき趣向だ。\nお前たちは手を出さず、下がっておれ。:
—Fine, an interesting notion.
You all stay back and don't interfere.
m920118.――デシウスめ、こんな所に呼び出すとは、\nいったいどういうつもりなんだ。\n今: ――Decius, summoning me here—what on earth are you thinking? We're in a situation where every second counts…
m920118.――今回は、間に合わなかったか。\nしかしあの圧倒的な覇気……。\nどうやら魔王: ――So we didn't make it in time this round. But that overwhelming aura… It seems the Demon King has fully revived.
m920118.――信用できません。\n魔王の配下だった者を側におくなど、\n酔狂の域を超えてい: I can't trust you. Keeping former Demon King minions by your side is beyond reckless.
m920118.――助けられた分の礼はしよう。\n真っ当な『人間』であれば死んでいただろう傷を、: —I'll repay the debt of being saved. A proper “human” would have died from those wounds, but you healed them…
m920118.――嗚呼、永遠にも感じられる、\n魂を燃やすような戦いであった……。: ――Ah, a battle that feels as if it could last forever, burning our very souls…
m920118.――存外遅いな、ガリウス。\n俺が受け止められる程度の剣速とは。\nその程度で魔: — You're surprisingly slow, Garius. That's the speed of a sword I could block. Is that all you call yourself a Demon King?
m920118.――成る程、あの地に満ちていた神の力の残滓、\n魔王ガリウスはそれを吸収したとい: —I see. So the remnants of the divine power that filled that land… Demon King Garius has absorbed them.
m920118.――救援は間に合ったようだな。: —Looks like the rescue arrived just in time.
m920118.――無様な戦いだな。\nだが、英雄王の系譜、\nその最期には間に合ったようだ。:
—What a pitiful fight.
Yet the lineage of the Hero-King seems to have caught up to its end in time.
m920118.――王子、まずは雪原に斥候を出す。\n魔王の所在を確認次第、\n帝国、王国の全軍: Prince, first we'll send scouts into the snowfield. Once we locate the Demon King, we'll devise a pincer attack with the Empire's and Kingdom's full forces.
m920118.――王子、依然として魔物の侵攻は止まりません。\n複数の戦線から救援要請が届いて: —Prince, the monster incursions still haven't ceased. We've received rescue requests from multiple fronts, and none have enough forces.
m920118.――王子は我輩が認めた男だ。\nその強さを甘く見たな？\nしかし、我輩に救援を求: —The Prince is a man I deem worthy. Did you take my strength lightly? Still, calling on me for aid was the right move, Shadia.
m920118.――興が冷めた。英雄王の系譜、白の皇帝よ、\n貴様らを滅ぼすのは真の力によって、: — My interest wanes. Heroic lineage, White Emperor, I'll crush you with my true power, giving you no chance to resist.
m920118.――行ったか。\n復讐に生きる娘よ、我輩はお前に、\nかつての自分自身を重ねてし: …So you've gone, then. Daughter who lives for revenge, I wonder if I've come to see in you the reflection of my former self.
m920118.――魔王様、\n畏れながらご報告申し上げます！\n対帝国戦線、押されております！: ――My lord, with all due respect, I must report! Our front against the Empire is being pushed back!!
m920118.――魔王様、前線の部隊ハ\n王国、帝国両軍に押されてイル様子。: —Lord Demon King, the front-line troops are being pressed by both the Kingdom and Empire.
m920118.…………ありがとう。\n礼は、言っておく。: ………Thank you. I'll make sure to repay you.
m920118.…………どこまでも馬鹿な男だ。\n分かった、ならば聞いてくれ。:
…………What a foolish man, through and through.
Fine, then listen up.
m920118.…………呆れた連中だ。\n千年戦争時代の人類より愚かだぞ、お前達は。: ………What a pathetic bunch. You're even dumber than humanity was back in the Thousand-Year War.
m920118.…………道は、ある。\nか細く、どうしようもなく険しい道だが。: …There is a path. It's narrow and impossibly steep, but it exists.
m920118.……あぁ。だが、あくまで可能性だ。\nただの徒労に終わるかも知れないし、\nそも:
…Yes. But it's only a possibility.
It could end up being nothing but wasted effort, and perhaps I'm even lying.
m920118.……いや、あくまでこれは\n魔王様が真の力を取り戻すまでの時間稼ぎだ。\n無理に: …No, this is merely a buying-time measure until the Demon Lord regains his true power. There's no need to force an attack and cause unnecessary casualties.
m920118.……さて、何のことだかな。\nまぁいい。好機となればお前を呼んでやろう。\n王子: …Well, what could that be about? Never mind. If the opportunity arises, I'll call upon you. You and the Prince share a deep grudge, after all.
m920118.……そうか。\nならば、礼は言うまい。: …I see. Then I won't thank you.
m920118.……そうです。\n不利な状況だって、苦しい戦いだって、\n私達はずっと……王子と:
...That's right.
Even in a disadvantageous, painful battle,
we've always... won alongside the Prince.
m920118.……そのとおりだ。\n話し合いで解決するなら、人は戦を選ぶことはない。: …Exactly. If it could be settled by discussion, no one would choose war.
m920118.……その無言が、お前の答えか。\n残念だ、本当に残念だ、王子。: …Your silence is your answer. Disappointing, truly disappointing, Prince.
m920118.……ていた。\n……この瞬間を、ずっと待っていた。: I've been waiting... I've been waiting for this moment all along.
m920118.……ですな。\n魔術師隊、陣を立て直せ！\n魔王軍に魔法の力を見せてやるのだ！: …Indeed. Mages, reform the lines! Show the demon-lord's army the power of our magic!
m920118.……では、どうして魔王を裏切ったのですか？\nそれに、兄の、あなた自身の仇とは…: …Then why did you betray the Demon King? And what about your brother—your own vengeance…?
m920118.……なッ！？\nシャディア、ナゼ魔王様を連れて来タ！？\n魔王様ハ今、本来の力ヲ:
...What!?
Shadia, why did you bring the Demon King!?
He can't unleash his true power right now!
m920118.……はぁ。\nお前はもう少し頭を使え。王子達が\n戦線を下げているのが分からない: …Sigh. Use your head a little more. Can't you see the Prince and the others are pulling back?
