m920118.ケラウノスの呪縛を脱しはしたが、\n真の力を取り戻すまでのほんの短い時間、\n魔: We've broken free of Keranos's curse, but the Demon Lord will be weakened for the short time it takes him to recover his true strength.
m920118.ゴブリン軍団が、魔王軍の配下に付いたってこと……？\nただでさえ数で押されている: So the goblin horde is now under the demon-lord's command…? We're already outnumbered, and now this…
m920118.シカシ！ 慢心することナカレ！\n我らはマスマス気を引き締め、\n訓練に励まねば:
But—don't get cocky!
We must tighten our resolve and
push ourselves in training!
m920118.シャディアが……魔王に斬りかかった！？\nどういうことなの……！？: Shadia... lunged at the Demon King! What the—!?
m920118.シャディアさん、ここは私たちに任せて後方に退避を。\n……王子、これを最後の戦い:
Shadia, leave this to us and fall back.
…Prince, let's make this our final battle.
Take command of the fight. —May you have victorious war!!
m920118.シャディアさん！！ 無茶をしては駄目です！！\n本当なら死んでいてもおかしくない:
Shadia!! Don't be reckless!!
You're in a condition where you could've died already!?
m920118.シャディアさん！？\nお、王子！ シャディアさんが急に苦しみだして……！:
Shadia-san!?
Prince! Shadia-san is suddenly in pain…!
m920118.シャディアだけでなく、\nデシウスまでこの戦線に……？\nそんな、どうしたらいい: Not just Shadia, but Desius too on this front…? What are we supposed to do…?
m920118.シャディアよ、お前は王子と共に進むが良い。\nその果てに何が待っているとしても、: Shadia, you should advance alongside the Prince. Whatever awaits at the end, a path bathed in light will suit you better…
m920118.シャディアを信じられぬ者、\n王子の身を案じる者は俺に付け。\n信じると断言する: Those who can't trust Shadia, those who worry about the Prince—bring them to me. If you declare you trust him, bring them to the Prince.
m920118.デシウス、何故そんなことを教えた。\nお前まで魔王ガリウスを裏切るつもりか？: Decius, why would you tell me that? Are you planning to betray Demon King Garius as well?
m920118.デシウス、魔王が真の力を取り戻す、\nその意味が分かっていて協力しているのですか: Decius, do you understand the meaning of the Demon King regaining his true power, and are you cooperating because of that?
m920118.デシウスさん……本当に\n魔王の配下に付いてしまったんですね……。: Decius… you really ended up siding with the Demon Lord's minions, didn't you…?
m920118.デシウスの使者によれば、\n何か伝えたいことがある、との事ですが……。: According to Decius's messenger, he says he has something he wants to tell us…
m920118.デーモンが戦場から離脱していきます。どうやら、\n別部隊のデシウスのところへ伝令: The Demon is withdrawing from the battlefield. It looks like they've sent a messenger to Desius's unit. They're trying to concentrate their forces here.
m920118.ムム！？ ドウシタというのだ！\n後方から何か来るというのか……？:
Huh?! What's going on!
Something coming from the rear…?
m920118.モハヤ、世界最強の種族は、\n我らゴブリン族と言っても過言ではナイ！！:
Mohaya, it's no exaggeration to say the strongest race in the world is—
the Goblin race!
m920118.ヤヤッ！\nまたしても邪魔をしに来たか、人間ども！:
Ha!
You humans are back to meddle again!
m920118.不敬だぞ、幹部如きが。これは魔王様の意志。\n私はただ英雄王の血筋、その最期を\:
How disrespectful, you subordinates. This is the Demon King's will.
I merely suggested to the Demon King that we should witness the final moments of the Hero-King's bloodline...
m920118.世界が滅ぶか否か、もはや我輩には意味のない事だ。\n大切な者も、祖国も、この世界: Whether the world ends or not no longer matters to me. My loved ones, my homeland, this world are already gone, and I've already taken my revenge on Keranos, the one responsible.
m920118.了解よぉ。\nゴブリン軍団の実力、見せてあげるわぁ。: Got it! I'll show you the might of the goblin legion.
m920118.予が物質界を消滅させる前に、\nその牙を突き立てられるというのなら、\nやってみ: If you think you can pierce my fangs before I erase the Material Realm, then go ahead and try…
m920118.予は寛大である。\n好きな方を選ぶが良い……。:
I am generous.
Choose whichever you prefer…
m920118.人間として生きる道など、とうに諦めていたが……。\nお前たちの歩む世界を、見てみ:
I've long given up on living as a human…
But I'm curious to see the world you all walk.
m920118.人間共もこれまで以上に本気、と言う事か。\n思った以上に楽しませてくれる。\n…:
Humans are more serious than ever, huh.
They're giving me more fun than I thought.
…But I can't ignore my army's losses.
m920118.今が好機ということだ。陣が乱れている内に、\n戦力を削るべきなのは自明だろう。\: This is our chance. While their lines are in disarray, it's obvious we should whittle down their forces. Hurry and summon the other commanders.
m920118.他の幹部が到着するのも時間の問題だ。\nせめて好敵手たるお前は、\n我輩がこの手: It's only a matter of time before the other commanders arrive. At least, as a worthy opponent, I'll give you a proper send-off with my own hands!
m920118.他の幹部にも伝令は行ったはず。\n王子、横槍なく戦えるのはこれが最後かもしれぬ。: I've sent messengers to the other commanders. Prince, this may be the last chance to fight without interference. Let's clash with everything we've got!!
m920118.仲間を利用し、使い捨てた瞬間を、\n魔王に背後から斬りかかった瞬間を、\nお前は: You saw it yourself—the moment you used our comrades as disposable tools, the instant you struck the Demon King from behind.
m920118.任せたぞ、我が臣下たちよ。\nクロコよ、お前はこちらの戦線に残れ。\n戦場全体を:
I'll leave it to you, my subordinates.
Croco, you stay on this front.
Survey the entire battlefield, and report any changes to me.
m920118.何、関係のないことだ。\n主君の敵だからといって、\n友と認めた者を心配してはな: That's beside the point. Just because he's your lord's enemy doesn't mean you can't worry about a friend you consider yours.
m920118.何しろここからは、\n私達の軍勢も参戦するのだからねぇ。: After all, from here our forces will join the fight as well.
m920118.何じゃ、この力の奔流は。\n大気が、大地が震えておる……っ！！:
What is this torrent of power?
The air, the earth… they're trembling…!!
m920118.俺達が全力を以て打ち合い、\n出した結論ならば、誰も異論を挟むことはあるまい。\: If we clash with all our might and reach a conclusion, no one will dare object. That will also protect Shadia.
m920118.分かりました。\nそこまでの考えがあるのなら止めはしません。\n双方、模擬戦の準: Understood. If you've thought it through that far, I won't oppose. Both sides, please prepare for the mock battle!
m920118.勘違いするな。\n救援ではない、共闘だ、デシウス。: Don't get it twisted. It's not aid—it's an alliance, Decius.
m920118.勝った気にならないで。\n王子がいる限り、私達は負けない。\nあなた達を倒し、他:
Don't get cocky about winning.
As long as the Prince is with us, we won't lose.
We just need to defeat you and rush to the other fronts.
m920118.千年戦争以前にも、\nこんな馬鹿共はいなかった。\nだが……嗚呼……くそっ……。: Even before the thousand-year war, there were no fools like this. But… ah… damn…
m920118.厳しい戦いになると思います。\nしかし私達は、王子を信じています。\nここで魔王:
I think this will be a tough fight.
But we trust the Prince.
Let's meet the Demon King's generals head-on here!
m920118.反発する方はいるかと思います。\nしかし、偶然か必然か、そうして仲間を増やし、\: I figured some would resist. But whether by chance or destiny, we've kept gaining allies and kept fighting.
m920118.器との血の繋がりから魔王の力の余波を受け\n不死となった私は、現世に至るまでの間: Bound by the blood of the vessel and bathed in the Demon King's lingering power, I became immortal and have spent the ages seeking the chance to give him his true ruin….
m920118.帝国もそうだろう。\nそれに両国の長が剣をもって示した以上、\n賽は投げられてし: The Empire feels the same. And since the leaders of both nations have shown their resolve with swords, the die is cast.
m920118.幸いなことに、私の兄の身体は既に解放されている。\n英雄王の剣によって、死という: Fortunately, my brother's body has already been released—by the Hero King's sword, in the form of death.
m920118.弱気になるな、フィリス。\n私達が全て受け止めてみせるさ。: Don't get discouraged, Phyllis. We'll take it all on.
m920118.強気なものだ……。\n兵は君主に似るものなのかもしれんな。: You're quite confident… Perhaps soldiers do take after their masters.
m920118.復讐の騎士の残滓に過ぎない我輩に、\n残るものがあるとするならば、\n好敵手たる: I'm nothing more than the lingering remnant of a revenge-seeking knight, but if anything remains, it's the chance to clash with you, Prince, in a battle that will scorch our souls.
m920118.恩に着るぞ、シャディア。\nさぁ構えよ王子、我らの交わる道は戦いのみだ！！: I owe you one, Shadia. Now, brace yourself, Prince—our path intersects only in battle!!
m920118.我々が諦めた時が、王国の最後です。\n王子、どうにか魔物を押し返しましょう。: When we give up, that's the kingdom's end. Prince, we have to push those monsters back somehow.
m920118.我が目的は物質界の完全なる破壊のみ……。\n今ここで予に逆らい、永遠に滅ぼされる:
My only goal is the complete annihilation of the Material Realm…
Defy me now and be forever erased, or tremble and survive until the world's end…
m920118.我らはこれより、\nメカゴブリンクイーン様にお披露目スル、\n行進の訓練をするト:
From now on we're supposed to be showing off to Mecha-Goblin Queen—
practicing our marching drills!
m920118.我輩はもはや、光の道には戻れまい。\n後は堕ちるところまで堕ちるのみ。だがそれ故: I can't return to the path of light any more. All that remains is to fall as far as I can. Yet because of that, I can stand against you once more.
m920118.戦力の再編成を終えた後、\nシャディアさんと共に出陣の準備をいたしますね、王子。:
Once we finish reorganizing our forces, I'll ready the troops with you, Shadia, Prince. We have to defeat him before the Demon King regains his true power…!
--- scene: The King's Approaching Blade (battle, start) ---
m920118.戦力の逐次投入などするから、\nケラウノスは失敗したのだ。\n強き者にはより強き: Because we keep feeding troops in, Keranos failed. Just throw stronger power at the strong ones.
m920118.捜し物の在り処……？ デシウスはもしや……。\nいえ、デシウスの思惑が何にせよ、: The location of the missing person…? Decius, could it be…? Whatever his motives, he's serious. Prince, let's give it our all and meet him head-on!
m920118.数を頼ム戦いは好まヌが、\nこれも魔王様ノ為、致し方あるマイ……。: Numbers aren't my thing, but for the Demon King's sake, I'll do what I must…
m920118.未だ予の真の力を取り戻していない以上、\n捨て置くことは出来ないか。\nこの諦め: As long as I haven't regained my true power, I can't just discard it. This stubbornness reminds me of the old Hero King.
m920118.本当に、ありがとうございました。\n……しかし、被害は甚大でした。: Truly, thank you so much. …But the damage was severe.
m920118.此は予の凱旋ぞ。\n世界にこのガリウスが帰還したと、\nそれを知らしめるためのな:
This is my triumphant return.
Let all know that Garius has come back to the world…
m920118.此度の侵攻には何か、裏があったように思う。\n勿論、話してくれるのだろうな、シャ: I have a feeling there was something behind this invasion. Of course, you'll tell us, won't you, Shadia?
m920118.死んだ、か。多少は使える娘かと思ったが……。\n真の力を得る前とは言え、予の力を: So you're dead. I thought you might be of some use... Even before I regain my true power, you underestimated me too much. — Now, lineage of the Hero King, you'll follow suit.
m920118.永きにわたる血の因果、ここで終わらせてやろう。\n――滅ぶがよい、我が宿敵の血脈:
The endless blood feud ends here.
— perish, line of my arch-enemy!
m920118.永遠に続くとも思えた私の旅は、この命の全ては、\n魔王を滅ぼす為のものだった……: My journey, which seemed endless, my very life—it was all devoted to destroying the Demon King….
m920118.浮遊石の大量確保、新兵器ノ開発、\nそしてメカゴブリンクイーン様の魔王軍幹部就任:
Securing massive amounts of floating stones, developing new weapons, and—
being appointed a high-ranking commander of Mecha-Goblin Queen's demon army—
we won't retreat a step as we stride forward on the path of advancement!
m920118.物質界の破壊……！？\nそんなことを、許すわけには……！！:
Annihilating the Material Realm…!?
We can't let that happen…!!
m920118.王子、お下がり下さい！\nこのまま持久戦に持ち込まれては、\n包囲されているこち: Prince, fall back! If this drags into a war of attrition, the surrounded side—us—will be at a disadvantage!
m920118.王子、お前の先祖である英雄王に滅ぼされた、\n千年戦争当時の魔王……。\nその器: Prince, the Demon King who was slain by your ancestor, the Hero King, during the Thousand-Year War… It was my brother who was taken as his vessel.
m920118.王子、これからもよろしくお願いしますね！: Prince, I'm counting on you from now on!
m920118.王子、これからもよろしくお願いします！: Prince, we'll continue to count on you!
m920118.王子、シャディアが出撃してくるようです！\nここは一時後退して、\n少しでも陣形: Prince, Shadia's about to launch an attack! Let's fall back for now and try to regroup our formation…!
m920118.王子、シャディアの部隊が来ます！\n迎撃の指揮をお願いします！: Prince, Shadia's forces are coming! Take command of the interception!
m920118.王子、奴の話に付き合う必要はない。\n完全復活までは、まだ猶予があるはずだ。\n:
Prince, there's no need to indulge his words.
We should still have time before a full revival.
He's probably just buying time.
m920118.王子、駄目だ、今の魔王には……くっ……。\n絶対に手を出すな……\nまだ、『可能:
Prince, no… we can't…—
Don't… touch him…
There's still a chance…!
m920118.王子が諦めない限り、私達も諦めたりはしません。\n必ず、魔王の軍勢からこの世界を:
As long as you don't give up, Prince, we won't either.
We'll protect this world from the Demon King's forces.
Let's keep working together, Prince.
m920118.王子という希望の灯火を、\nここで消すわけにはいかないの。\n最後の最後まで抵抗:
We can't let the beacon of hope called the Prince be snuffed out here.
We'll keep resisting until the very end.
m920118.王子の判断は極めて合理的だと思います。\nもはや魔王を倒す為に、\n手段を選べる: I think the Prince's decision is extremely rational. At this point we can't afford to be choosy about how we defeat the Demon King.
m920118.王子よ、この共闘関係は魔王を倒す為のものだったな。\nならば、これからもお前に協:
Prince, this alliance was forged to bring down the Demon King.
If so, let me continue to aid you.
m920118.王子！ 東方面の部隊が潰走したと報告があった。\nロイヤルガード達が支えているら: Prince! We've received reports that the eastern forces have been routed. The Royal Guard is holding the line, but at this rate they won't be able to hold out much longer!
m920118.現在、白の帝国に救援要請を出しています。\n前線を下げつつ、援軍到着まで耐えまし: We've requested aid from the White Empire. Let's fall back a bit and hold out until reinforcements arrive.
m920118.白の帝国の援軍は間に合いませんでしたか……。\nでも、ここで諦めるわけにはいきま: The White Empire's reinforcements didn't make it in time… But we can't just give up here. The kingdom's people are behind us.
m920118.白の皇帝……王子、\nあなた方はもしや……。: White Emperor… Prince, could it be that you…
m920118.白の皇帝……！\n間に合ったのですね……！！: White Emperor...! You made it in time...!!
m920118.皆さん、王子がどれだけ本気なのか、\nそれを見たかったのでしょうか……。: Everyone, you wanted to see just how serious the Prince is… didn't you?
m920118.神器を持つ者がもうひとり、か。\n真の力を取り戻す前となれば、\n少々手間がかか: Another who wields a divine artifact, huh. If I haven't regained my true power yet, it might take a bit more effort...
m920118.私も戦うぞ、王子。\nせめて一太刀、奴に浴びせねば……。\n――ぐぅッ……！:
I'll fight too, Prince.
At least I must land a strike on him….
—Guh…!
m920118.私自身も、魔王の命を受け、\nこれまで、密かにその『力』の調査をしていた。: I've been commissioned by him, and I've been secretly investigating that ‘power' all this time.
m920118.私達を……利用……？\nいったいどういうことですか！: Are you… using us? What on earth does that mean!
m920118.良い……良いぞ王子ッ！\nお前との激突で、我輩が生きた証を残させてくれ。: Good… good, Prince! Let this clash be the proof that I lived.
m920118.英雄王の系譜、人類種の希望、\n物質界の守護者……何とも下らぬものだ。\n我が前:
The Hero King's lineage, humanity's hope,
the guardian of the material realm… such trivialities.
If you don't stand before me, those who have survived until the age of ruin…
m920118.裏切ったわけではない。\n元より私の目的はひとつだけ。\n魔王に復讐することだけ: I didn't betray him. My purpose has always been singular: to avenge the Demon King.
m920118.許すだと？ 思い上がりも甚だしい。\nもはや、お前達の思惑など関係ないのだ……。:
Letting? Your arrogance is astounding.
Your plans no longer matter…
No human can resist me now.
m920118.誰が死に体だ。\nこっちの心は全っ然折れてないぞ、魔王軍っ！:
Who's on the brink of death?
Our hearts aren't broken at all, Demon Army!
m920118.負傷者も増えるばかりで、\n癒やしの力も追いつきません……。: The wounded keep increasing, and our healing can't keep up…
m920118.貴様が弱まり、腕利きの護衛が側を離れた、\n我が刃が届くこの瞬間を、待ち続けたぞ: Now that you're weakened and your skilled guards have left your side, I've been waiting for the moment my blade can reach you...!!
m920118.進軍を止めてくれるなら、\n私達の攻撃も届きますからね。: If you halt your advance, our attacks will reach them, you know.
m920118.隊列……行進……？\nいったい何をいっているのでしょうか。:
Formations… marching…?
What on earth are they talking about?
m920118.雑兵だけでお前達の\n相手をさせたのは少々酷だったかもしれんな。: Perhaps it was a bit harsh to have you face us with just foot soldiers.
m920118.雪降り止まぬ地……ですか？: A land where the snow never stops…?
m920118.魔物の群れの向こうに、\n魔王親衛隊のシャディアを見たという報告もあります。\n: There are reports of seeing Shadia, the Demon Lord's elite guard, beyond the monster horde. It seems she hasn't yet reached the front lines…
m920118.魔王が何を意図して\n雪原にいるのかは分かりませんが……。\nもう迷っている時間: I don't know what the Demon King intends by staying in the snowfield, but… there doesn't seem to be any time left for hesitation.
m920118.魔王は魔界の各地に点在する、\nある種の『力』を探している。: The Demon King is searching for a certain kind of ‘power' scattered across the demon realm.
m920118.魔王への背信は演技で、\n王子を暗殺するべく懐に潜り込んだ\nとは考えないのです: You think the betrayal to the Demon King was just an act, that you slipped into his inner circle to assassinate the Prince?
m920118.魔王を倒せる希望があるのなら、\nそれがどんなに僅かな可能性であれ、\n賭ける価: If there's even a sliver of hope to defeat the Demon King, it seems worth the gamble… .
m920118.魔王ガリウス、お前は必ず、俺が倒す。: Demon King Garius, I'll definitely defeat you.
m920118.魔王ガリウス！！\n我が兄の、そして私自身の仇を取らせてもらう！\nその首、貰い: Demon King Garius!! I'll avenge my brother—and myself! I'll take your head!!
m920118.魔王様、最後の一撃は\n御自ら下されてはいかがでしょう？: Demon King, why not deliver the final blow yourself?
m920118.魔王様、私はゴブリンクイーンと共に、\n前線の指揮に当たりたいと思います。\n行: Demon King, I'll take command of the front lines together with the Mecha Goblin Queen. Let's go, Goblin Queen.
m920118.魔王様。王国、帝国両軍が我が軍を挟撃する形で\n進軍しております。……恐らくは挟: Demon King, the Kingdom and Empire forces are advancing to flank our army. …They'll likely coordinate the pincer and send the Prince's elite units straight at you.
m920118.魔王軍幹部、竜将クロコに……\nメ、メカゴブリンクイーン！？\nどうしてゴブリン: The demon-lord's elite, Dragon General Croco… Me—Mecha Goblin Queen?! How did goblins end up in the demon-lord's ranks…?
m920118.魔術師達に後れを取るな！\n王子が諦めないのなら、道を拓くのは俺達だ！！: Don't fall behind the mages! If the Prince won't quit, it's up to us to blaze a trail!

m920151.――あ、あの、何だか変な音がしませんか？\nここには私たちしかいないはずですよね:
――Um, excuse me, do you hear that strange noise?
We should be the only ones here, right?
m920151.――あのぉ、本当にアンブローズさんなんですか？\n英傑で、私たちと一緒に戦った、:
――Um, is it really Ambrose?
The hero who fought alongside us,
that beautiful young woman, Ambrose……?
m920151.――いいえ、ご心配は無用です。\nアージェは無事に再起動しました。:
――No, please don't worry.
Arge has restarted successfully.
m920151.――いや、そんなことはさせない。\nどうやら間に合ったようだな、アエロ。:
――No, I won't let you do that.
Looks like we made it in time, Aero.
m920151.――くっ……。\n計算ではこれで王国軍など壊滅できるはず……。:
――Tch…
By all calculations, this should have annihilated the Kingdom's army…
m920151.――こんな所業に手を貸すはずがない。\nそう思っているようですね、ライノー。:
——I would never lend a hand to such atrocities.
That seems to be what you think, Rhyno.
m920151.――すまない王子殿、傷の手当までしてもらって。: ――I'm sorry, Prince. I've put you to the trouble of tending my wounds.
m920151.――その上、私みたいなデーモンや、\nアンデッドは癒やしの力を得られないんでしょ:
――And on top of that, demons like me,
and the undead, can't receive that healing power, right?
I remember that much! Honestly!
m920151.――と、水面から勢いよく飛び出して、\n遥か彼方にスカーさんが\nぶっ飛ばされた: —and with that, Scar was launched out of the water at full force and sent flying off into the distance. That was a few days ago.
m920151.――と言っている間に、巣の近くまで来たようですよ。\nここからでも、フレイムドラ:
――While we've been talking, it seems we've reached the vicinity of the nest.
Even from here, I can feel
the Flame Dragon's powerful mana.
m920151.――なぜ神の寵愛を拒むのですか。\nいずれ散りゆく者たちよ。:
――Why do you reject the divine favor?
You, who are destined to perish.
m920151.――なるほど、物質界では\nそんなことが起きていたのか……。: ――So that is what has been happening in the Material World……
m920151.――ゼェ！ ハァ！\nクソッ、エラ呼吸が苦しいゼ……。:
—Pant! Pant!
Damn it, breathing through gills is a pain…
m920151.――リッカ様、良い名前です。\nそしてそちらの方は――分析――完了。:
――Lady Rikka, what a lovely name.
And you over there――analysis――complete.
m920151.――亜神による、争いですか……。: ――A conflict between the demi-gods, is it……
m920151.――千年戦争の頃の遺跡だな。\nこんなところに、あいつが眠っているのか？:
――This is a ruin from the Millennium War.
So that's where she's been sleeping all this time?
m920151.――待て、パリオス。\nこの気配……まずい、囲まれているぞ！:
――Wait, Pallios.
This presence…… it's bad. We're surrounded!
m920151.――敵性存在沈黙。代理マスター、\nアージェの性能にはご満足いただけましたか？:
――Hostile entities neutralized. Proxy Master,
were you satisfied with Arge's performance?
m920151.――状況把握――完了。\nアージェが眠っている間に、\n機械技術は発展したようで:
――Situation assessment――complete.
It appears mechanical technology has advanced
while Arge was dormant.
m920151.――王子、何か変な音が聞こえないか？: ――Prince, do you hear that strange sound?
m920151.――王子、斥候から連絡だ。\nアラエルの軍勢が、再度こちらに進軍している。:
――Prince, we have a report from our scouts.
Arael's army is advancing on us again.
m920151.――発言停止。\nアージェは情緒と風情を理解しています。\nここから先は、リッカ:
――Cease your speech.
Arge understands emotion and sentiment.
From here on, please conduct your own research, Lady Rikka.
m920151.――神器を封印しておいた場所に、\n魔界アリとフレイムドラゴンが住み着いていて、:
――She says that Demon Realm Ants and a Flame Dragon
have moved into the place where the Divine Relic is sealed,
and she can't retrieve it on her own.
m920151.――表情解析。「非常に良い」だと分析できます。\nアージェの開発者たる亜神たちも:
――Expression analysis. I can determine the answer is "very good."
The sub-deities who developed Arge
would likely be pleased with your evaluation.
m920151.…………？\nパーフェクトというには身長が低いぞ？:
…………?
That's hardly “perfect.”
You're still pretty short.
m920151.…………？\n亜神？ 何を言っているのでしょう。:
…………?
Lesser gods? What are you talking about?
m920151.……いや、きっとアラエル様は、\n再び私たちを襲撃してくるはずだ。:
……No, Arael will surely
launch another attack on us.
m920151.……おかしいですね。\nガリウス様を倒したと聞いたので、\nもっと強い存在かと思:
……How strange.
I heard you defeated Garius,
so I expected a far more formidable presence.
m920151.……この状況でも、私たちを仲間と言ってくれるのか。: ……Even in a situation like this, you call us comrades.
m920151.……ご苦労。\n僕の小鳥よ、僕らの神に反逆する、\nすべての者を抹殺するのです。:
……Well done.
My little bird, we shall exterminate all who defy our God.
m920151.……そんなの可哀想すぎますわ。\n王子、あの子も助けてあげないとですわよね？:
……That is just too pitiful.
Prince, we have to help that child, don't we?
m920151.……と、ともあれ、\n心強い味方が……増えました、ね？:
……Anyway,
it seems we've gained a powerful ally, right?
m920151.……どういうことだ？\n――ぐっ……こ、これは……頭が……っ！:
……What's going on?
—Gh…… This is…… My head……!
m920151.……どこまでも目障りな者共め。\nならば僕の子らを呼ぶとしましょうか。:
……How utterly in the way you all are.
Very well, I shall call upon my children.
m920151.……どこまでも罪深い者たちよ。\n祈りは済ませましたか？\nさぁ天界兵よ、この地:
……You are sinners to the core.
Have you finished your prayers?
Then, Celestial soldiers, purify this land entirely.
m920151.……なるほど、街を奪えば補給路が確保できる。\nそれならまずは、鳥人の集落を目指: ……I see. Seizing the towns would secure our supply lines.
m920151.……はぁ。\nまぁ、お前の実力はよく知ってるしな。\n手伝ってやるとするか。:
……Haa.
Well, I know your strength well enough.
I'll help you out.
m920151.……はっ、ら、ライノーさん！ パリオスさん！\n急いでここから離れてください！！:
……R-Rhyno! Parios!
Get away from here, now!!
m920151.……ほう。\nユージェン、これは重装歩兵の行軍の音だな。\n鎧と足音が重なって、:
……Hm.
Yuugen, that is the sound of a heavy infantry march.
The clanking of armor and the heavy footfalls
create that deep, resonant noise.
m920151.……まさか深海でサラタンと遭遇するとは。: ……To encounter a Saratan in the deep sea of all places.
m920151.……またくだらない話を。\n僕の小鳥よ、君なら神の存在を感じられますね？:
……More of that nonsense.
My little bird, you can sense God's presence, can't you?
m920151.……みんな、アラエルさまを連れて撤退するよ。\nこんなに苦しそうなの……可哀想、:
……Everyone, let's take Arael-sama and retreat.
She's in so much pain… it's just too sad…
m920151.……やはり、王子の軍勢は厄介ですね。\nこれまで静観していたのは、\nやはり悪手:
……So the Prince's army is a thorn in our side after all.
Watching from the sidelines
was a grave mistake, it seems.
m920151.……アラエル、撤退しました。\nパリオスさんや、他の操られた鳥人さんたちも。:
……Arael has retreated.
Pallios and the other controlled bird-people have gone with her.
m920151.……アラエルさま。\nアラエルさま、苦しそう……。:
……Arael-sama.
Arael-sama is in so much pain…
m920151.……パリオス。\nくそっ、私の、せいだ……。:
……Pallios.
Damn it… this is my fault…
m920151.……一緒に、探してくれる、のか？\nいや、だが貴殿らには貴殿らの故郷を守る戦いが:
……You will search with me?
No, but you have your own homeland to defend…….
m920151.……仕方ないだろ？\n最後にお前に会った時は、\nもっと大人っぽい容姿だっただろ:
……What can you do?
The last time I saw you,
you looked a lot more mature.
m920151.……何が守護者だ。\n自分が守るべき者に、精神支配をかけたな！？:
……What kind of “Guardian” are you?
You're using mental domination on those you're supposed to protect!?
m920151.……命令は変わりません。\nこの集落を殲滅するのです、僕の小鳥よ。:
……The order has not changed.
Annihilate this settlement, my little bird.
m920151.……嘘だ。\nなぜ神の被造物たるあなたが、\n亜神の勢力になど手を貸しているので:
……Lies.
Why are you, a creation of the God,
lending your strength to the forces of a demigod?
m920151.……天使とは、神の兵器です。\n堕天することで私たちは自由意志を得ましたが、\n:
……Angels are the God's weapons.
We gained free will through our fall, but
they must still be bound to obey only the God's commands.
m920151.……天使とは意思ある兵器。\n創造主以外の命を聞くとすれば、\n堕天か、他の者に:
……An angel is a weapon with a will of its own.
If it were to obey a command from anyone other than the Creator,
it would only be after falling, or when it is controlled by another.
m920151.……嫌な表情ですね。\n自信に満ちた、迷いなき表情です。:
……What a displeased look.
A face filled with confidence, devoid of any doubt.
m920151.……我々に敵対する亜神は、\nおそらく天使を従える、\n何らかの手段を手に入れた:
……The demigod who opposes us
has likely acquired some means
of commanding the angels.
m920151.……戯言を。\nこうなればアラエル様の力を借りるしかありませんね。:
……Nonsense.
It seems we have no choice but to call upon Arael's power.
m920151.……東の国風に、おさしみという手もありますけどね。\nとはいえ調査が終わるまでは:
……If we go by the customs of the eastern lands, sashimi would be an option.
But until the investigation is complete, we won't be having any lavish meals.
m920151.……物質界を制した人間に\n与する者を減らそうとしているのだろう。:
……They're likely trying to reduce the number of humans
who have conquered the Material World.
m920151.……王国の、王子ですか。\n神の愛を拒み、神を殺した者が、\n次は天界で何をしよ:
……The Prince of that kingdom, is it.
You who rejected God's love and killed a god—
what do you intend to do in the Celestial Realm now?
m920151.……王子殿、惑わされるな。\nもとより多くの亜神たちは、ケラウノス様を\n疎まし:
……Your Highness, do not be swayed.
Many of the lesser gods had long resented Keraunos-sama.
m920151.……生意気な目です。\n信仰心のかけらも感じられない。:
……What insolent eyes.
I cannot sense a shred of faith in you.
m920151.……知恵は回るようですね。\nですがそれに気付いたからといって、\n何か打つ手が:
……It seems you are quite the strategist.
But knowing that doesn't change anything, does it?
m920151.……私たちが、今まさに向かおうとしていた、\n鳥人の集落がある方角だな。:
……It is the direction of the birdman settlement
we were just about to head to.
m920151.……私たちの神は、もういないからです。\nアラエル様、天使とは創造主を助けるもの:
……Because our God is no longer there.
Arael, an angel is one who assists the Creator.
Now that God is gone, who is it that controls you?
m920151.……魔法で身体を生成して、\n魂を移して永遠に生きてるって本当だったのか。\nて:
……So it's true.
You generate your body with magic,
transfer your soul into it, and live forever.
I thought it was just a drunk's tall tale.
m920151.「あの子」がアージェを天界に連れて行ったら\n物質界の手助けが出来ないじゃないで:
The Hero King, the Heavens, and you……
you all just love making things complicated, don't you……
Well, fine. Now we just wait for the Prince to enter the inner chamber.
m920151.ああ。今の天界は、亜神たちによる\n勢力争い――否、もはや戦争状態にあると言って: I see. The current state of the Celestial Realm is a power struggle among the demi-gods――no, it is fair to say it has already become a war.
m920151.ああ。天界の動乱が始まってからは\n交流が途絶えてしまっていたがな。:
That's right. Since the turmoil in the Celestial Realm began,
contact between the two groups has been cut off.
m920151.あたしこそ、歴史に寄り添い未来を守る！\n偉大なる転生魔導士のアンブローズちゃん:
I'm the one who stands by history and protects the future!
I'm the great reincarnated mage, Ambrose-chan!
m920151.あなた方がケラウノス様を倒さなければ、\n天界にこんな争いは起きなかったでしょう:
If you had not defeated Keraunos-sama,
this conflict would never have arisen in the Celestial Realm.
m920151.あの方も音信不通となって随分と経つ。\n他の亜神に殺されたという噂もあれば、\n: It has been quite some time since we last heard from that one as well. There are rumors that they were killed by other demi-gods, and others say they were taken hostage.
m920151.ありえません。\n神が目覚めたとなれば、\n強力な魔力の乱れで世界のどこにいても:
Impossible.
If a god were to awaken,
the resulting surge in magical power would be felt anywhere in the world.
m920151.ありがとう、王子、みんな。\nこれより我が翼は、刃は、貴殿のために捧げよう。\n:
Thank you, Prince, and everyone.
From this moment on, my wings and my blades are dedicated to you.
Please, help me save Pallios and Arael-sama.
m920151.あれはアラエル様に仕える霊鳥だ。\nその生命は不滅で、倒すことができないという。:
They are Spirit Birds that serve Arael.
Their lives are said to be immortal; they cannot be slain.
m920151.あれは人の信ずる神とは別の神による創造物だ。\n物質界の人間に似てはいるが、\n: Those are creations of a god other than the one mortals worship. They may resemble humans, but they're fundamentally different beings—fight them as such.
m920151.あれらの個体には、一定以上の攻撃能力が必要です。\n数より質、つまりアージェをご:
Those individuals require a certain level of offensive power to be defeated.
Quality over quantity, in other words, please make use of Arge.
m920151.あんた達の隠れ里も襲撃されたんだから、\nむしろ今まで無事だったほうが奇跡なのか:
Your hidden village was attacked too, so
it's actually a miracle that it stayed safe until now.
Your friends are there, right? Let's hurry!
m920151.あんなデカイ鮫の魚人に殴り勝つなんて、\n海底にいったい何がいるんだろうね……。: To beat a fish-man the size of that shark in a fistfight… just what on earth is lurking down there in the deep?
m920151.いつか天界に起きるだろう動乱に備えて、か。\n「あの亜神」め、わざわざ封印しなく:
In preparation for the turmoil that would one day erupt in the Heavens, I suppose.
That “sub-deity” really should have just kept her by her side,
instead of going to the trouble of sealing her away.
m920151.いや、聞き間違いだろう。\nアラエルとは、私たちの創造主が生み出した、\n空を飛:
No, I must have misheard.
Arael is the name of the angel who guards those who take to the skies,
created by our Creator.
m920151.うっ……それはもう、どうしようもないというか……。\n魔導装置が壊れちゃった以上:
Ugh…… I mean, there's nothing I can do about it now.
With the magic device broken, I guess I'll just have to make do with this body for a while……
m920151.うわっとっとっと。\n海流の乱れのせいで、興奮した魚も出てきました！:
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
The turbulent currents are agitating the fish!
m920151.えぇ。私たちが魔王を封印した後、\nアージェはこの封印施設で眠りについたんです。:
Yes. After we sealed away the Demon King,
Arge went to sleep in this sealing facility.
m920151.えぇっ！？\nもしかしてアエロちゃんたちの集落も、\nどこかの勢力の襲撃を受けて:
Wha-!?
Could it be that Aelro-chan's settlement is also
under attack by some faction……!?
m920151.えっ、えっ！？ どういうことですか！？\n私のくぐつがどうしたんですかー！？:
Eh, eh?! What do you mean?!
What's wrong with my Kugutsu?!
m920151.えっ、わ、私ですか？\n私は機甲士のリッカです。:
Eh, w-what? Me?
I'm Rikka, a Mecha Knight.
m920151.え～！？ 王子、王子も何とか言ってくださいよぉ！: Huh?! Prince, Prince, please say something!
m920151.お、おおお、王子さまぁっ！\nすごい重装の天界兵が\n集落の方に向かってくるよぉ:
P-Prince!
A massive force of heavy Celestial soldiers
is heading straight for the settlement!
m920151.おいしいごはんと、\n天界の情報をくれるだけでも十分よ。\n今日だって道案内して:
Just providing us with a good meal and information about the Celestial Realm is plenty.
You're even guiding us around today, after all.
m920151.おかげで魔王との決戦にも間に合わなかったし……。\nごめんねぇ、英雄王の子孫ちゃ:
And because of that, I missed the decisive battle with the Demon King……
I'm sorry, descendant of the Hero King.
m920151.おそらく私たちの隠れ里を襲撃した天使も、\n里を庇護下に置いていた亜神が姿を消し: It is likely that the angels who raided our hidden village took advantage of the demi-god's disappearance to expand their territory.
m920151.お前の言葉遣いは脳にこびりつくんだよ！！: Your way of speaking is burned right into my brain!
m920151.きっと、王子も同じ意見だと思うよ……？\n王子はね、誰より仲間のことを大切に思っ:
I'm sure the Prince feels the same way……?
You know, the Prince cherishes his comrades more than anyone.
m920151.きっとすぐ近くに、\n大規模な本隊が控えているはずです！:
There's no doubt a large main force
is lying in wait just nearby!
m920151.きっと力になってくれるはずだよー！\nみんないい人ばっかりの集落で、\nあっ、ぼ:
They're sure to be a great help!
It's a settlement full of wonderful people, and oh, my best friend is there too, so let me introduce you to—
m920151.くっ……やめろパリオス！\n行かないでくれ！！:
Curses… stop it, Pallios!
Don't go!!
m920151.ぐぅっ……くそっ……。\nパリオスを返せ……っ！！:
Grr…… Damn it…….
Give Pallios back……!!
m920151.ぐっ……頭が……割れそうに……あぁあぁッ！！\n撤退……撤退するぞッ！ 陣地まで:
Gh…… My head…… it's about to…… Aaah!!
Retreat…… We're falling back!
Fall back to the base!!
m920151.こいつら、すっごく努力するし、\nすぐ成長するし、数日見ないだけで\nすっごくカ:
They work incredibly hard,
grow incredibly fast, and if you don't see them for a few days,
they come back looking incredibly cool!
m920151.ここは地上への門に近いから、\nまだ結界の力も弱い方ではあるが……。\n慣れない:
Since this place is close to the gate to the ground,
the barrier's power is weaker here, but……
Combat in unfamiliar conditions is dangerous. Be careful!
m920151.こちらこそ感謝を。\nライノーさん、パリオスさんのおかげで、\n物質界連合軍の天:
We are the ones who should be thanking you.
Thanks to Rhyno and Pallios, we were able to establish the Material World Coalition's base here in the Celestial Realm.
m920151.この魔力の伝わり方……。\n嫌ってほど知ってますわよ……っ！！:
The way this magical power is spreading…….
I know all too well, unfortunately……!!
m920151.これから向かうのは、\nライノーさんたちの隠れ里と仲のいい、\n鳥人さんたちの集:
The place we are heading to next is the birdman settlement, right?
The one that was on good terms with Rhyno-san and the others' hidden village?
m920151.これで全盛期の、パーフェクトな\nアンブローズちゃん復活ですよぉ！:
With this, the perfect
Ambrose-chan from her prime is back!
m920151.これは……機械の駆動音……？\nもしかして警備装置が起動しちゃったんじゃ！？:
This is…… the sound of machinery starting up……?
Could it be that the security system has activated?!
m920151.これは正しき戦い……。\n神は未だ生きておられる……。\n僕らが亜神に従わされる:
This is a righteous war….
God is still alive….
There is no way we could be forced to obey a demi-god…
m920151.さすがは魔王ガリウスを倒した男だ。\n貴殿になら、私たちの部族も安心して翼を預け:
Truly, you are the man who defeated the Demon Lord Galios.
We can entrust our wings to you with peace of mind.
m920151.さっそく気付かれちゃったってわけね……。\nまったく、ただでさえ動きにくいってい:
So we were noticed right away……
I can't believe it. It's already hard enough to move around as it is!
m920151.そうなんですよぉ♪\nなので子孫ちゃんの実力を見るついでに、\n一緒に神器回収デ:
That's right♪
So while I'm checking out the descendant's skills,
I thought we'd go on a relic-retrieval date♪
m920151.その通り、僕が残虐な行いに手を貸すことはありません。\nそう、これは非道ではなく:
You are right. I would never aid in any cruel act.
This is not wickedness, but
the will of the holy God, and something I have desired.
m920151.それから王子、すごーく言いにくいんだけど、\nこの集落の中って天界の抑止の力が更:
Also, Prince, this is really hard to say, but
the celestial suppression force seems even stronger inside this settlement.
Please take care of the demon and undead units.
m920151.それが分かっただけじゃ、\n何も打つ手がないですよぉ……。:
Knowing that alone doesn't
give us any real options…….
m920151.それじゃあ子孫ちゃん、\nはりきってドラゴン退治しちゃいましょうねぇ♪: Then, descendant, let's give it our all and take that dragon down♪
m920151.それでは、王国へ帰還しましょうか。\n此度のフレイムドラゴン討伐、お疲れさまでし: Then shall we return to the kingdom? Thanks for the hard-won victory over the Flame Dragon!
m920151.それでも天界に来てくれたこと、\nすっごく、すっごく感謝してるよ！\nありがと王:
But I'm so, so grateful that you came to the Celestial Realm!
Thank you, Prince!
m920151.それなら話は難しくない。\n戦争の基本は補給と情報収集だぜ？: Then the situation is not difficult to understand.
m920151.それに「天界を助けてー！」って\nお願いしたのは、ぼくたちの方だしね！\n出来る:
Besides, it was us who begged you to "help the Celestial Realm!"
So we'll do whatever we can!
m920151.それにこんな人里近くの渓谷に\nフレイムドラゴンがいるっていうのも問題だしな。\:
Besides, having a Flame Dragon in a valley
so close to civilization is a problem.
We should hunt it down before it damages the foothills.
m920151.それまでに戦力を整えておくしかない、か。\n良いじゃないか、王子。\n真正面から:
Then we have no choice but to prepare our forces in the meantime.
Very well, Prince.
Let's face him head-on.
m920151.だ、だめですパリオスちゃん！\nさっきのは本隊じゃないんですよ！:
N-No, Pallios-chan!
That wasn't the main force!
m920151.では、まずは鳥人さんの集落を目指しましょうか。\nライノーさん、パリオスさん、\: Then let us head to the birdman settlement first.
m920151.でもこれで、謎の巨大生物の件は解決ですね♪: But that solves the mystery of the giant creature, doesn't it?♪
m920151.ともあれ、現状は物質界に\n戦力を送り込んだ亜神の正体も分からないんだろう？: In any case, we don't know the identity of the demi-god who sent forces to the Material World, do we?
m920151.ど、どどど、どうなってるんですか……？\n前に深海でも、\n天使が創造主を裏切っ:
W-what's going on here…?
Earlier, in the Deep Sea,
an angel betrayed the Creator…
m920151.どうやって倒すんですのそれー！？: How on earth do you defeat something like that?!
m920151.なぜです……なぜ……なぜですか……ッ！！\n神の命を受けたこの僕に\n物質界のゴ:
Why… why… why is this…!!
You, who serve at God's command…
You dare say that the trash of the material world is our equal?!
m920151.なっ……何をする！？\n僕はまだ戦える！\n神の愛を伝えなければいけないのに！:
Wha— what are you doing!?
I can still fight!
I have to spread the love of God!
m920151.なっ、なな、何が神さまですか！\nケラウノス様のいない今、\n亜神同士で争ってる:
???: W-Wha-What do you mean, "divine"?
Now that Keraunos-sama is gone,
aren't you just fighting each other, you lesser gods!?
m920151.ならば、ここでその生命を終わらせましょう。\nただ、ただ祈り続けなさい、人の子ら:
Then, let us end your lives right here.
Pray, and pray, and pray, children of men.
m920151.なるほど、怪物の伝承は天界の介入の可能性が……。\nっと、その前に迎撃でした！:
I see, the monster legends might be evidence of celestial intervention….
Oh, right, we need to intercept them first!
m920151.なんて強力な精神支配ですの……。\nこれでは一度解呪しても、\nまたすぐに支配さ:
What powerful mental domination…
Even if we break the curse once,
they will fall under its control again in no time…
m920151.はぁ、今日はおいしいお鍋のはずだったのですが……。\n水中ではお鍋が作れないです:
Ah, I was looking forward to a nice, hearty hot pot today…
You can't really make hot pot underwater, can you?
m920151.はははっ！ これはおかしい。\n僕の小鳥を、僕の手元に置いて何が悪いのでしょうか:
Hahaha! How absurd.
What's wrong with me keeping my little birds by my side?
m920151.ふっふっふ、神器奪取成功ですぅ♪: Fu-fu-fu, the Divine Relic is secured♪
m920151.ぼくが、お助けしないと……。\nアラエルさまを、助けないと……。:
I have to… help her…
I have to save Arael-sama…
m920151.まぁ、かつての味方とやりあうのは\n勘弁してほしいところだな。: Well, I'd prefer not to have to fight former allies.
m920151.まぁそういうわけで、\nこれからの天界での戦いを助けるべく、\nあたしも戦力に加:
Anyway, with all that said,
I'd like to join the fight
to help with the upcoming battles in the Celestial Realm……
m920151.まずいですね……。\nまだ王子君たちが戻っていないのに……。:
That's bad…….
The Prince and the others haven't returned yet…….
m920151.また、撃破時の自爆には十分にご注意を。\n代理マスター、あなたの指揮能力を信じま:
Also, please be careful of the self-destruct mechanisms upon defeat.
Proxy Master, I trust in your command abilities.
--- scene: Ancient Magitech Soldier, Activation (battle, end) ---
m920151.むぅぅぅぅ。\nアトナテスちゃんも信じてないんですかぁ？:
Ambrose?: Mmmph.
You don't believe me either, Atnates-chan?
m920151.やっ……いやぁっ……！！\nぼくの中に、入ってこないで……っ！！:
I c…… No, aaah……!!
Don't come inside me……!!
m920151.やった！ 天界兵たちを倒したよー！！: We did it! We defeated the Celestial soldiers!!
m920151.やっぱり器おっきいなぁ♪\n英雄王ちゃんの血かな？\n教育係が良かったんですかね:
You really have a big heart, don't you♪
Is that the Hero King's blood?
Maybe you just had good tutors♪
m920151.ら、ライノーさん！\nそれに、この方々は……？:
R-Rhyno-san!
And, who are these people……?
m920151.アラ……エル……さま……。\n進軍の……準備は……整いました……。:
Arael… my… Lord….
The… advance… is… ready…
m920151.アラエル様とパリオスの行方は、\nまったく分からない……。\nすまない、不甲斐な:
We have no idea where Arael-sama and Pallios are…….
I'm sorry. I've failed you…….
m920151.アラエル様！ こちらへ！！\nもしかしたら精神支配を解くことが――:
Arael! Over here!
Perhaps we can break the mental domination—
m920151.アージェが敵に回る状況は、\n人類の皆さまにとって\n非常に良くないものと想定で:
Since a situation where Arge turns against the enemy
would be extremely detrimental
to the human race.
m920151.アージェちゃん、お久しぶりですね！\n天界に帰っちゃったと思ってましたよー。:
Arge, it's been a while!
I thought you had gone back to the Celestial Realm.
m920151.アージェちゃん！ 王子ちゃん！\n良かったぁ、敵がすぐ近くまで迫ってるんですよー:
Arge! Prince!
Phew, you're just in time! The enemies are closing in fast!
m920151.アージェは完璧な兵器ですから、\n『銀腕』とソラス様は、悪意ある者に知られぬよう:
Arge is a perfect weapon, after all.
"Silver Arm" and Solais hid Arge in this sealed facility
so that her existence would not become known to those with ill intent.
m920151.アージェは非攻撃状態の間、攻撃性能を増加し、\n打撃機構の解放指示と同時に\n遠:
While in a non-attacking state, Arge increases her offensive power.
Upon receiving the command to release the impact mechanisms,
she can deploy long-range attacks.
m920151.ギガエルの軍勢との戦いもありますし、\n可能な限り海底の危険は\n取り除いておき: With the war against the Gigaels looming, we really need to eliminate any potential threats from the seabed as much as possible.
m920151.ケラウノス様が姿を消して以来、\n各地の亜神たちが残された「神の楔」を巡って\n: Ever since Keraunos vanished, the demi-gods in various regions have been engaged in large-scale battles over the "God's Wedges" he left behind.
m920151.ケラウノス様なき今、ここまで強固に\n天使を従える手段など何処にもないはず……。:
Now that Keraunos is gone, there should be no way
they could be so firmly
under anyone's control…
m920151.サラタァァァァァン！！\nどこに逃げやがったァ！？\nシャァァァァァァァック！！:
SARATAAAAAAN!!
Where did you run off to?!
SHAAAAACK!!
m920151.シャァァァァァック！！\nやってらんねェぜ！ あのクソ天使サマめ！！:
Shaaaaack!!
I can't take it anymore! That damn angel!
m920151.テメェ！ このサラタン！\nリベンジマッチに来たぞ――って、アァン？:
You! You Saratan!
I've come for a rematch— Wait, what?
m920151.ライノー、あなたは誤解しています。\n僕は神の聖なる戦いに、\n自ら望んで参じて:
Rhyno, you are mistaken.
I am participating in the God's holy war
of my own free will.
m920151.ライノーさん！！\nいま精神支配を解きます！\n少しだけ耐えてください！:
Rhyno!!
I'm breaking the mental domination now!
Just hold on a little longer!
m920151.世界樹の魔物化を目論んだのも、\nきっと似たような考えによるものに違いない。:
The plot to turn the World Tree into a monster
was surely born from the same mindset.
m920151.中には事態を静観している亜神さまや、\nぼくたちの里を保護してくれる\n亜神さま: Some demi-gods are choosing to keep out of it, and there are others who have been protecting our village, but……
m920151.主よ！ なぜです！\nなぜ応えてくれないのですか！？:
My Lord! Why?!
Why won't you answer me?!
m920151.乾いた地のごはん、楽しみにしていたのですが……。\n――っと、あら……？\nなん:
I was looking forward to a proper meal on dry land…
Oh, wait…?
The currents seem a bit disturbed…
m920151.人質を取っておいて、酷い言い草ですわね……。\nパリオスさんを返しなさいな！！:
What a cruel thing to say, holding someone hostage…….
Return Pallios to us!!
m920151.人間ごときが、\nより強くなっているとでも言うのですか……？:
Are you saying that mere humans
have grown even stronger…?
m920151.他の神さまが目覚めたという可能性は……？: Is there a possibility that another god has awakened…?
m920151.仲間がさらわれたなら、\nそれを助けに行くのだって当たり前ですわよ！:
If a companion has been taken,
of course we must go and rescue them!
m920151.何か憂さ晴らしを……って、アァン？\nなんだこのでっかい影は――って、グワァァァ:
I just wanted to blow off some steam… Huh?
What the hell is that massive shadow— GWAH?!
m920151.何が魚人たちのタメだッ！\nクラールフのクソ野郎に牙剥く\nイケテル野郎だと思っ: What the hell is this about the fish-folk?! I was ready to sink my teeth into that bastard Claluf, thinking he was some kind of badass, but he's nothing but a crook!
m920151.何度も言ってるじゃないですかぁ。\nサナラちゃんは本当に心配性なんですからぁ。:
I've told you over and over, haven't I?
You really are such a worrier, Sanara.
m920151.僕が「空に生きる者の守護者」\nであるという、その意味をね。:
The true meaning behind my title,
“Guardian of Those Who Live in the Sky.”
m920151.僕がここで負けるわけには……ぐぅッ！\nあ、頭が割れそうだ……くそっ、くそぉぉぉ:
I cannot… lose here… ghh!
My head… it's splitting… damn it, damn it!!
m920151.僕の……僕の鳥たちが……。\nどうして……こんなことが……ッ！？:
My… my birds…
Why… why is this happening…!?
m920151.僕の持ち物をどうしようと、僕の勝手でしょう。\nさぁ可愛い僕の小鳥たち、\n物質:
It's none of your business how I handle my possessions.
Now then, my little birds,
sweep away the rude interlopers of the material world.
m920151.僕らの神無き今、僕が小鳥たちの――いや、まて、\nかみ……なき……？\nいいや、:
In this age without gods, I am the birds'— No, wait,
god……less……?
No, my god certainly exists…….
m920151.先程よりも激しい戦いとなることだろう。\nどうか、私たちに力を貸してほしい。:
This battle will be far more intense than before.
Please, lend us your strength.
m920151.全軍、鳥人の集落を殲滅せよ！\n我らが神は、鳥人の血をお望みだ！！:
All units, annihilate the bird-folk settlement!
Our God desires the blood of the bird-folk!!
m920151.全面的に肯定です。\n――質問。ところで、そちらのお嬢様は？:
I fully agree.
――Question. By the way, who is that young lady over there?
m920151.兵にも休息が必要ですからね。\nそれでは王子、地上に帰還しましょうか。:
The soldiers need their rest as well.
Then, Prince, shall we return to the surface?
m920151.創造主を助け、被造物たる空を飛ぶ者を慈しむ、\n心優しきアラエル様が、こんな所業:
Arael, who aids the Creator and shows compassion to the flying beings under her care…
would never lend a hand to such atrocities—
m920151.哀れなる鳥人の子よ、\n神の寵愛を拒むその罪により、今ここで、\n我らが浄化の手:
Poor birdman child,
for the sin of rejecting divine favor, we shall now
extend the hand of purification to you.
m920151.地上に戻って、砂浜でおいしいごはんだね！: Let's head back to the surface and enjoy a delicious meal on the beach!
m920151.天使たちが撤退していきます。\nしかしあの方角は……。:
The angels are retreating.
But that direction is……
m920151.天使を操る手段を、何れかの亜神が手に入れたと、\nその予想は正しかったようですが:
It seems our prediction was correct.
One of the demigods must have acquired a means of controlling angels…….
m920151.天使を操る装置が存在するというのなら、\nいずれ私たちも、\nそれを破壊しなけれ:
If a device that controls angels exists,
then sooner or later,
we will have to destroy it too――
m920151.如何に強き英雄と言えど、\n押し寄せる軍勢に抗うことはできないでしょう。:
No matter how strong a hero may be,
they cannot stand against an advancing army.
m920151.小さくなっちゃったのは！ あたしも想定外なのぉ！:
I didn't expect to shrink!
It was a total surprise, too!
m920151.強さとカッコよさは関係ないだろう。\nだが、そうだな、私もそう信じたい。: Strength and coolness have nothing to do with each other.
m920151.我々には天界の土地勘がありませんからね。\nこうして友好関係を結べそうな集落に\:
We have no sense of the terrain in the Celestial Realm.
It is a great help that you are guiding us to a settlement that seems amenable to a friendly alliance.
m920151.操るだとか、従えるだとか……。\nまったく、これだから堕天した者は……。:
“Commanding” or “controlling”…
Honestly, this is what I expect from fallen ones…
m920151.敵性存在より、障壁を感知しました。\n代理マスター、半透明の障壁が見えますか？:
I've detected a barrier from the hostile entities.
Proxy Master, can you see the translucent barrier?
m920151.本当だ……すごい大きなものが動いてる気がする！: You're right… I feel like something huge is moving!
m920151.次は僕も前線に出ましょう。\n神の実在を疑う者には、\n相応の罰を与えなければな:
Next, I will take the front lines myself.
Those who doubt the existence of God
must be given a fitting punishment.
m920151.海面だけじゃなく、深海でも活動できたんですね。\nさすがは伝説の巨大カニです……:
So it can operate not just on the surface, but in the deep as well.
Truly worthy of being a legendary giant crab…
m920151.深海での戦闘では、水圧に気をつけてくださいまし。\n乾いた地の方々は徐々に身体に:
Please be careful with the water pressure during combat in the deep.
Those from the dry land will start to feel the strain on their bodies,
which will slow their movements and make their attacks sluggish.
m920151.物質界に敵意を持つ亜神を倒すとなれば、\nその支配下にある街を奪取し、\n戦力を: If we are to defeat the demi-god hostile to the Material World, we simply need to seize the towns under its control, whittle down its forces, and strike with everything we have.
m920151.物質界の王子さまだよ！\n天界の動乱を止めるために、\n地上からここまで来てくれ:
He's the Prince of the Material World!
He came all the way from the ground
to stop the turmoil in the Celestial Realm!
m920151.物質界の者にとっては違和感があるかもしれないな。\n天界には、他者を害する力を抑:
It might feel unnatural to those from the Material World.
In the Celestial Realm, a barrier is woven that suppresses the power to harm others
and slowly heals wounds.
m920151.状況分析――完了。\n代理マスター、アージェの性能を周知する好機かと。:
Situation analysis――complete.
Proxy Master, this seems like a good opportunity to demonstrate Arge's capabilities.
m920151.王子、パリオスさんの進行方向を見極め、\n兵の配置には十分に注意してくださいね！:
Prince, please identify Pallios's direction of advance
and pay close attention to your troop placements!
m920151.王子さま、天界兵が来るよ！\nあいつらの武器は神聖な力を蓄積して、\n強力な攻撃:
Prince, the Celestial soldiers are coming!
Their weapons charge up holy power
and unleash powerful attacks, so be careful!
m920151.王子君なら、きっと無事に再起動してくれますよ。\n私たちはのんびりと、ふたりを待:
The Prince will surely restart her safely.
Let's just relax and wait for the two of them♪
m920151.王子様、すぐそこまで魚の群れと、\n何だか巨大な気配が迫ってますよ！\n迎撃の準: Prince, a school of fish is right ahead, and some massive presence is closing in! Prepare to intercept!!
m920151.王子殿、アラエル様は我ら空に生きる者の守護者。\n鳥や鳥人を強化する加護を持って:
Your Highness, Arael is the guardian of those who live in the sky.
She bestows blessings that strengthen birds and bird-people.
m920151.王子殿の強さを知った以上、\n決して見過ごすことはないだろうからな……。:
Now that he knows of Your Highness's strength,
he won't simply let us go…….
m920151.神の愛を受け入れ、その身を捧げるならば\nこれが最後の機会ですよ。\n王子よ、人:
Accept the love of the Divine and offer up your life.
This is your last chance.
Prince, accept your fate as a child of man.
m920151.神の愛を！ あの御方の伝承を！\n後世の空に生きる者たちに伝えなければ！！:
The love of God! The legacy of that Being!
We must pass it on to those who live in the sky to come!!
m920151.神の手を汚させるまでもありません。\nここで、我々の手で、物質界の王子を抹殺しま:
I will not dirty the hands of the Divine.
Here and now, we shall eliminate
the Prince of the Material World with our own hands.
m920151.神の無限の愛を感じられないというのなら、\nここでその力の一端をお見せしましょう:
If you cannot feel the God's infinite love,
then allow me to show you a glimpse of that power.
m920151.神や亜神による強制的な戦闘状態、とでも言えばいいか。\n物質界にも荒ぶる怪物の逸:
You could call it a forced combat state induced by a god or demi-god.
Aren't there several legends of rampaging monsters
left behind in the material world?
m920151.私たちの目的と、ライノーさんの目的。\nそれはきっと同じ方向を向いていると思いま:
Our goal and Rhyno-san's goal.
I think they are certainly pointing in the same direction.
m920151.私たちの隠れ里と同じく、\n銀腕様の庇護下にあった集落だ。\n天使の襲撃も、幾度: It is a settlement that, like our hidden village, was under Silver Arm's protection.
m920151.私たちの集落は、ずっと包囲されたまま、\n散発的な攻撃を受け続けていたんです。:
Our settlement has been under siege for the longest time,
taking hit after hit from sporadic attacks.
m920151.私はパリオスの行方を探そうと思う。\n案内を約束したのに、すまない。\nでも私は:
I intend to search for Pallios.
I'm sorry for breaking my promise to guide you.
But I have to save that child――
m920151.私は幸いにも、堕天した後あなたに出会いました。\nけれどきっと彼は、\n望まぬ主:
I was fortunate enough to meet you after my fall.
But he is surely
being forced to serve a master he does not wish to obey.
m920151.罪深き者たちよ、これが最後の問いかけです。\n神を信じ、こちらへ下りなさい。\n:
Sinful ones, this is my final offer.
Believe in God and descend to us.
Our God has not perished.
m920151.肉体生成魔導装置が壊れちゃってて、\n成長が中途半端になっちゃったんですよねぇ。:
My body-generation magic device broke,
so my growth stopped halfway.
m920151.自前で永遠に生きられるからぁ、\n神さまパワーで永遠にしなくても大丈夫ですぅ♪\:
She said she could live forever on her own,
so she didn't need to use her divine power to make it permanent♪
I guess she's got herself to blame.
m920151.英雄王といい天界といいお前といい、\n回りくどいのが好きなんだな……。\nまぁい: Hero-king, heavens, you… you love beating around the bush, don't you? …Fine, all that's left is waiting for the Prince in the inner chamber.
m920151.補給のできない遠征ほど怖いものはないからな。\n少しでも助けになれたなら嬉しい。:
There is nothing more frightening than an expedition without resupply.
I'm glad we could be of some help.
m920151.覚悟を決めたというのなら、\nこのまま浄化の波に押しつぶされるが良いでしょう。:
If you have made up your mind,
then let the wave of purification crush you.
m920151.誰にそそのかされたかは知らないけど、\n人間って種族の強さを見誤ったみたいね。:
I don't know who misled them,
but they seem to have underestimated the strength of the human race.
m920151.転生ってただの肩書じゃなかったのか？\nこんな小さくなって現れると、\nどうして:

Princeeeeee!!
